title: 磁阻式記憶體磁穿隧接面
summary: 從MTJ 分層、STT 路徑到記憶體用途：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From MTJ stack and STT pathway to Memory application: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: MTJ 分層 → 磁各向異性
stages.description: 把「MTJ 分層」「TMR 定義」「磁各向異性」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for MTJ stack, TMR definition, Magnetic anisotropy.

steps.title: MTJ 分層：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization.
steps.instruction: 畫參考層、穿隧障壁及自由層，標出讀寫端點。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw reference layer, barrier and free layer with read/write terminals. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態；參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。
steps.observationEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization; Reference-layer stability also conditions readout.
steps.failure: 若採用「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「MTJ 分層」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit the MTJ stack diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer.

quiz.question: 關於「MTJ 分層」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For MTJ stack, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態
只標自由層方向而不定義參考層
不註明分母便比較不同 TMR 百分比
optionsEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization
Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer
Comparing TMR percentages without denominator conventions
quiz.explanation: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: MTJ 分層：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「MTJ 分層」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding MTJ stack artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Reference-layer stability also conditions readout. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態；參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。
steps.observationEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization; Reference-layer stability also conditions readout.
steps.failure: 若採用「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「MTJ 分層」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「參考層穩定性也是讀值條件」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for MTJ stack, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Reference-layer stability also conditions readout" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Reference-layer stability also conditions readout.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」與「穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer" is not equivalent to "Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.title: TMR 定義：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「電阻比的分母必須一致」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent.
steps.instruction:
以假設 RP、RAP 計算 (RAP-RP)/RP 並註明慣例。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設同一偏壓與溫度下 MTJ 平行電阻 RP=5 kΩ、反平行 RAP=10 kΩ，TMR=(RAP−RP)/RP=100%。若錯用 RAP 當分母會得到 50%。本例不含讀取電路雜訊或電阻分布，不能由平均 TMR 直接宣告可靠讀取。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute (RAP-RP)/RP from hypothetical values with the convention stated. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume MTJ resistances measured at the same bias and temperature are RP=5 kΩ and RAP=10 kΩ. TMR=(RAP−RP)/RP=100%; incorrectly using RAP as denominator gives 50%. Noise and resistance distributions are absent, so mean TMR does not establish reliable reading.
steps.observation: 電阻比的分母必須一致；RA 需註明有效接面面積。
steps.observationEn: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent; Resistance-area values need effective junction area.
steps.failure: 若採用「不註明分母便比較不同 TMR 百分比」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Comparing TMR percentages without denominator conventions", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「TMR 定義」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：電阻比的分母必須一致。
算例驗收：驗算 100%，標示分母 RP，並畫出兩態分布可能重疊的情況。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the TMR definition diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 100%, label RP as denominator and sketch a possible overlap of the two state distributions.

Introduce this diagnostic principle: Sense-amplifier offsets shrink read margins. title: 電阻式記憶體製作
summary: 從阻變截面、SET 與 RESET到權重漂移：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Resistive-switching section and SET and RESET to Weight drift: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 交叉陣列：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「陣列輸出不只由單元導電值決定」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Array output depends on more than cell conductance.
steps.instruction:
用小型電阻矩陣計算理想列電流，再加入線阻和偷流。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設理想交叉陣列的一個求和節點具有 G1=10 µS、G2=20 µS，輸入 V1=0.1 V、V2=0.2 V。兩支路電流為 1 與 4 µA，總和 5 µA。請依 I=ΣGV 列式；線阻、非線性、偷漏路徑與 ADC 誤差均未納入，結果不是實際神經網路精度。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute ideal column current for a small conductance matrix, then add line resistance/sneak paths. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume an ideal crossbar summing node with G1=10 µS, G2=20 µS and inputs V1=0.1 V, V2=0.2 V. Branch currents are 1 and 4 µA, totaling 5 µA by I=ΣGV. Line resistance, nonlinearity, sneak paths and ADC errors are excluded; the result is not real neural-network accuracy.
steps.observation: 陣列輸出不只由單元導電值決定；列電壓因線阻而沿線下降。
steps.observationEn: Array output depends on more than cell conductance; Line resistance changes local column voltages.
steps.failure: 若採用「單元線性就假定整陣列乘法精確」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

steps.check:
提交「交叉陣列」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：陣列輸出不只由單元導電值決定。
算例驗收：驗算兩支路與 5 µA 總和，並在電路圖上加一個可能破壞理想求和的寄生元件。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Crossbar array diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Array output depends on more than cell conductance.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify the branch currents and 5 µA sum, then add a parasitic element that could break ideal summation.

summaryEn: From Phase and ferroelectricity and Dopants and composition to Integration evidence: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 厚度與場：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Thickness and field: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「相同電壓對不同膜厚並非相同應力」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Equal voltage across different thicknesses is not equal stress.
steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設均勻 HZO 薄膜厚 10 nm，真正跨薄膜電壓為 1 V，平均場 E=1 MV/cm；改為 20 nm 則為 0.5 MV/cm。這個換算不能證明鐵電性或矯頑場；介面層分壓、漏電和量測波形需另外檢查。
steps.instructionEn:
Convert hypothetical voltage to field while separating film thickness/interface division. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a uniform 10 nm HZO film with an actual 1 V drop: average E=1 MV/cm; at 20 nm it is 0.5 MV/cm. This conversion does not demonstrate ferroelectricity or a coercive field; interface voltage division, leakage and the measurement waveform require separate checks.
steps.observation: 相同電壓對不同膜厚並非相同應力；局部薄點的電場高於平均。
steps.observationEn: Equal voltage across different thicknesses is not equal stress; Local thin spots have higher fields.
steps.failure: 若採用「用電壓相同就宣稱不同厚度測試公平」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Claiming fair thickness comparison from equal voltage", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「厚度與場」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：相同電壓對不同膜厚並非相同應力。
算例驗收：驗算兩個場值並指出要驗證可切換極化仍需要哪類對照量測。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Thickness and field diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Equal voltage across different thicknesses is not equal stress.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both fields and identify a control measurement still needed to establish switchable polarization.

stages.description: 把「FeCAP 與 FeFET」「非破壞讀出」「整合證據」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for FeCAP and FeFET, Nondestructive readout, Integration evidence.

steps.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET：建立模型
steps.titleEn: FeCAP and FeFET: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ.
steps.instruction: 畫獨立電容讀電荷與閘極控制通道讀電流的兩種回路。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw capacitor charge readout and ferroelectric-gated transistor current readout. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同；FeFET 通道捕捉也能移動閾值。
steps.observationEn: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ; FeFET channel traps can also shift threshold.
steps.failure: 若採用「同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「FeCAP 與 FeFET」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同。
steps.checkEn: Submit the FeCAP and FeFET diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ.

knowledge.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: FeCAP and FeFET / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 機制：FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ.

knowledge.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: FeCAP and FeFET / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop.

quiz.question: 關於「FeCAP 與 FeFET」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For FeCAP and FeFET, which inference has a physical basis?
options: FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同
同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗
讀出電流小就直接保證不擾動
optionsEn: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ
Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop
Guaranteeing nondisturbance from small read current
quiz.explanation: FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: FeCAP and FeFET: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「FeCAP 與 FeFET」成果，先指出錯誤主張「同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：FeFET 通道捕捉也能移動閾值。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding FeCAP and FeFET artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop". Introduce this diagnostic principle: FeFET channel traps can also shift threshold. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同；FeFET 通道捕捉也能移動閾值。
steps.observationEn: FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ; FeFET channel traps can also shift threshold.
steps.failure: 若採用「同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「FeCAP 與 FeFET」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「FeFET 通道捕捉也能移動閾值」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for FeCAP and FeFET, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "FeFET channel traps can also shift threshold" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: FeCAP and FeFET / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：FeFET 通道捕捉也能移動閾值。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: FeFET channel traps can also shift threshold.

knowledge.title: FeCAP 與 FeFET／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: FeCAP and FeFET / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「同一電容迴圈便完整預測 FeFET 記憶窗」與「FeCAP 與 FeFET 的讀取及介面要求不同」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Predicting a complete FeFET window from one capacitor loop" is not equivalent to "FeCAP and FeFET readout/interface requirements differ"; the control must expose their difference.

title: CMOS 影像感測器製作
summary: 從像素訊號鏈、完整電荷轉移到感測器驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Pixel signal chain and Complete charge transfer to Sensor acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 像素訊號鏈 → 光二極體深度
stages.titleEn: Pixel signal chain to Photodiode depth
stages.description: 把「像素訊號鏈」「前照與背照」「光二極體深度」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Pixel signal chain, Front versus back illumination, Photodiode depth.

steps.title: 像素訊號鏈：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Pixel signal chain: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Optical collection and electrical readout have different efficiencies.
steps.instruction: 畫光子、光電荷、轉移閘、浮接擴散與讀出放大器。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw photons, photocharge, transfer gate, floating diffusion and amplifier. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率；轉移閘時序會影響可讀出的電荷。

steps.title: 飽和與轉換增益：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Saturation and conversion gain: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「更高電壓轉換增益不等於更高滿井容量」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Higher voltage conversion gain does not imply greater full well.
steps.instruction:
用假設浮接電容算 ΔV=Q/C，比較訊號增益和容量需求。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設 1,000 個電子完整轉移到 10 fF 的感測節點，q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C，Q=1.602×10⁻¹⁶ C，電壓變化幅度 ΔV=Q/C=16.02 mV。若電容增為 20 fF，幅度為 8.01 mV。忽略寄生、漏失與放大器增益；這不是滿井容量或量子效率。
steps.instructionEn:
Use hypothetical floating-node capacitance to compare ΔV=Q/C and capacity. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume 1,000 electrons transfer completely to a 10 fF sense node. With q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C, Q=1.602×10⁻¹⁶ C and voltage-change magnitude ΔV=Q/C=16.02 mV. At 20 fF it becomes 8.01 mV. Parasitics, charge loss and amplifier gain are excluded; this is neither full-well capacity nor quantum efficiency.
steps.observation: 更高電壓轉換增益不等於更高滿井容量；讀噪需換算到同一電子或電壓單位。
steps.observationEn: Higher voltage conversion gain does not imply greater full well; Read noise needs consistent electron or voltage units.
steps.failure: 若採用「用單一增益數值代表動態範圍」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Representing dynamic range by gain alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「飽和與轉換增益」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：更高電壓轉換增益不等於更高滿井容量。
算例驗收：驗算 16.02 與 8.01 mV，並說明為何電容加倍使電荷轉電壓增益減半。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Saturation and conversion gain diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Higher voltage conversion gain does not imply greater full well.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 16.02 and 8.01 mV and explain why doubling capacitance halves charge-to-voltage gain.

title: 雪崩光二極體製作
summary: 從吸收與倍增、暗電流來源到偵測系統：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Absorption and multiplication and Dark-current sources to Detection system: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:
用同光通量比較低倍增參考與工作偏壓電流並扣暗電流。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設相同光通量下，已扣暗電流的單位增益參考光電流為 10 nA，工作偏壓下為 200 nA，雪崩增益 M=200/10=20。若未扣暗電流便用總電流相除，可能偏差。此例假定參考確為 M=1，且不提供過剩雜訊或擊穿電壓資訊。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare low-gain and operating currents at equal flux with dark subtraction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume equal photon flux and dark-subtracted photocurrents of 10 nA at a unit-gain reference and 200 nA at operating bias. Avalanche gain M=200/10=20. Dividing total currents without dark subtraction can bias gain. The reference is assumed to have M=1; the example does not determine excess noise or breakdown voltage.
steps.observation: 光源漂移會混入增益估計；低偏壓參考仍需確認收集效率。
steps.observationEn: Source drift contaminates gain estimates; Low-bias references still need collection checks.
steps.failure: 若採用「不同光強下的電流比直接當 M」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

算例驗收：驗算 M=20，寫出兩個必要條件：等光通量與暗電流扣除，另註明單位增益參考假設。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Gain calibration diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Source drift contaminates gain estimates.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify M=20 and record equal flux, dark subtraction and the assumed unit-gain reference.

title: 單光子雪崩二極體陣列
summary: 從Geiger 觸發、後脈衝到熱點像素：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Geiger triggering and Afterpulsing to Hot pixels: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Geiger triggering, Quench and reset, Photon-detection probability.

steps.title: Geiger 觸發：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「單像素飽和脈衝不直接量出同時光子數」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: A saturated pixel pulse does not directly count simultaneous photons.
steps.instruction: 畫超額偏壓與雪崩觸發後的脈衝，分離光子數和脈衝幅度。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw excess bias and triggered pulses and separate photon count from pulse height. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 單像素飽和脈衝不直接量出同時光子數；多像素數可擴展陣列動態範圍。
steps.observationEn: A saturated pixel pulse does not directly count simultaneous photons; More microcells can extend array dynamic range.
steps.failure: 若採用「用單一雪崩脈衝高度精確判斷入射光子數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Inferring exact photon number from one avalanche height", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「Geiger 觸發」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：單像素飽和脈衝不直接量出同時光子數。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Geiger triggering diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: A saturated pixel pulse does not directly count simultaneous photons.

steps.title: 直接飛行時間：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Direct time of flight: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「往返飛行時間須除以二」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Round-trip flight time requires a factor of two.
steps.instruction:
用 d=cΔt/2 算假設距離並扣除電子延遲。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設直接 ToF 系統已扣除電子延遲，測得往返時間 10 ns，取 c=3×10⁸ m/s，距離 d=ct/2=1.5 m。若時間誤差為 1 ns，對應距離誤差幅度 0.15 m。未處理多重路徑、光子統計及介質折射率；不可省略往返的二分之一。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute hypothetical d=cΔt/2 after subtracting electronic delay. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a direct-ToF system has removed electronic delay and measures a 10 ns round trip. With c=3×10⁸ m/s, d=ct/2=1.5 m. A 1 ns timing-error magnitude corresponds to 0.15 m. Multipath, photon statistics and medium refractive index are excluded; the round-trip factor of one-half is essential.
steps.observation: 往返飛行時間須除以二；多重反射會產生多個距離峰。
steps.observationEn: Round-trip flight time requires a factor of two; Multipath produces multiple range peaks.
steps.failure: 若採用「直接用 cΔt 作為單程距離」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

提交「直接飛行時間」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：往返飛行時間須除以二。
算例驗收：驗算 1.5 m 與 0.15 m，畫出發射及返回兩段光路。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Direct time of flight diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Round-trip flight time requires a factor of two.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 1.5 m and 0.15 m and draw the outgoing and returning optical paths.

title: 碳化矽磊晶與缺陷控制
summary: 從多型與基板、穿通差排到磊晶放行：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Polytype and substrate and Threading dislocations to Epitaxy release: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 厚度均勻度：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「一個中心點無法代表全片漂移層」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: One center point cannot represent the whole drift layer.
steps.instruction:
建立徑向厚度圖並分開片內與片間偏差。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設三個外延厚度測點為 99、100、101 µm，平均 100 µm、極差 2 µm。若僅描述這三點、使用母體定義，標準差 sqrt(2/3)=0.8165 µm，變異係數 0.8165%；若作樣本估計則標準差為 1 µm。必須寫明分母，且三點不能推論整片缺陷密度。
steps.instructionEn:
Map radial thickness and separate within-wafer from wafer-to-wafer variation. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume three epitaxial thickness readings of 99, 100 and 101 µm. Mean is 100 µm and range 2 µm. Describing just these points with the population definition gives standard deviation sqrt(2/3)=0.8165 µm and CV=0.8165%; the sample estimate instead gives 1 µm. State the denominator; three sites cannot establish wafer-wide defect density.
steps.observation: 一個中心點無法代表全片漂移層；厚度與摻雜分布可能相互相關。
steps.observationEn: One center point cannot represent the whole drift layer; Thickness and doping variations may correlate.
steps.failure: 若採用「中心厚度合格就代表全片耐壓一致」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

提交「厚度均勻度」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：一個中心點無法代表全片漂移層。
算例驗收：驗算平均、極差及兩種標準差，並在圖上註明取樣位置不足的限制。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Thickness uniformity diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: One center point cannot represent the whole drift layer.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify mean, range and both standard-deviation definitions and mark the sampling limitation on the map.

knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「每顆缺陷都以同一方式殺死所有晶粒」與「缺陷風險取決於位置與元件敏感度」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Assuming every defect kills every die equally" is not equivalent to "Defect risk depends on location and device sensitivity"; the control must expose their difference.

quiz.question: 檢查「晶粒接受區」時，哪個新增因素應納入？
quiz.questionEn: Which additional factor belongs in a check of Die acceptance regions?
options: 元件終端區也可能對缺陷敏感
每顆缺陷都以同一方式殺死所有晶粒
只選缺陷密度最低批次而忽略其他規格
optionsEn: Device termination can also be defect-sensitive
Assuming every defect kills every die equally
Selecting minimum defect density while ignoring other requirements
quiz.explanation: 元件終端區也可能對缺陷敏感；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Device termination can also be defect-sensitive. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 磊晶放行：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「磊晶放行須連到後續元件需求」。

steps.instruction: 整合厚度、摻雜、缺陷、粗糙與基板追溯表。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Combine thickness, doping, defects, roughness and substrate traceability. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 磊晶放行須連到後續元件需求；放行規格應固定所用缺陷定義。
steps.observationEn: Epitaxy release must connect to downstream device needs; Release specifications need fixed defect definitions.
steps.failure: 若採用「只選缺陷密度最低批次而忽略其他規格」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Selecting minimum defect density while ignoring other requirements", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「磊晶放行」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：磊晶放行須連到後續元件需求。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Epitaxy release diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Epitaxy release must connect to downstream device needs.

steps.title: 磊晶放行：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只選缺陷密度最低批次而忽略其他規格」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Selecting minimum defect density while ignoring other requirements.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「磊晶放行」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只選缺陷密度最低批次而忽略其他規格」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：放行規格應固定所用缺陷定義。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Epitaxy release artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Selecting minimum defect density while ignoring other requirements". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Release specifications need fixed defect definitions. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 磊晶放行須連到後續元件需求；放行規格應固定所用缺陷定義。

steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Epitaxy release, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Release specifications need fixed defect definitions" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

title: 碳化矽 MOSFET 製程
summary: 從垂直元件路徑、植入與活化到晶片到模組：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Vertical device path and Implantation and activation to Die-to-module validation: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Vertical device path, Blocking design, Channel interface.

steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「垂直 MOSFET 的電阻由多區域組成」。

steps.instructionEn: Draw source, channel, drift region and backside drain and trace conduction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 垂直 MOSFET 的電阻由多區域組成；封裝引線也貢獻量到的電阻。
steps.observationEn: Vertical MOSFET resistance has multiple regional contributions; Package leads contribute measured resistance.
steps.failure: 若採用「把全部導通電阻都歸給通道」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Attributing all on-resistance to the channel", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「垂直元件路徑」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：垂直 MOSFET 的電阻由多區域組成。

steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「低 RDS(on) 不保證最低總損耗」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Low on-resistance does not guarantee minimum total loss.
steps.instruction:
以假設 V(t)I(t) 積分比較切換損耗與導通損耗。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設功率開關在特定溫度的 RDS(on)=10 mΩ，導通電流 10 A、占空比先設為 100%，導通損耗 I²R=1 W。若熱態電阻加倍，損耗為 2 W。這不含切換、閘極驅動或反向恢復損耗；若占空比為 50% 且電流維持矩形 10 A，平均導通損耗才各減半。另假設每周期切換能量 Eon+Eoff=10 µJ、頻率 100 kHz，切換功率為 1 W，冷態 50% 導通加切換合計 1.5 W，仍未含驅動損耗。
steps.instructionEn:
Integrate hypothetical V(t)I(t) and compare switching/conduction losses. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a power switch has RDS(on)=10 mΩ at a specified temperature and conducts 10 A continuously: I²R=1 W. Doubling hot-state resistance gives 2 W. Switching, gate-drive and reverse-recovery losses are excluded. At 50% duty with rectangular 10 A current, average conduction loss halves in each case. Also assume switching energy Eon+Eoff=10 µJ per cycle at 100 kHz: switching power is 1 W, so the cold 50%-duty conduction-plus-switching total is 1.5 W, still excluding drive losses.
steps.observation: 低 RDS(on) 不保證最低總損耗；電壓電流探棒時間偏移會誤算能量。
steps.observationEn: Low on-resistance does not guarantee minimum total loss; Probe timing mismatch biases switching energy.
steps.failure: 若採用「只按室溫導通電阻選最高頻方案」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

算例驗收：驗算連續導通 1 W、熱態 2 W、50% 占空比下 0.5/1 W 及冷態含切換的 1.5 W，勿用平均電流直接平方取代 RMS。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Dynamic losses diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Low on-resistance does not guarantee minimum total loss.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 1 W continuous, 2 W hot, 0.5/1 W at 50% duty and the cold 1.5 W total including switching; do not square average current instead of using RMS current.

summary: 從異質接面、緩衝層到整合驗證：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Heterojunction and Buffer layer to Integration verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 異質接面 → 常開與常關
stages.description: 把「異質接面」「極化電荷」「常開與常關」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Heterojunction, Polarization charge, Normally on/off.

steps.title: 異質接面：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer.
steps.instruction: 畫 AlGaN/GaN 與能帶井，定位二維電子氣。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw AlGaN/GaN and its band well and locate the 2DEG. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層；界面粗糙會影響通道散射。
steps.observationEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer; Interface roughness affects channel scattering.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「異質接面」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Heterojunction diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer.

knowledge.title: 異質接面／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer.

knowledge.title: 異質接面／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping.

quiz.question: 關於「異質接面」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Heterojunction, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層
把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜
將固定極化電荷當成直接流動電流
optionsEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer
Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping
Treating fixed polarization charge as current-carrying particles
quiz.explanation: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 異質接面：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「異質接面」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：界面粗糙會影響通道散射。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Heterojunction artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Interface roughness affects channel scattering. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層；界面粗糙會影響通道散射。
steps.observationEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer; Interface roughness affects channel scattering.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「異質接面」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「界面粗糙會影響通道散射」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Heterojunction, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Interface roughness affects channel scattering" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 異質接面／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：界面粗糙會影響通道散射。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Interface roughness affects channel scattering.

knowledge.title: 異質接面／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」與「異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。

steps.title: p-GaN 與凹槽：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: p-GaN and recessed gates: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「對所有 GaN 共用同一閘極電壓規格」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Using one gate-voltage limit for all GaN types.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「p-GaN 與凹槽」成果，先指出錯誤主張「對所有 GaN 共用同一閘極電壓規格」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：凹槽蝕刻損傷可能增加陷阱。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding p-GaN and recessed gates artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Using one gate-voltage limit for all GaN types". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Recess etch damage can add traps. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 不同常關架構有不同閘極容限；凹槽蝕刻損傷可能增加陷阱。
steps.observationEn: Normally-off architectures have different gate tolerances; Recess etch damage can add traps.
steps.failure: 若採用「對所有 GaN 共用同一閘極電壓規格」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Using one gate-voltage limit for all GaN types", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「p-GaN 與凹槽」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「凹槽蝕刻損傷可能增加陷阱」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for p-GaN and recessed gates, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Recess etch damage can add traps" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

steps.title: 歐姆接觸：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「接觸電阻影響導通和 RF 性能」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Contact resistance affects conduction and RF performance.
steps.instruction:
以假設 TLM 資料分離接觸電阻和接觸間通道電阻。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設線性 TLM 回歸 Rtotal(L) 的零距離截距為 0.4 Ω，兩端接觸相同且寄生已扣除，截距=2Rc，所以每個接觸 Rc=0.2 Ω。未給接觸寬度，不能報成 Ω·mm；若 I-V 非線性或兩接觸不同，此抽取就需修改。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate contact and channel resistance with hypothetical TLM data. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a linear TLM fit Rtotal(L) has a zero-spacing intercept of 0.4 Ω, with identical contacts and parasitics removed. The intercept is 2Rc, giving Rc=0.2 Ω per contact. Without width, do not report Ω·mm; nonlinear I-V or unequal contacts invalidates the simple extraction.
steps.observation: 接觸電阻影響導通和 RF 性能；接觸正規化需註明單位寬度。
steps.observationEn: Contact resistance affects conduction and RF performance; Contact normalization needs width conventions.
steps.failure: 若採用「只提高通道遷移率就消除所有串聯損失」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Eliminating all series loss by increasing mobility alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「歐姆接觸」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：接觸電阻影響導通和 RF 性能。
算例驗收：驗算 0.2 Ω，區分總截距、單接觸電阻與寬度歸一化電阻。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Ohmic contacts diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Contact resistance affects conduction and RF performance.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 0.2 Ω and distinguish total intercept, single-contact resistance and width-normalized resistance.

steps.title: 熱路徑：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「高臨界電場不代表容易散熱」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: High critical field does not imply easy heat removal.
steps.instruction: 畫通道熱點經基板、界面到散熱器的路徑。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Trace channel hotspots through substrate/interfaces to a heat sink. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 高臨界電場不代表容易散熱；熱界面電阻可能主導局部溫升。
steps.observationEn: High critical field does not imply easy heat removal; Thermal-interface resistance may dominate heating.
steps.failure: 若採用「只看材料能隙就決定可容許功率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Determining allowable power from bandgap alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「熱路徑」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：高臨界電場不代表容易散熱。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Thermal paths diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: High critical field does not imply easy heat removal.

steps.title: 熱路徑：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只看材料能隙就決定可容許功率」這項錯誤主張。

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Thermal paths artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Determining allowable power from bandgap alone". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Thermal-interface resistance may dominate heating. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 高臨界電場不代表容易散熱；熱界面電阻可能主導局部溫升。

steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Thermal paths, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Thermal-interface resistance may dominate heating" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

title: 氮化鎵發光二極體磊晶
summary: 從直接能隙、組成與波長到磊晶驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Direct bandgap and Composition and wavelength to Epitaxy acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

title: 砷化鎵射頻元件製作
summary: 從HBT 與 pHEMT、閘長與寄生到技術選擇：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From HBT versus pHEMT and Gate length and parasitics to Technology selection: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 通道片電荷：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Channel sheet charge: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「片密度與體密度單位不同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Sheet and volume density have different units.
steps.instruction:
分開片密度、遷移率與片電阻，做假設單位換算。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設單一載子通道的面密度 ns=10¹² cm⁻²、遷移率 μ=5,000 cm²/(V·s)，q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C。片電阻 Rs=1/(qnsμ)≈1,248.4 Ω/□。此式忽略平行通道及接觸電阻；不能直接當成整顆射頻元件導通電阻。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate sheet density, mobility and resistance with unit checks. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a single-carrier channel with sheet density ns=10¹² cm⁻² and mobility μ=5,000 cm²/(V·s), using q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C. Sheet resistance Rs=1/(qnsμ)≈1,248.4 Ω/square. Parallel channels and contact resistance are excluded; this is not whole-device RF on-resistance.
steps.observation: 片密度與體密度單位不同；Hall 量測也需要幾何校正。
steps.observationEn: Sheet and volume density have different units; Hall measurements need geometry corrections.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 cm^-2 直接當成 cm^-3」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating cm^-2 as cm^-3", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「通道片電荷」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：片密度與體密度單位不同。
算例驗收：驗算約 1.25 kΩ/□，保留面密度單位，勿把 cm⁻² 當成 cm⁻³。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Channel sheet charge diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Sheet and volume density have different units.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify approximately 1.25 kΩ/square and keep sheet-density units distinct from volume density.

steps.title: 隔離與漏電：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Isolation and leakage: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage.
steps.instruction: 畫元件間半絕緣基板及表面路徑，列出關斷量測。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw substrate/surface isolation paths and specify off-state tests. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電；隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性。
steps.observationEn: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage; Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage.
steps.failure: 若採用「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「隔離與漏電」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Isolation and leakage diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage.

knowledge.title: 隔離與漏電／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Isolation and leakage / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 機制：半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage.

knowledge.title: 隔離與漏電／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Isolation and leakage / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label.

quiz.question: 關於「隔離與漏電」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Isolation and leakage, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電
只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試
未校正線纜便把總量測當裸晶
optionsEn: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage
Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label
Treating uncalibrated cable response as bare-die data
quiz.explanation: 半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 隔離與漏電：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Isolation and leakage: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「隔離與漏電」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Isolation and leakage artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電；隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性。
steps.observationEn: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage; Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage.
steps.failure: 若採用「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「隔離與漏電」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Isolation and leakage, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 隔離與漏電／物理與模型

knowledge.text: 診斷機制：隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage.

knowledge.title: 隔離與漏電／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Isolation and leakage / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」與「半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label" is not equivalent to "A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.observation: S 參數必須附頻率、偏壓和參考阻抗；校正後漂移仍可能產生誤差。
steps.observationEn: S-parameters require frequency, bias and reference impedance; Drift after calibration still introduces error.
steps.failure: 若採用「未校正線纜便把總量測當裸晶」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating uncalibrated cable response as bare-die data", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「S 參數」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：S 參數必須附頻率、偏壓和參考阻抗。
steps.checkEn: Submit the S-parameters diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: S-parameters require frequency, bias and reference impedance.

title: 氧化鎵功率元件研究
summary: 從材料潛力與實現、橫向與垂直到研究成熟度：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Material potential versus realization and Lateral versus vertical to Research maturity: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:

steps.instructionEn:
Build a hypothetical thermal network separating electrical loss and conduction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a steady lumped thermal model with P=2 W, junction-to-ambient Rθ=20 K/W and ambient 25°C. ΔT=PRθ=40 K gives 65°C junction temperature. At 30 K/W the estimate is 85°C. These are not gallium-oxide product ratings; thermal capacitance, nonuniform hotspots and temperature dependence are excluded.
steps.observation: 低電性損失不保證低接面溫度；熱導率要連同晶向和溫度記錄。

提交「自熱侷限」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：低電性損失不保證低接面溫度。
算例驗收：驗算 65°C 與 85°C，說明 K 的溫升可以加到 °C，但熱阻的路徑必須相同。

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Research maturity artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Equating a new structure announcement with reliable products". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Long-term reliability requires models and statistics. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.

title: 二維半導體轉移與接觸
summary: 從單層與晶粒、轉移殘留到晶圓可製造性：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Monolayer and grains and Transfer residue to Wafer manufacturability: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 接觸抽取：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias.
steps.instruction:
用假設不同通道長度 TLM 比較接觸截距與片電阻。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設二維材料元件的 TLM 資料符合線性 Rtotal(L)，截距 2 kΩ，且兩接觸相同，則每個接觸為 1 kΩ。若某長度的量測總阻為 5 kΩ，模型歸於通道的部分為 3 kΩ。此分解依賴接觸與通道一致性，不適用於任意非線性注入曲線。
steps.instructionEn:
Use hypothetical channel-length TLM to separate intercept and sheet resistance. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a 2D-device TLM dataset follows linear Rtotal(L) with intercept 2 kΩ and identical contacts: each contact is 1 kΩ. If total resistance at one spacing is 5 kΩ, the model assigns 3 kΩ to the channel. This decomposition assumes contact/channel consistency and does not apply to arbitrary nonlinear injection curves.
steps.observation: 長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓；尺寸縮放使接觸占比上升。
steps.observationEn: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias; Scaling increases the contact contribution.
steps.failure: 若採用「混合不同載子密度樣本直接回歸」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Regressing samples with mixed carrier densities", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「接觸抽取」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓。
算例驗收：驗算每接觸 1 kΩ 與通道 3 kΩ；若負截距出現，先檢查模型而非宣稱負接觸電阻。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Contact extraction diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 1 kΩ per contact and 3 kΩ channel resistance; investigate a negative intercept instead of claiming negative contact resistance.

title: 微機電慣性感測器製程
summary: 從質量彈簧、深矽輪廓到溫漂校正：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Mass and spring and Deep-silicon profile to Temperature calibration: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.description: 把「質量彈簧」「差動梳齒」「共振與阻尼」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Mass and spring, Differential combs, Resonance and damping.

steps.title: 質量彈簧：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Mass and spring: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Static approximation needs operation below resonance.
steps.instruction:
用假設 m、k 畫 F=ma 與 x=ma/k 靜態關係。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設準靜態加速度計質量 m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg、彈簧 k=1 N/m、加速度 a=9.81 m/s²，力 F=ma=9.81 nN，位移 x=F/k=9.81 nm。加速度加倍時位移加倍，但此例忽略阻尼、共振與非線性止擋，不能外推到衝擊量程。
steps.instructionEn:
Use hypothetical mass/stiffness to draw F=ma and x=ma/k. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a quasistatic accelerometer mass m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg, spring constant k=1 N/m and acceleration a=9.81 m/s². F=ma=9.81 nN and x=F/k=9.81 nm. Doubling acceleration doubles displacement in this model. Damping, resonance and nonlinear stops are absent, so do not infer shock range.
steps.observation: 靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件；動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項。
steps.observationEn: Static approximation needs operation below resonance; Dynamics also include damping and inertia.
steps.failure: 若採用「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Applying static displacement at every frequency", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「質量彈簧」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件。
算例驗收：驗算 9.81 nN 與 9.81 nm，確認 µg 到 kg 的轉換是 10⁻⁹。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Mass and spring diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Static approximation needs operation below resonance.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 9.81 nN and 9.81 nm and confirm the 10⁻⁹ conversion from micrograms to kilograms.

knowledge.title: 質量彈簧／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Mass and spring / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」。
假設數值與推算：假設準靜態加速度計質量 m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg、彈簧 k=1 N/m、加速度 a=9.81 m/s²，力 F=ma=9.81 nN，位移 x=F/k=9.81 nm。加速度加倍時位移加倍，但此例忽略阻尼、共振與非線性止擋，不能外推到衝擊量程。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Applying static displacement at every frequency.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume a quasistatic accelerometer mass m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg, spring constant k=1 N/m and acceleration a=9.81 m/s². F=ma=9.81 nN and x=F/k=9.81 nm. Doubling acceleration doubles displacement in this model. Damping, resonance and nonlinear stops are absent, so do not infer shock range.

quiz.question: 關於「質量彈簧」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Mass and spring, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件
把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率
差動架構自動消除全部偏差
optionsEn: Static approximation needs operation below resonance
Applying static displacement at every frequency
Assuming differential geometry removes every bias
quiz.explanation: 靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Static approximation needs operation below resonance. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 質量彈簧：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mass and spring: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Applying static displacement at every frequency.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「質量彈簧」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Mass and spring artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Applying static displacement at every frequency". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Dynamics also include damping and inertia. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件；動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項。
steps.observationEn: Static approximation needs operation below resonance; Dynamics also include damping and inertia.
steps.failure: 若採用「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Applying static displacement at every frequency", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「質量彈簧」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Mass and spring, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Dynamics also include damping and inertia" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

title: 微機電壓力感測器製程
summary: 從壓力定義、電容讀出到氣壓與高度：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Pressure definition and Capacitive readout to Pressure and altitude: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 電容讀出：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「小間隙提高靈敏度但限制行程」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Small gaps improve sensitivity but limit travel.
steps.instruction:
畫膜片和固定電極，分開位移及邊緣寄生電容。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設理想空氣平板電容 A=1 mm²、間隙 g=10 µm，C=ε0A/g=0.8854 pF；膜片位移使間隙變 9 µm，C≈0.9838 pF。電容增加約 11.11%，並非正好 10%。例中忽略邊緣場、膜片非均勻變形與靜電拉入，不能由此直接回推壓力。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw moving/fixed electrodes and separate displacement from parasitics. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume an ideal air parallel-plate capacitor with A=1 mm² and gap g=10 µm: C=ε0A/g=0.8854 pF. Reducing the gap to 9 µm gives approximately 0.9838 pF, an 11.11% increase rather than exactly 10%. Fringing, nonuniform deflection and electrostatic pull-in are absent; capacitance alone does not give pressure.
steps.observation: 小間隙提高靈敏度但限制行程；拉入不穩定限制電容偏壓。
steps.observationEn: Small gaps improve sensitivity but limit travel; Pull-in instability limits capacitive bias.

算例驗收：驗算兩個電容與 11.11% 變化，註明仍缺少壓力到位移的機械模型。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Capacitive readout diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Small gaps improve sensitivity but limit travel.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both capacitances and the 11.11% change and identify the missing pressure-to-deflection model.

title: 薄膜電晶體顯示背板
summary: 從像素開關、閘介面到面板驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Pixel switching and Gate interface to Panel acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for IGZO chemistry, Gate interface, Hydrogen and passivation.

steps.title: IGZO 化學：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything.
steps.instruction: 畫氧相關缺陷和載流子，分開導通與關斷需求。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw oxygen-related defects/carriers and separate on/off needs. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善；氧含量變動也會改變穩定性。
steps.observationEn: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything; Oxygen variation also changes stability.
steps.failure: 若採用「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「IGZO 化學」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善。
steps.checkEn: Submit the IGZO chemistry diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything.

knowledge.title: IGZO 化學／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything.

knowledge.title: IGZO 化學／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs.

quiz.question: 關於「IGZO 化學」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For IGZO chemistry, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善
通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好
只測膜厚就證明閘介面品質
optionsEn: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything
Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs
Proving gate-interface quality from thickness alone
quiz.explanation: 載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: IGZO 化學：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「IGZO 化學」成果，先指出錯誤主張「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：氧含量變動也會改變穩定性。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding IGZO chemistry artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Oxygen variation also changes stability. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善；氧含量變動也會改變穩定性。
steps.observationEn: Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything; Oxygen variation also changes stability.
steps.failure: 若採用「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「IGZO 化學」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「氧含量變動也會改變穩定性」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for IGZO chemistry, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Oxygen variation also changes stability" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: IGZO 化學／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：氧含量變動也會改變穩定性。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Oxygen variation also changes stability.

knowledge.title: IGZO 化學／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「通道越導電就代表 TFT 越好」與「載子過多可能提高漏電而非全面改善」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Assuming more conductive channels always make better TFTs" is not equivalent to "Excess carriers can increase leakage rather than improve everything"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.instructionEn: Draw dielectric traps/channel and predict subthreshold/hysteresis effects. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 介面品質影響開關陡峭度與穩定；介面電容需和有效閘電容區分。
steps.observationEn: Interface quality affects switching and stability; Distinguish interface response from effective gate capacitance.
steps.failure: 若採用「只測膜厚就證明閘介面品質」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

steps.check: 提交「閘介面」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：介面品質影響開關陡峭度與穩定。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Gate interface diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Interface quality affects switching and stability.

steps.title: 保持與漏電：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Hold and leakage: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「低刷新率會放大保持需求」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Low refresh rates increase hold requirements.
steps.instruction:
用假設電容和漏電估算一幀內的像素電壓下降。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設顯示像素保持電容 1 pF、固定漏電 1 pA、保持時間 16 ms，電壓衰減幅度 ΔV=IΔt/C=0.016 V=16 mV。漏電加倍則為 32 mV。這只是假設定值漏電的儲存節點模型，不是 IGZO 面板規格；光照、偏壓應力與寄生耦合另需驗證。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate pixel voltage loss over a frame from hypothetical capacitance/leakage. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a display-pixel storage capacitance of 1 pF, constant leakage of 1 pA and hold time of 16 ms. Voltage-loss magnitude ΔV=IΔt/C=0.016 V=16 mV; doubling leakage gives 32 mV. This constant-leakage model is not an IGZO-panel specification; illumination, bias stress and parasitic coupling need separate evaluation.
steps.observation: 低刷新率會放大保持需求；儲存電容也占用像素面積。
steps.observationEn: Low refresh rates increase hold requirements; Storage capacitors consume pixel area.
steps.failure: 若採用「刷新變慢便可忽略關斷漏電」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Ignoring off leakage at slower refresh", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「保持與漏電」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：低刷新率會放大保持需求。
算例驗收：驗算 16 mV 並保留 ms 到 s 的轉換；說明若漏電隨時間變化需以積分取代常數乘法。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Hold and leakage diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Low refresh rates increase hold requirements.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 16 mV and the millisecond-to-second conversion; explain that time-varying leakage requires integration.

title: 晶圓臨界尺寸電子顯微量測
summary: 從灰階到邊緣、電子劑量到尺寸報告：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Grayscale to edge and Electron dose to Dimension report: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 像素校正：建立模型

steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設校正標準的 100 nm 節距在影像上占 40 pixel，比例為 2.5 nm/pixel；量得線寬 20 pixel，名目 CD=50 nm。若線寬抽取本身的不確定度為 1 pixel，單此項即 2.5 nm，尚未合併校正與邊緣模型誤差；不能把像素尺寸當成完整準確度。
steps.instructionEn:
Calibrate nm/pixel with a hypothetical pitch standard and uncertainty. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a calibrated 100 nm pitch spans 40 pixels, giving 2.5 nm/pixel. A 20-pixel width has nominal CD=50 nm. If width extraction alone has 1-pixel uncertainty, that contribution is 2.5 nm before calibration and edge-model errors are combined. Pixel scale is not complete accuracy.

steps.observationEn: Magnification does not automatically improve scale accuracy; Reference standards themselves have uncertainty.

steps.check:
