算例驗收：驗算 2.5 nm/pixel、50 nm 與 2.5 nm 誤差項，寫清 1 pixel 指線寬而不是每一側邊緣。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Pixel calibration diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Magnification does not automatically improve scale accuracy.

steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只報一個奈米數而省略量測定義」這項錯誤主張。

steps.instruction: 接續前一步「尺寸報告」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只報一個奈米數而省略量測定義」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：溯源鏈應連到長度標準。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Dimension report artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Reporting one nanometer number without its definition". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Traceability should connect to length standards. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 可比較的 CD 需要完整量測條件；溯源鏈應連到長度標準。

steps.check: 交出「尺寸報告」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「溯源鏈應連到長度標準」如何改變前一步的判讀。

title: 光學散射量測
summary: 從週期標靶、偏振和角度到製程回授：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Periodic targets and Polarization and angle to Process feedback: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 週期標靶 → RCWA 假設

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Periodic targets, Forward and inverse, RCWA assumptions.

steps.title: 週期標靶：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「散射反演需要明確幾何參數化」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Scatter inversion needs explicit geometry parameterization.
steps.instruction:
畫光柵節距、線寬、高度與側壁角的參數圖。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設對稱梯形線條高 100 nm、頂寬 40 nm、底寬 60 nm，每側水平差為 (60−40)/2=10 nm。相對水平面的側壁角 atan(100/10)≈84.29°；相對垂直面的傾斜約 5.71°。這是已知幾何的計算，不能證明光學反演已唯一決定此形貌。
steps.instructionEn:
Parameterize grating pitch, width, height and sidewall angle. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a symmetric trapezoidal line 100 nm high, 40 nm wide at top and 60 nm at bottom. Each side shifts horizontally by 10 nm. Sidewall angle from horizontal is atan(100/10)≈84.29°, or 5.71° from vertical. This computes known geometry; it does not prove a unique optical inverse solution.
steps.observation: 散射反演需要明確幾何參數化；節距可固定但須有獨立依據。
steps.observationEn: Scatter inversion needs explicit geometry parameterization; Fixing pitch needs independent evidence.
steps.failure: 若採用「不定義形狀便宣稱光譜能直接讀出線寬」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Reading CD directly from spectra without geometry assumptions", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「週期標靶」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：散射反演需要明確幾何參數化。
算例驗收：驗算兩種角度並在截面上標明參考方向，避免將 84.29° 與 5.71° 誤認互相矛盾。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Periodic targets diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Scatter inversion needs explicit geometry parameterization.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both angles and mark reference directions so 84.29° and 5.71° are not mistaken for contradictory results.

title: 晶圓薄膜橢圓偏光量測
summary: 從p/s 偏振、厚度與 n到報告與限制：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From p/s polarization and Thickness-index coupling to Report and limits: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設正入射且 n=1.5、厚度 t=100 nm，單程光學路徑 nt=150 nm、往返 300 nm。另一假設薄膜 n=2、t=75 nm 也有同樣 nt。這說明 n 與 t 可能耦合，但不表示兩者的完整橢圓偏光譜相同；Fresnel 振幅、色散與吸收仍有差異。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw surface/interior paths and phase differences. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume normal incidence with n=1.5 and thickness t=100 nm: one-way optical path nt=150 nm and round trip 300 nm. A different hypothetical film with n=2 and t=75 nm has the same nt. This illustrates n–t coupling, not identical full ellipsometric spectra; Fresnel amplitudes, dispersion and absorption can differ.
steps.observation: 光程同時包含厚度及折射率；界面粗糙會改變有效反射。
steps.observationEn: Optical path includes thickness and refractive index; Rough interfaces modify effective reflection.

算例驗收：驗算兩組 nt，並列出至少一項可以幫助區分 n 與 t 的額外光學觀察。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Thin-film interference diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Optical path includes thickness and refractive index.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both nt products and name an additional optical observation that could help separate n and t.

steps.instructionEn: Trace backside reflection and compare suppressed/unsuppressed data. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

steps.failure: 若採用「所有多重反射都一定來自目標薄膜」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Attributing every extra reflection to the target film", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「背面反射」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：基板背反射可污染前表面模型。

steps.title: 背面反射：故障判讀與驗證

steps.title: 報告與限制：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Report and limits: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「省略模型仍可把厚度當直接量尺讀值」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Presenting model-free thickness as a direct ruler reading.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「報告與限制」成果，先指出錯誤主張「省略模型仍可把厚度當直接量尺讀值」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：參數信賴區間應包含模型限制。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Report and limits artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Presenting model-free thickness as a direct ruler reading". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Confidence reporting should include model limitations. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 厚度結果是條件化的模型推論；參數信賴區間應包含模型限制。
steps.observationEn: Thickness is a model-conditioned inference; Confidence reporting should include model limitations.
steps.failure: 若採用「省略模型仍可把厚度當直接量尺讀值」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Presenting model-free thickness as a direct ruler reading", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「報告與限制」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「參數信賴區間應包含模型限制」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Report and limits, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Confidence reporting should include model limitations" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

title: 晶圓缺陷分類與良率分析
titleEn: Wafer defect classification and yield analysis
summary: 從缺陷單位、混淆矩陣到改善驗證：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Defect units and Confusion matrix to Improvement verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Defect units, Coordinate registration, Detection threshold.

steps.title: 缺陷單位：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷」。

steps.instructionEn: Separate image detections, physical defects and failed dies. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷；同一缺陷可能在多層被重複觀察。
steps.observationEn: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects; One defect may appear on several layers.
steps.failure: 若採用「把檢出事件數直接當失效晶粒數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating detection count with failed-die count", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「缺陷單位」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Defect units diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects.

steps.title: 良率模型：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「Poisson 良率近似依賴獨立均勻假設」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Poisson yield depends on independent uniform defects.
steps.instruction:
用假設隨機獨立缺陷比較 Y=exp(-AD0) 與聚集情況。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設致命缺陷為空間獨立均勻 Poisson 過程，晶粒面積 A=1 cm²、缺陷密度 D0=0.1 cm⁻²，零缺陷良率 Y=exp(−AD0)=exp(−0.1)≈90.48%。面積加倍時 Y≈81.87%。聚集缺陷、冗餘修復與參數失效不在模型內，不能當實廠良率預測。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare hypothetical Poisson yield with clustered defects. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume spatially independent uniform Poisson killer defects with die area A=1 cm² and density D0=0.1 cm⁻². Zero-defect yield Y=exp(−AD0)=exp(−0.1)≈90.48%; doubling area gives 81.87%. Clustering, repair redundancy and parametric failures are excluded; this is not a fab-yield prediction.
steps.observation: Poisson 良率近似依賴獨立均勻假設；聚集模型可能較符合某些缺陷族群。
steps.observationEn: Poisson yield depends on independent uniform defects; Cluster models can suit some defect populations.
steps.failure: 若採用「任意聚集分布都用同一密度精確預測」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

提交「良率模型」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：Poisson 良率近似依賴獨立均勻假設。
算例驗收：驗算兩個良率，確認 AD0 無單位，並說明良率並非隨面積線性下降。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Yield model diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Poisson yield depends on independent uniform defects.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both yields, confirm dimensionless AD0 and explain why yield does not decrease linearly with area.

title: 製程統計管制系統
summary: 從規格與控制、Xbar 與 R到變更管理：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Specifications and control and Xbar and range to Change management: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設穩定且近似常態的製程，規格 LSL=95、USL=105，平均 μ=101、組內標準差 σ=1（使用同一單位）。Cp=(105−95)/(6σ)=1.667；Cpk=min((105−101)/(3σ),(101−95)/(3σ))=1.333。此組假設尚未由資料驗證，控制界限也不等於 95/105 規格界限。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute hypothetical Cp/Cpk after checking stability and distribution. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a stable approximately normal process with LSL=95, USL=105, mean μ=101 and within-process σ=1 in common units. Cp=10/(6σ)=1.667; Cpk=min(4/(3σ),6/(3σ))=1.333. These assumptions still need data support; control limits are not the 95/105 specification limits.
steps.observation: 能力指標需要適用假設與穩定條件；非正態資料需要合適分布處理。
steps.observationEn: Capability requires suitable assumptions and stability; Nonnormal data need suitable distribution handling.

算例驗收：驗算 Cp 與 Cpk，指出偏離規格中心使 Cpk 低於 Cp，並保留穩定性驗證步驟。

Worked-example acceptance: Verify Cp and Cpk, explain the reduction from off-centering and retain a process-stability check.

title: 先進製程控制與虛擬量測
titleEn: Advanced process control and virtual metrology
summary: 從閉迴路邊界、時間切割到版本回復：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Closed-loop boundary and Temporal splitting to Version rollback: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: Run-to-run 控制：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「控制更新有延遲且需要製程增益方向」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Updates have delay and need the correct gain sign.
steps.instruction:
用假設線性增益將上一片誤差換成下一片小幅修正。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設無延遲、無雜訊的教學模型 y=2u+1，現在 u=4 得 y=9，目標 y*=11。以模型反算 Δu=(11−9)/2=1，故下次 u=5、預測 y=11。若真實斜率不是 2 或量測有延遲，這次修正可能過度；這是紙上控制練習，不能作機台指令。
steps.instructionEn:
Convert prior-wafer error to a bounded next-run correction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a delay-free noise-free teaching model y=2u+1. Current u=4 gives y=9; target y*=11. Model inversion gives Δu=(11−9)/2=1, so next u=5 predicts y=11. A different real slope or delayed measurement can cause overcorrection. This is a paper control exercise, not a machine command.
steps.observation: 控制更新有延遲且需要製程增益方向；增益估計錯誤可放大振盪。
steps.observationEn: Updates have delay and need the correct gain sign; Gain-estimation errors can amplify oscillation.
steps.failure: 若採用「不知增益正負就直接反覆加大修正」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

steps.check:
提交「Run-to-run 控制」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：控制更新有延遲且需要製程增益方向。
算例驗收：驗算 u=5，並以斜率改為 3 的另一假設檢查模型失配為何改變控制增益。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Run-to-run control diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Updates have delay and need the correct gain sign.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify u=5 and use an alternative slope of 3 to explain why model mismatch changes the required control gain.

title: 晶圓級參數測試
summary: 從SMU 四象限、量測等待到判限與重測：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From SMU quadrants and Settling time to Limits and retest: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instruction:
分開 force 和 sense 線，指出感測輸入電流近似。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設 DUT=100 Ω、兩條 force 引線各 2 Ω，輸入 1 mA。二線總壓降為 104 mV，反算 104 Ω；理想四線 Kelvin 的 sense 電流可忽略，僅量 DUT 100 mV，得 100 Ω。接點位於哪裡仍決定是否包含接觸電阻，四線並不自動消除所有誤差。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate force/sense and state the low-sense-current assumption. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a 100 Ω DUT, two 2 Ω force leads and 1 mA. A two-wire measurement reads 104 mV and infers 104 Ω; ideal four-wire Kelvin sensing with negligible sense current reads 100 mV across the DUT, giving 100 Ω. Sense-contact placement determines whether contact resistance is included; four-wire does not remove every error.
steps.observation: Kelvin 可降低引線壓降但不能取消所有誤差；Sense 接觸開路仍會破壞量測。
steps.observationEn: Kelvin reduces lead drop but not every error; An open sense contact still breaks measurement.

算例驗收：驗算 104 與 100 Ω，畫出 force/sense 接點與電壓量測邊界。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Four-wire Kelvin diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Kelvin reduces lead drop but not every error.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 104 and 100 Ω and draw force/sense contacts and the voltage-measurement boundary.

title: 台積電 GIGAFAB 廠務整合案例
summary: 從工廠與供應鏈、振動與基礎到公開案例審查：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Fab and supply chain and Vibration and foundations to Public-case review: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

依假設排程比較工作、待機與喚醒能量，加入重新穩定時間。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設同一設備在 8 小時比較窗口中，維持工作狀態為 10 kW、可用待機狀態為 2 kW。能耗分別 80 與 16 kWh，差 64 kWh；若喚醒與重新穩定另耗 10 kWh，淨差才是 54 kWh。這是自訂能源帳，不是台積電實測資料，也未計產能與良率代價。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare active/idle/wakeup energy with restabilization time. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume an 8-hour comparison for one tool: active power 10 kW versus an available standby state at 2 kW. Energy is 80 versus 16 kWh, a 64 kWh difference; if wakeup and restabilization add 10 kWh, net savings are 54 kWh. These invented teaching inputs are not TSMC measurements and exclude throughput and yield costs.
steps.observation: 節能策略須同時驗證產能和製程穩定；喚醒後需驗證可用而非只顯示通電。
steps.observationEn: Energy strategies need throughput and process-stability checks; Wakeup needs readiness, not merely power-on status.
steps.failure: 若採用「關機時間越長就一定總成本最低」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming longer shutdown always minimizes total cost", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「設備節能」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：節能策略須同時驗證產能和製程穩定。
算例驗收：驗算 64 與 54 kWh，區分 kW 功率和 kWh 能量，並列出喚醒驗收需求。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Equipment energy saving diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Energy strategies need throughput and process-stability checks.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 64 and 54 kWh, distinguish kW from kWh and list a wakeup-qualification requirement.

title: imec NanoIC 試驗線架構
summary: 從試驗線目的、系統探索到里程碑核對：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Pilot-line purpose and System exploration to Milestone verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Pilot-line purpose, Distributed nodes, Technology modules.

steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Assuming a pathfinding pass guarantees immediate volume fabrication.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「探索 PDK」成果，先指出錯誤主張「探索 PDK 通過便保證可立即流片量產」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：PDK 版本改動可改變設計結論。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Pathfinding PDK artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Assuming a pathfinding pass guarantees immediate volume fabrication". Introduce this diagnostic principle: PDK versions can change design conclusions. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 探索模型不等於量產保證模型；PDK 版本改動可改變設計結論。
steps.observationEn: Pathfinding models are not production-guaranteed models; PDK versions can change design conclusions.
steps.failure: 若採用「探索 PDK 通過便保證可立即流片量產」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming a pathfinding pass guarantees immediate volume fabrication", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「探索 PDK」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「PDK 版本改動可改變設計結論」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Pathfinding PDK, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "PDK versions can change design conclusions" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: PDK versions can change design conclusions.

knowledge.title: 探索 PDK／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「探索 PDK 通過便保證可立即流片量產」與「探索模型不等於量產保證模型」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。

steps.title: 分批實驗：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「實驗矩陣有助區分交互作用」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Experimental matrices help separate interactions.
steps.instruction:
建立只改兩項變因的假設分批矩陣，保留對照。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設試驗線比較兩個因子 A、B，各低／高兩水準，全因子需要 2²=4 組條件。每組做 3 個獨立製程重複，共 12 次；對同一試片讀三次不是三個獨立製程重複。若四組平均響應依 A低B低、A高B低、A低B高、A高B高為 10、14、12、20，A 效應在 B低為 4、B高為 8，交互作用的差中之差為 4。
steps.instructionEn:
Build a two-factor hypothetical split with controls. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a pilot-line experiment with two factors A and B at low/high levels. A full factorial needs 2²=4 conditions; three independent process replicates per condition require 12 runs. Three readings of one specimen are not three independent process replicates. If condition means in low-low, high-low, low-high and high-high order are 10, 14, 12 and 20, A effects are 4 at low B and 8 at high B, giving a difference-in-differences interaction contrast of 4.
steps.observation: 實驗矩陣有助區分交互作用；分批設計須記錄交互作用假設。
steps.observationEn: Experimental matrices help separate interactions; Split designs need stated interaction assumptions.
steps.failure: 若採用「同時更改全部模組後仍能單獨歸因」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Attributing causes after changing every module", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「分批實驗」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：實驗矩陣有助區分交互作用。
算例驗收：列出四組矩陣、12 次獨立重複及交互作用對比 4；註明此為未標準化差中之差，不等同所有軟體的效應係數定義。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Split experiments diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Experimental matrices help separate interactions.
Worked-example acceptance: List four conditions, 12 independent runs and interaction contrast 4; note that this unscaled difference-in-differences is not every software package's effect-coefficient definition.

steps.instruction: 定義可重複性、晶圓分布、可靠度與移轉文件的驗收。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Define repeatability, wafer distributions, reliability and transfer evidence. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 成熟度是證據集合，不只是單一最佳指標；樣本數與失敗樣本不能從門檻中消失。

steps.title: 成熟度門檻：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「單顆最佳展示就視為可量產成熟」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Treating one record device as manufacturing maturity.

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Maturity gates artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating one record device as manufacturing maturity". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Gates must retain sample counts and failures. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.

title: 先進封裝共同設計
summary: 以 20 模組、520 項可保存進度的教學操作，串聯來料、薄化、切割、接合、扇出、RDL、TSV、HBM、散熱與 CPO 驗證；其中 40 項另有定量算例、模型邊界與診斷策略。
summaryEn: Twenty modules and 520 progress-preserving educational operations connect incoming inspection, thinning, dicing, bonding, fan-out, RDL, TSVs, HBM, cooling and CPO verification; 40 selected operations add quantitative examples, model boundaries and diagnostics.
scope: 公開原理與原創教學模型的分支流程；520 步涵蓋互斥或可選工法，不是每件產品都須依序執行的單一量產配方。新算例皆明示假設；原有步驟 ID 與進度對應保留。
scopeEn: A branching curriculum based on public principles and authored models. The 520 operations include alternative and optional routes, not one production recipe every product follows. New examples are hypothetical, and original step IDs remain stable.

stages.title: 封裝架構、DFM與材料選擇
stages.titleEn: Package architecture, DFM and material selection
stages.description: 以26項獨立教學操作檢查封裝架構、DFM與材料選擇的材料、介面、量測和異常判讀。使用自行建立的示意模型，或您提供／由來源合法取得的量測資料；本課程未附逐工序實測表。門檻須明示為教學假設或來自合格材料文件。
stages.descriptionEn: Twenty-six distinct educational operations review materials, interfaces, metrology and diagnosis for package architecture, dfm and material selection. Use schematic models you create, or measurement data you supply or lawfully obtain from sources. No operation-specific measured tables are bundled. State limits as teaching assumptions or derive them from qualified material documents.
stages.route: 共用架構規劃；選定分支後才建立製程旅行單。
stages.routeEn: Shared architecture planning; select a branch before building a traveler.

steps.title: 辨識封裝功能邊界
steps.objective: 把晶粒、封裝及電路板畫成三個介面區，並能說明「封裝同時承擔電連接、散熱與保護」。

steps.instruction: 把晶粒、封裝及電路板畫成三個介面區。以您自行建立或取得的證據逐項核對：每條跨區連線都有訊號或熱的角色。
steps.instructionEn: Draw die, package and PCB as separate interfaces. Check evidence you create or obtain against: Every crossing has an electrical or thermal role.
steps.observation: 每條跨區連線都有訊號或熱的角色；保留可重現判讀所需的原始圖像、量測或流程圖。
steps.observationEn: Every crossing has an electrical or thermal role; retain the original image, measurement or process map needed to reproduce the assessment.
steps.failure: 把板級功能算入晶粒會漏掉封裝介面。
steps.failureEn: Assigning board functions to the die hides package interfaces.
steps.check: 每條跨區連線都有訊號或熱的角色。
steps.checkEn: Every crossing has an electrical or thermal role.

knowledge.title: 本工序機制
knowledge.text: 封裝同時承擔電連接、散熱與保護。
knowledge.textEn: Packaging provides connection, heat removal and protection.

knowledge.title: 異常診斷與判讀邊界

knowledge.textEn: Assigning board functions to the die hides package interfaces. Recheck this operation's input evidence instead of substituting a guess.

quiz.question: 驗收「辨識封裝功能邊界」時，哪一項證據最直接對應本步目標？

optionsEn: Thermal-network topology matches the cross-section
Placement reasoning includes loop geometry and capacitance
Every crossing has an electrical or thermal role

quiz.explanationEn: Packaging provides connection, heat removal and protection. Verify: Every crossing has an electrical or thermal role. A common misinterpretation is: Assigning board functions to the die hides package interfaces.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 假設兩條熱路並聯，上方 0.5 K/W、下方 2 K/W，等效為 0.4 K/W；50 W 對共同等溫邊界的溫升為 20 K。若兩端冷卻溫度不同，不能直接使用這個並聯公式。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical parallel paths of 0.5 and 2 K/W, equivalent resistance is 0.4 K/W; 50 W gives 20 K rise above a common isothermal boundary. Different sink temperatures invalidate this direct parallel reduction.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 把晶粒功率、散熱器溫度、接觸熱阻與邊界對流分開記錄。熱阻測試的邊界條件是數值的一部分，不能把資料表 θJA 當任何系統通用常數。
knowledge.textEn: Record die power, sink temperature, contact resistance and convection separately. Test boundary conditions are part of thermal resistance; datasheet θJA is not a universal system constant.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 教學地圖有 100 個實體晶粒，電子檔標示 92 良品、5 不良、3 未測。可挑選數是 92，而不是以非不良數 95 代替；未測需維持獨立狀態。
knowledge.textEn: A teaching map has 100 physical dies: 92 good, 5 bad and 3 untested. Pickable count is 92, not 95 inferred from not-bad status; untested remains separate.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 驗證晶圓 ID、座標原點、旋轉、鏡射、bin 定義及版本雜湊。相同檔名不代表相同地圖，且更新後不得讓舊快取挑選未授權晶粒。
knowledge.textEn: Verify wafer ID, origin, rotation, reflection, bin meanings and version hash. Identical filenames need not mean identical maps, and stale caches must not select unauthorized dies.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 假設同位置五次厚度量測為 99、100、101、100、100 µm，平均 100 µm、樣本標準差約 0.707 µm。這只描述重複性，未包含不同人、日期、治具與校正偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Five hypothetical thickness readings 99, 100, 101, 100 and 100 µm give mean 100 µm and sample standard deviation about 0.707 µm. This is repeatability only, excluding operators, days, fixtures and calibration bias.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 先確認量測不確定度相對製程窗口是否足夠小，再解讀改善。若觀測改變小於儀器可分辨的差異，不能以單次讀值宣稱製程提升。
knowledge.textEn: Check measurement uncertainty against the process window before interpreting improvement. A change below resolvable measurement difference cannot establish process improvement from one reading.

knowledge.textEn: For a hypothetical 20 µm die-attach layer, k=2 W/(m·K) and area 25 mm², ideal 1D resistance is 0.4 K/W; 10 W gives 4 K rise before contact and spreading resistance.

steps.observationEn: All plated regions have conductive paths; retain the original image, measurement or process map needed to reproduce the assessment.

steps.failureEn: Planar coverage can hide sidewall breaks.
steps.check: 所有待鍍區均有導電路徑。
steps.checkEn: All plated regions have conductive paths.

steps.title: 量測種子層片電阻
steps.objective: 以固定點位繪製片電阻分布，並能說明「片電阻反映厚度與材料狀態」。
steps.objectiveEn: Map sheet resistance at fixed positions and explain: Sheet resistance reflects thickness and material state.
steps.instruction: 以固定點位繪製片電阻分布。以您自行建立或取得的證據逐項核對：異常區與覆膜資料交叉核對。 進階練習：依下方工程算例重算一次，將所用單位、假設及無法由現有資料判定的項目寫入筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Map sheet resistance at fixed positions. Check evidence you create or obtain against: Anomalies are compared with deposition evidence. Advanced exercise: reproduce the worked example below and record units, assumptions and conclusions unsupported by the available data.
steps.observation: 異常區與覆膜資料交叉核對；保留可重現判讀所需的原始圖像、量測或流程圖。
steps.observationEn: Anomalies are compared with deposition evidence; retain the original image, measurement or process map needed to reproduce the assessment.
steps.failure: 片電阻變化不必全由厚度造成。
steps.failureEn: Resistance variation need not arise only from thickness.
steps.check: 異常區與覆膜資料交叉核對。
steps.checkEn: Anomalies are compared with deposition evidence.

knowledge.title: 本工序機制
knowledge.text: 片電阻反映厚度與材料狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Sheet resistance reflects thickness and material state.

knowledge.title: 異常診斷與判讀邊界
knowledge.text: 片電阻變化不必全由厚度造成；應回查本步輸入證據，不能以猜測取代判定。
knowledge.textEn: Resistance variation need not arise only from thickness. Recheck this operation's input evidence instead of substituting a guess.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 片電阻 Rs=ρ/t；假設 ρ=2×10⁻⁸ Ω·m、t=100 nm，Rs=0.2 Ω/□。20 squares 的理想條帶電阻 4 Ω，不含接觸與尺寸效應。
knowledge.textEn: For Rs=ρ/t, hypothetical ρ=2×10⁻⁸ Ω·m and t=100 nm give 0.2 Ω/□. An ideal 20-square strip has 4 Ω excluding contacts and size effects.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 低片電阻不保證深孔側壁和孔底連續。應把平面量測與截面覆蓋證據分開，薄膜電阻率也可能不同於塊材。
knowledge.textEn: Low sheet resistance does not prove continuity at deep via walls and bottoms. Separate planar measurements from sectional coverage; film resistivity may differ from bulk values.

面積定義與使用的電流量一致
optionsEn: Time-temperature evidence comes from part records
Anomalies are compared with deposition evidence
Area definition matches the current used
quiz.explanation: 片電阻反映厚度與材料狀態。本步要確認：異常區與覆膜資料交叉核對；常見誤判是：片電阻變化不必全由厚度造成。
quiz.explanationEn: Sheet resistance reflects thickness and material state. Verify: Anomalies are compared with deposition evidence. A common misinterpretation is: Resistance variation need not arise only from thickness.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 假設模封後某晶粒中心位移 dx=12 µm、dy=5 µm，位移長度 13 µm；若另有旋轉，晶粒角落位移可能更大，不能只補償中心。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical die shift dx=12 µm and dy=5 µm has magnitude 13 µm. Rotation may make corner displacement larger, so center correction alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 位移圖應保留每顆身份、中心、角度、局部尺度及擬合殘差。RDL 補償能力與曝光設備可修正模型相符才有意義。
knowledge.textEn: Displacement maps should retain die identity, center, angle, local scale and residuals. RDL correction is meaningful only within the exposure system's supported model.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略

knowledge.textEn: Compare sections and chain resistance at different fill stages, distinguishing seed discontinuity, wetting and additive control. High final resistance alone does not justify arbitrary bath changes.

knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「損傷訊號下降且剩餘厚度合格」。可藉由「比較處理前後表面裂紋與強度資料」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Damage decreases while remaining thickness passes. Evidence can be developed through this action: Compare crack and strength data before and after treatment. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 背磨損傷層消除的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Evaluate grinding damage removal
knowledge.text: 只降低粗糙度未必消除亞表面裂紋。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Lower roughness need not remove subsurface cracks. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「背磨損傷層消除」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Evaluate grinding damage removal?
options: 只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：只降低粗糙度未必消除亞表面裂紋。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
損傷訊號下降且剩餘厚度合格
optionsEn: Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Lower roughness need not remove subsurface cracks.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Damage decreases while remaining thickness passes
quiz.explanation: 應確認「損傷訊號下降且剩餘厚度合格」。只降低粗糙度未必消除亞表面裂紋，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Damage decreases while remaining thickness passes. Lower roughness need not remove subsurface cracks, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 已填 TSV 晶圓的背面支線；載板、去黏方式與背面金屬順序依材料系統選用。
steps.routeEn: Backside branch for filled-TSV wafers; carrier, debond method, and backside metal sequence depend on the material system.

steps.title: TSV 顯露終點模擬
steps.objective: 判斷「TSV 顯露終點模擬」是否滿足此具體條件：孔端露出但未超出支撐容許量。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Simulate TSV reveal endpoint meets this specific condition: Tips are exposed within supported-height limits.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：讀取矽移除量與孔端高度。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Read silicon removal and via-tip height together. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：孔端露出但未超出支撐容許量；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Tips are exposed within supported-height limits. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 過度顯露會削弱孔端機械支撐。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Excessive reveal weakens mechanical tip support. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 孔端露出但未超出支撐容許量；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Tips are exposed within supported-height limits. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

steps.title: 背面顯露高度分布
steps.objective: 判斷「背面顯露高度分布」是否滿足此具體條件：最矮孔可接觸且最高孔不過凸。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Map backside reveal height meets this specific condition: Shortest tips contact while tallest avoid excessive protrusion.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：建立全片 TSV 突出高度圖。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。 進階練習：依下方工程算例重算一次，將所用單位、假設及無法由現有資料判定的項目寫入筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Map TSV protrusion heights across the wafer. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing. Advanced exercise: reproduce the worked example below and record units, assumptions and conclusions unsupported by the available data.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：最矮孔可接觸且最高孔不過凸；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Shortest tips contact while tallest avoid excessive protrusion. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 孔深差異會轉換成顯露高度差。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Via-depth variation becomes reveal-height variation. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 最矮孔可接觸且最高孔不過凸；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Shortest tips contact while tallest avoid excessive protrusion. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 假設露出高度 1、2、4 µm，平均 2.33 µm；若後段接觸模型容許 1–3 µm，4 µm 點可能有支承或鈍化風險。門檻僅為教學例。
knowledge.textEn: Hypothetical reveal heights 1, 2 and 4 µm average 2.33 µm; an authored downstream window of 1–3 µm flags the 4 µm point for support or passivation risk.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 高度以鄰近矽或鈍化面為基準，分辨殘矽、銅突出和量測遮蔽。過度顯露不必然較好，需連同後續覆蓋評估。
knowledge.textEn: Reference height to nearby silicon or passivation and distinguish residual silicon, protruding copper and occlusion. More reveal is not automatically better; evaluate subsequent coverage.

knowledge.textEn: Good DC resistance does not establish low high-frequency impedance. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 假設允許瞬態 droop 20 mV、負載階躍 10 A，目標阻抗量級 Ztarget=ΔV/ΔI=2 mΩ。它應附頻率範圍，不能只用 DC 電阻宣稱通過。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical droop 20 mV and load step 10 A, target impedance scale is 2 mΩ. Specify frequency range; DC resistance alone cannot establish compliance.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 分開電阻壓降、封裝電感與去耦共振。將晶粒到基板再到穩壓器的回流路徑畫完整，避免只沿供電線看幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Separate resistive drop, package inductance and decoupling resonance. Draw the full return path from die through substrate to regulator rather than only supply geometry.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 串擾同時取決於耦合長度、間距、回流面與邊沿速度。兩條同長線即使位元率相同，不同上升時間也可能有不同高頻耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Crosstalk depends on coupled length, spacing, reference planes and edge rate. Equal-length traces at the same data rate can couple differently with different rise times.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 使用一致埠定義與終端比較近端/遠端串擾，保留激發與安靜受害線條件。不能只將更寬間距視為唯一改善方法。
knowledge.textEn: Compare near- and far-end crosstalk using consistent ports and terminations and state aggressor and quiet-victim conditions. Greater spacing is not the only possible improvement.

knowledge.text: 樹脂拖抹會遮住內層銅接點。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Resin smear can cover inner-layer copper contacts. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「有機芯通孔鑽孔支線」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Inspect organic-core drilled holes?
options: 忽略此失效線索：樹脂拖抹會遮住內層銅接點。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
孔形及孔壁可接受後續金屬化
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
optionsEn: Ignore this failure clue: Resin smear can cover inner-layer copper contacts.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Hole geometry supports subsequent metallization
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「孔形及孔壁可接受後續金屬化」。樹脂拖抹會遮住內層銅接點，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Hole geometry supports subsequent metallization. Resin smear can cover inner-layer copper contacts, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 有機芯或玻璃芯支線；玻璃通孔與有機鑽孔各用其合格路線，不可互換製程參數。
steps.routeEn: Organic-core or glass-core branch; glass vias and organic drilling use separately qualified routes.
steps.photoNote: 本步代表性真實照片（同模組可能共用）。可觀察 BGA 封裝內的晶粒及周邊互連；不將這張傳統封裝內部照片當作扇出、RDL、HBM 或 CPO 實拍。
steps.photoNoteEn: Representative real photograph for this step (may be shared within the module). Observe a die and surrounding interconnects in a BGA package; this conventional package interior is not a fan-out, RDL, HBM or CPO process photograph.

steps.title: 玻璃通孔成孔支線
steps.objective: 判斷「玻璃通孔成孔支線」是否滿足此具體條件：孔形及崩角符合金屬化能力。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Inspect through-glass via formation meets this specific condition: Geometry and chipping fit metallization capability.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：量測玻璃孔錐度與出口崩角。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Measure glass-via taper and exit chipping. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：孔形及崩角符合金屬化能力；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Geometry and chipping fit metallization capability. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 出口裂紋可降低熱循環耐受。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Exit cracks can reduce thermal-cycle endurance. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 孔形及崩角符合金屬化能力；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Geometry and chipping fit metallization capability. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Stacked-via interfaces maintain continuous contact. Evidence can be developed through this action: Trace interface contact in stacked-via cross sections. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 增層微孔堆疊支線的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Inspect stacked-microvia interfaces
knowledge.text: 介面凹陷可成為疲勞弱點。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Interface dimples can become fatigue weak points. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 三層堆疊微孔的偏移可以累積。假設每層確定向同側偏 3 µm，總偏 9 µm；只有獨立隨機偏差才可另作 RSS 模型。
knowledge.textEn: Offsets in three stacked microvias may accumulate. Three hypothetical deterministic 3 µm same-direction offsets total 9 µm; RSS requires a separate independent-random model.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 檢查上下接墊捕捉區、介面裂紋與熱循環累積應變。錯列孔與堆疊孔有不同佈線和力學代價，不以單一面積指標決策。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect capture pads, interface cracks and cyclic strain. Staggered and stacked vias have different routing and mechanical tradeoffs; area alone is insufficient.

quiz.question: 完成「增層微孔堆疊支線」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Inspect stacked-microvia interfaces?
options: 以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
上下微孔介面接觸連續
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：介面凹陷可成為疲勞弱點。
optionsEn: Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Stacked-via interfaces maintain continuous contact
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Interface dimples can become fatigue weak points.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「上下微孔介面接觸連續」。介面凹陷可成為疲勞弱點，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Stacked-via interfaces maintain continuous contact. Interface dimples can become fatigue weak points, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 有機芯或玻璃芯支線；玻璃通孔與有機鑽孔各用其合格路線，不可互換製程參數。
steps.routeEn: Organic-core or glass-core branch; glass vias and organic drilling use separately qualified routes.

steps.title: 防焊層開口
steps.objective: 判斷「防焊層開口」是否滿足此具體條件：開口保留所選焊墊定義方式。

steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare mask boundaries and pad designs. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：開口保留所選焊墊定義方式；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Openings preserve the chosen pad-definition scheme. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 開口偏移可改變有效潤濕面積。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Misregistration changes effective wettable area. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 開口保留所選焊墊定義方式；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Openings preserve the chosen pad-definition scheme. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

stages.title: 混合鍵合與直接接合對準
stages.description: 混合鍵合同時依靠介電與金屬介面；顆粒、局部平坦度、銅高度差與對位都必須受控。本模組為 26 個可分支的判讀作業，課程順序不代表量產配方。網站提供原創示意模型；本模組未隨附逐步實測資料或商用允收門檻。
stages.descriptionEn: Hybrid bonding combines dielectric and metal interfaces; particles, local flatness, copper height, and alignment must all be controlled. These 26 branching interpretation exercises are a learning sequence, not a production recipe. The site supplies original schematic models, not per-step measured datasets or commercial acceptance limits.
stages.route: 晶圓對晶圓、直接晶粒對晶圓及集合轉移為替代支線；混合鍵合不能視為微凸塊回焊。
stages.routeEn: Wafer-to-wafer, direct die-to-wafer, and collective transfer are alternative branches; hybrid bonding is not microbump reflow.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 不能以增加熱量任意補救所有凹陷：過度熱負載可能影響已完成元件。先確定形貌、Cu 微結構和允許熱預算，再做合格試片研究。

knowledge.text: 腐蝕可使墊面凹入且增加接觸阻抗。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Corrosion recesses pads and raises contact impedance. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「銅墊腐蝕檢查」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Inspect copper-pad corrosion?
options: 忽略此失效線索：腐蝕可使墊面凹入且增加接觸阻抗。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
銅墊無超出規則的腐蝕區
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
optionsEn: Ignore this failure clue: Corrosion recesses pads and raises contact impedance.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Pads lack corrosion beyond acceptance rules
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「銅墊無超出規則的腐蝕區」。腐蝕可使墊面凹入且增加接觸阻抗，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Pads lack corrosion beyond acceptance rules. Corrosion recesses pads and raises contact impedance, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 晶圓對晶圓、直接晶粒對晶圓及集合轉移為替代支線；混合鍵合不能視為微凸塊回焊。
steps.routeEn: Wafer-to-wafer, direct die-to-wafer, and collective transfer are alternative branches; hybrid bonding is not microbump reflow.

steps.title: 晶粒切割污染路徑
steps.objective: 判斷「晶粒切割污染路徑」是否滿足此具體條件：切割污染未進入有效接合區。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Map singulation contamination paths meets this specific condition: Singulation contamination stays outside active bond areas.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：比較保護前後接合面的顆粒地圖。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare bonding-surface particle maps across protection cases. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：切割污染未進入有效接合區；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Singulation contamination stays outside active bond areas. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 切割邊緣潔淨不代表面內潔淨。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Clean edges do not establish a clean bonding face. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 切割污染未進入有效接合區；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Singulation contamination stays outside active bond areas. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

Evidence can be developed through this action: Compare bonding-surface particle maps across protection cases. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.textEn: Fit correctable affine terms first, then inspect nonlinear residuals. Specify whether overlay limits are single-axis, vector, maximum or percentile; these are not interchangeable.

stages.title: HBM 與晶粒堆疊組裝
stages.description: 堆疊放大單層缺陷的成本，必須維持晶粒譜系、逐層幾何與測試可達性。本模組為 26 個可分支的判讀作業，課程順序不代表量產配方。網站提供原創示意模型；本模組未隨附逐步實測資料或商用允收門檻。
stages.descriptionEn: Stacking magnifies the cost of individual defects and requires die genealogy, layer geometry, and test access. These 26 branching interpretation exercises are a learning sequence, not a production recipe. The site supplies original schematic models, not per-step measured datasets or commercial acceptance limits.
stages.route: 依產品採微凸塊熱壓、回焊或混合鍵合；本模組比較支線，不宣稱任何供應商固定堆疊配方。
stages.routeEn: Products may use microbump thermocompression, reflow, or hybrid bonding; these are alternatives, not a supplier recipe.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 假設每層厚度差造成 0.02° 同向傾斜，八層最壞累積 0.16°；在 5 mm 跨距對應約 14 µm 高差。實際須以逐層量測確認是否同向。
knowledge.textEn: Eight hypothetical layers each tilted 0.02° in the same direction accumulate 0.16° worst case, corresponding to about 14 µm over 5 mm. Layer measurements must establish whether tilts align.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 將角度、局部間隙和接點共平面分開檢查。頂層平面不能單獨證明每層內部接合完整，需結合電測與非破壞影像。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect angle, local gap and contact coplanarity separately. A flat top does not prove every internal interface is sound; combine electrical and nondestructive evidence.

knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Relative and absolute layer offsets meet limits. Evidence can be developed through this action: Compare layer corners in the base coordinate frame. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 上層晶粒偏移的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Measure upper-layer displacement
knowledge.text: 僅逐層比對可漏掉總體漂移。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Adjacent-layer checks can miss total drift. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「上層晶粒偏移」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Measure upper-layer displacement?
options: 每層相對與絕對偏移皆達標
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：僅逐層比對可漏掉總體漂移。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
optionsEn: Relative and absolute layer offsets meet limits
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Adjacent-layer checks can miss total drift.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「每層相對與絕對偏移皆達標」。僅逐層比對可漏掉總體漂移，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Relative and absolute layer offsets meet limits. Adjacent-layer checks can miss total drift, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 依產品採微凸塊熱壓、回焊或混合鍵合；本模組比較支線，不宣稱任何供應商固定堆疊配方。
steps.routeEn: Products may use microbump thermocompression, reflow, or hybrid bonding; these are alternatives, not a supplier recipe.
steps.photoNote: 本步代表性真實照片（同模組可能共用）。可觀察封裝截面、基板與外部焊球；它不是 TSV／HBM／混合鍵合的專屬截面，也不能判定內部空洞。

steps.title: 上蓋晶粒支線
steps.objective: 判斷「上蓋晶粒支線」是否滿足此具體條件：上蓋接觸不造成局部集中載荷。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Evaluate a top-cap die branch meets this specific condition: Cap contact avoids concentrated local loads.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：比較上蓋平整度與機械支撐面。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare cap flatness and mechanical support surfaces. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：上蓋接觸不造成局部集中載荷；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Cap contact avoids concentrated local loads. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 凸起缺陷可把載荷傳入記憶體薄晶粒。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Protrusions can transfer load into thin memory dies. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 上蓋接觸不造成局部集中載荷；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Cap contact avoids concentrated local loads. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.text: 假設八層各發熱 1 W、頂面為唯一熱出口，最底層熱流須穿過更多界面。不能用 8 W 乘單一晶粒熱阻來保證每層結溫。
knowledge.textEn: For eight hypothetical 1 W layers with only top cooling, lower layers traverse more interfaces. Multiplying 8 W by one die's resistance does not establish all junction temperatures.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 建立逐層熱阻與發熱節點，另列側向擴散和 TSV 熱通道。空間上不均勻的記憶體活動需要非均勻功率輸入。
knowledge.textEn: Build per-layer resistance and source nodes, including spreading and TSV thermal paths. Nonuniform memory activity requires nonuniform power inputs.

knowledge.title: 充填間隙流阻的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Evaluate underfill gap-flow resistance
knowledge.text: 間隙變小會顯著增加流動阻力。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Smaller gaps substantially increase flow resistance. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 狹縫毛細填充的簡化模型常有時間隨流長平方增加的趨勢；路長由 5 增至 10 mm，其他假設不變時時間量級可增四倍。真實填料與固化會偏離。
knowledge.textEn: Simplified slit-capillary models often give fill time scaling with length squared; increasing 5 to 10 mm can quadruple time if assumptions hold. Fillers and curing cause deviations.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 先檢查表面潤濕、間隙一致性和排氣路徑，再比較黏度。兩個入口相遇可能困氣，填滿外緣不能證明內部無空洞。
knowledge.textEn: Check wetting, gap uniformity and venting before comparing viscosity. Converging fronts can trap gas; a filled edge does not prove a void-free interior.

quiz.question: 完成「充填間隙流阻」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Evaluate underfill gap-flow resistance?
options: 以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
預期流動能在已驗證作業窗內完成
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：間隙變小會顯著增加流動阻力。
optionsEn: Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Predicted flow completes within the validated working window
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Smaller gaps substantially increase flow resistance.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「預期流動能在已驗證作業窗內完成」。間隙變小會顯著增加流動阻力，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Predicted flow completes within the validated working window. Smaller gaps substantially increase flow resistance, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.title: 填膠材料可用狀態
steps.objective: 判斷「填膠材料可用狀態」是否滿足此具體條件：材料狀態符合供應商核准要求。

steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare storage, thaw, and working-time records. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：材料狀態符合供應商核准要求；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Material condition meets approved supplier requirements. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 外觀正常仍可能已超出可用時間。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Normal appearance can conceal expired working time. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 材料狀態符合供應商核准要求；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Material condition meets approved supplier requirements. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.textEn: High bulk conductivity does not ensure low contact resistance. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「導熱介面材料選擇」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Compare thermal-interface material branches?
options: 只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：高本體導熱率不保證低接觸熱阻。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
材料兼顧熱阻與封裝應變需求
optionsEn: Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: High bulk conductivity does not ensure low contact resistance.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Material meets thermal resistance and strain needs
quiz.explanation: 應確認「材料兼顧熱阻與封裝應變需求」。高本體導熱率不保證低接觸熱阻，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Material meets thermal resistance and strain needs. High bulk conductivity does not ensure low contact resistance, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 依封裝選毛細充填、模封充填或預施膠；有蓋、無蓋及液冷介面是替代結構。
steps.routeEn: Select capillary, molded, or preapplied underfill; lidded, lidless, and liquid-cooled interfaces are alternative structures.
steps.photoNote: 本步代表性真實照片（同模組可能共用）。可觀察封裝截面、基板與外部焊球；它不是 TSV／HBM／混合鍵合的專屬截面，也不能判定內部空洞。
steps.photoNoteEn: Representative real photograph for this step (may be shared within the module). Observe a package cross section, substrate and external balls; it is not a TSV/HBM/hybrid-bond cross section and cannot establish internal voiding.

steps.title: 導熱層塗佈覆蓋
steps.objective: 判斷「導熱層塗佈覆蓋」是否滿足此具體條件：目標熱區連續覆蓋且不污染保留區。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Inspect thermal-interface coverage meets this specific condition: Hot regions are covered without contaminating keep-outs.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：比較塗佈圖形與實際發熱區。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare deposited patterns with heat-producing regions. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：目標熱區連續覆蓋且不污染保留區；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Hot regions are covered without contaminating keep-outs. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 只看總塗佈量會漏掉熱點缺膠。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Total deposited mass can hide uncovered hotspots. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 目標熱區連續覆蓋且不污染保留區；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Hot regions are covered without contaminating keep-outs. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Hot regions are covered without contaminating keep-outs. Evidence can be developed through this action: Compare deposited patterns with heat-producing regions. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：以支撐幾何推算壓合後厚度。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。 進階練習：依下方工程算例重算一次，將所用單位、假設及無法由現有資料判定的項目寫入筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Infer compressed thickness from support geometry. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing. Advanced exercise: reproduce the worked example below and record units, assumptions and conclusions unsupported by the available data.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 假設 TIM 厚 50 µm、k=5 W/(m·K)、面積 100 mm²，塊材 R=0.1 K/W；50 W 對應 5 K，未計兩面接觸熱阻。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical TIM thickness 50 µm, k=5 W/(m·K) and area 100 mm², bulk R=0.1 K/W; 50 W gives 5 K before contact resistance.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 減薄可以降低塊材項，但若不足以填補翹曲而形成乾接觸，總熱阻反而可能上升。將厚度、覆蓋率、壓力與熱測結果共同判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Thinning lowers bulk resistance, but insufficient gap filling under warpage can increase total resistance. Interpret thickness, coverage, pressure and thermal data together.

knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「合金版本與核准熱歷程相容」。可藉由「核對球材識別與接合材料清單」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Alloy revision matches the qualified thermal history. Evidence can be developed through this action: Match ball identity to joining material lists. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 焊球合金版本的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Verify solder-ball alloy revision
knowledge.text: 外形相同的合金可能有不同接合需求。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Identical ball geometry can hide different joining needs. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「焊球合金版本」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Verify solder-ball alloy revision?
options: 以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
合金版本與核准熱歷程相容
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：外形相同的合金可能有不同接合需求。
optionsEn: Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Alloy revision matches the qualified thermal history
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Identical ball geometry can hide different joining needs.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「合金版本與核准熱歷程相容」。外形相同的合金可能有不同接合需求，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Alloy revision matches the qualified thermal history. Identical ball geometry can hide different joining needs, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: BGA 對外焊球支線；LGA、裸晶模組與光學連接器採其他端接形式。
steps.routeEn: External BGA solder-ball branch; LGA, bare-die modules, and optical connectors use other terminations.
steps.photoNote: 本步代表性真實照片（同模組可能共用）。可觀察電路板上封裝元件的位置及外觀；這是頂視圖，焊球位於底部不可見，無法由此判定接合品質。
steps.photoNoteEn: Representative real photograph for this step (may be shared within the module). Observe the package on a circuit board; this is a top view, so underside balls are not visible and joint quality cannot be inferred.

steps.title: 焊球尺寸分布
steps.objective: 判斷「焊球尺寸分布」是否滿足此具體條件：尺寸尾端符合規定的批次限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Measure solder-ball size distribution meets this specific condition: Distribution tails meet lot limits.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：比較抽樣直徑與體積統計。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare sampled diameter and volume statistics. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：尺寸尾端符合規定的批次限制；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Distribution tails meet lot limits. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 只報平均直徑會漏掉過大過小球。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Mean diameter hides oversized and undersized balls. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 尺寸尾端符合規定的批次限制；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Distribution tails meet lot limits. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.text: 事後直流量測可能漏掉短暫斷路。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Posttest DC measurements can miss transient opens. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「板級跌落支線」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Assess board-level drop branch?
options: 只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：事後直流量測可能漏掉短暫斷路。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
瞬斷事件與實際衝擊時間對得上
optionsEn: Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Posttest DC measurements can miss transient opens.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Transient opens align with measured impact timing
quiz.explanation: 應確認「瞬斷事件與實際衝擊時間對得上」。事後直流量測可能漏掉短暫斷路，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Transient opens align with measured impact timing. Posttest DC measurements can miss transient opens, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.title: 機械振動共振

steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare acceleration transmissibility and fixture modes. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：樣本負載可與夾具影響分離；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Specimen loads can be separated from fixture effects. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 夾具共振可能被誤判為產品弱點。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Fixture resonance can be mistaken for a product weakness. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 樣本負載可與夾具影響分離；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。

knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「缺陷在相鄰切片有連續證據」。可藉由「沿互連方向追蹤疑似空隙或裂縫」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Defects have coherent evidence across adjacent slices. Evidence can be developed through this action: Trace suspected voids or cracks along interconnects. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 三維 X 光追蹤的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Track defects with three-dimensional X-ray
knowledge.text: 重建偽影不可當成真實裂紋。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruction artifacts must not be treated as cracks. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「三維 X 光追蹤」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Track defects with three-dimensional X-ray?
options: 缺陷在相鄰切片有連續證據
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：重建偽影不可當成真實裂紋。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
optionsEn: Defects have coherent evidence across adjacent slices
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Reconstruction artifacts must not be treated as cracks.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「缺陷在相鄰切片有連續證據」。重建偽影不可當成真實裂紋，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Defects have coherent evidence across adjacent slices. Reconstruction artifacts must not be treated as cracks, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「採用指定參考平面與測試負載」。可藉由「比較去嵌入前後的眼高與眼寬」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Specified reference planes and loads are used. Evidence can be developed through this action: Compare eye height and width before and after de-embedding. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 高速眼圖量測的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Measure high-speed eye diagrams
knowledge.text: 治具損耗未分離會低估封裝性能。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Unseparated fixture loss can understate package performance. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「高速眼圖量測」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Measure high-speed eye diagrams?
options: 忽略此失效線索：治具損耗未分離會低估封裝性能。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
採用指定參考平面與測試負載
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
optionsEn: Ignore this failure clue: Unseparated fixture loss can understate package performance.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Specified reference planes and loads are used
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「採用指定參考平面與測試負載」。治具損耗未分離會低估封裝性能，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Specified reference planes and loads are used. Unseparated fixture loss can understate package performance, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.title: 誤碼率與觀察時間
steps.titleEn: Assess bit error rate and observation duration
steps.objective: 判斷「誤碼率與觀察時間」是否滿足此具體條件：報告包含位元分母與信賴限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Assess bit error rate and observation duration meets this specific condition: Reports include bit-count denominator and confidence limits.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：將錯誤數除以實際觀察位元數。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。 進階練習：依下方工程算例重算一次，將所用單位、假設及無法由現有資料判定的項目寫入筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Divide error count by actually observed bit count. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing. Advanced exercise: reproduce the worked example below and record units, assumptions and conclusions unsupported by the available data.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：報告包含位元分母與信賴限制；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Reports include bit-count denominator and confidence limits. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 零錯誤不代表真實誤碼率為零。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Zero observed errors do not establish zero true BER. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 報告包含位元分母與信賴限制；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Reports include bit-count denominator and confidence limits. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 假設有效觀測 10^12 bits 且零錯誤，在獨立稀有錯誤模型下 95% BER 上限約 3×10⁻¹²；不是 BER=0。若錯誤群聚，需另看 burst 統計。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical 10^12 observed bits and zero errors, an independent rare-error model gives approximately 3×10⁻¹² at 95% confidence, not BER=0. Bursts require separate statistics.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 記錄碼型、速率、等化、FEC 前後、溫度和供電條件。相同平均 BER 的鏈路可能有不同突發錯誤長度和系統影響。
knowledge.textEn: Record pattern, rate, equalization, pre/post-FEC status, temperature and voltage. Equal average BER can conceal different burst lengths and system impact.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 假設波導有效熱光係數 1.8×10⁻⁴/K、長 1 mm、λ=1.55 µm，均勻 1 K 溫升造成固定幾何相位約 0.730 rad。局部熱點則須沿路徑積分。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical effective thermo-optic coefficient 1.8×10⁻⁴/K, length 1 mm and λ=1.55 µm, uniform 1 K rise gives fixed-geometry phase about 0.730 rad. Local hotspots require path integration.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 分別量測本地加熱效率、鄰近串擾和封裝背景漂移，建立工作點相關的耦合矩陣。只校正單顆相位器不能保證多通道共同運作時穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Measure local efficiency, neighboring crosstalk and package drift separately and build an operating-point-dependent matrix. Calibrating one phase shifter does not guarantee stability during joint operation.

title: 矽光子與 CPO 光引擎
titleEn: Silicon Photonics and CPO Optical Engines
summary: 48 項循序任務：由波導、光源與調變器進入光纖封裝、IL/PDL、熱串擾矩陣、應力相位、製程公差、N−1 備援與端到端 BER 驗收，含可手算的自訂工程案例。
summaryEn: Forty-eight sequential tasks connect waveguides, sources and modulators with fiber packaging, IL/PDL, thermal-crosstalk matrices, stress-induced phase, process tolerance, N−1 redundancy and end-to-end BER acceptance, with reproducible authored examples.
scope: 矽光子與 CPO 共同設計的原創教學；24 項基礎任務後新增 24 項定量設計審查。算例不是商用 PDK 或原廠實測，外部研究依其公開測試條件引用。
scopeEn: Authored silicon-photonics and CPO co-design teaching, preserving 24 foundational tasks and appending 24 quantitative reviews. Examples are not commercial PDK values or vendor measurements; cited research retains its published test conditions.

steps.title: 理解折射率導光

steps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for understand index guiding.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 高低折射率結構可束縛光場，但模態分布需滿足波動方程。
knowledge.textEn: Index contrast can confine light, while mode profiles must satisfy wave equations.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 標出核心、包覆層及消逝場。
knowledge.textEn: Label core, cladding and evanescent field.

steps.check: 標出核心、包覆層及消逝場。
steps.checkEn: Label core, cladding and evanescent field.

quiz.question: 哪個敘述最直接說明「理解折射率導光」的核心原理？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains understand index guiding?
options: 有效折射率描述相位傳播，群折射率描述波包延遲。
彎曲輻射與側壁散射是不同損耗機制。
高低折射率結構可束縛光場，但模態分布需滿足波動方程。
optionsEn: Effective index describes phase propagation; group index describes pulse delay.
Bend radiation and sidewall scattering are distinct loss mechanisms.
Index contrast can confine light, while mode profiles must satisfy wave equations.
quiz.explanation: 高低折射率結構可束縛光場，但模態分布需滿足波動方程。
quiz.explanationEn: Index contrast can confine light, while mode profiles must satisfy wave equations.

steps.instruction: 畫核心與上下包覆層剖面，標出折射率與場分布，將模態束縛和單純幾何光線反射分開討論。
steps.instructionEn: Draw core and claddings with indices and field profiles, distinguishing modal confinement from simple ray reflection.
steps.failure: 只用核心折射率不能決定有效折射率或單模條件。
steps.failureEn: Core index alone does not determine effective index or single-mode operation.
steps.observation: 高低折射率結構可束縛光場，但模態分布需滿足波動方程。 標出核心、包覆層及消逝場。
steps.observationEn: Index contrast can confine light, while mode profiles must satisfy wave equations. Label core, cladding and evanescent field.

steps.title: 區分有效與群折射率

steps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for distinguish effective and group index.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 有效折射率描述相位傳播，群折射率描述波包延遲。
knowledge.textEn: Effective index describes phase propagation; group index describes pulse delay.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 說明相位計算與延遲計算應選不同折射率。
knowledge.textEn: Choose the appropriate index for phase and delay calculations.

steps.check: 說明相位計算與延遲計算應選不同折射率。
steps.checkEn: Choose the appropriate index for phase and delay calculations.
