有效折射率描述相位傳播，群折射率描述波包延遲。
彎曲輻射與側壁散射是不同損耗機制。
optionsEn: Index contrast can confine light, while mode profiles must satisfy wave equations.
Effective index describes phase propagation; group index describes pulse delay.
Bend radiation and sidewall scattering are distinct loss mechanisms.
quiz.explanation: 有效折射率描述相位傳播，群折射率描述波包延遲。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective index describes phase propagation; group index describes pulse delay.

steps.instruction: 將相位延遲使用的 neff 與群延遲使用的 ng 分開，建立長度、波長和頻率導數的單位表，勿把兩者任意互換。
steps.instructionEn: Separate neff for phase from ng for group delay and tabulate length, wavelength and frequency-derivative units without interchanging the indices.
steps.failure: 以 neff 直接代替 ng 可能錯估群延遲與共振自由頻譜範圍。
steps.failureEn: Substituting neff for ng can misestimate group delay and free spectral range.
steps.observation: 有效折射率描述相位傳播，群折射率描述波包延遲。 說明相位計算與延遲計算應選不同折射率。
steps.observationEn: Effective index describes phase propagation; group index describes pulse delay. Choose the appropriate index for phase and delay calculations.

steps.title: 分析彎曲與粗糙損耗

knowledge.text: 彎曲輻射與側壁散射是不同損耗機制。

steps.failureEn: Attributing all end-to-end loss to sidewall roughness ignores coupling and bends.

steps.title: 辨識光源整合方式

steps.title: 比較邊緣與光柵耦合

steps.title: 分離鏈路參考面與插入損耗

steps.objective: 報告 6.02 dB 並保留參考面、波長和偏振。

steps.instruction: 畫出雷射、光纖、PIC 與功率計，各接頭編號。讓旁路與 DUT 共用參考面，列出尚未去嵌的項目。

steps.observation: 假設參考功率 1.00 mW，輸出 0.25 mW，IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB；此值仍包含未去嵌耦合器。
steps.observationEn: With hypothetical reference 1.00 mW and output 0.25 mW, IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB; unremoved coupler loss remains included.
steps.failure: 重新插拔參考線後未重校正，會把治具漂移當元件變化。
steps.failureEn: Reconnecting without rereferencing makes fixture drift appear to be device change.
steps.check: 報告 6.02 dB 並保留參考面、波長和偏振。
steps.checkEn: Report 6.02 dB with reference planes, wavelength and polarization.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 損耗附波長、偏振與參考面；端到端數字不能冒充波導本身損耗。
knowledge.textEn: Loss requires wavelength, polarization and reference planes; end-to-end loss is not waveguide loss alone.

steps.instruction: 用三個長度資料擬合直線，檢查殘差。加入具有不同彎曲數的樣本，辨識額外幾何損耗。

steps.failure: 長波導有額外交叉時，斜率不再只含傳播損耗。
steps.failureEn: Extra crossings on longer paths contaminate the propagation slope.
steps.check: 分別報告 α、C、殘差與彎曲數。

steps.title: 區分光功率與接收器靈敏度
steps.objective: 在一致條件下算出 3 dB 並列未分配餘裕。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain 3 dB under matching conditions and list unallocated margins.
steps.instruction: 用同一格式列發射功率、總損耗與接收靈敏度，另列老化與不確定度餘裕。

steps.observation: 假設均為平均功率：+2 dBm 減 8 dB 得 −6 dBm，靈敏度 −9 dBm，原始餘裕 3 dB。

stages.descriptionEn: Six authored calculation and interpretation tasks. Examples are explicitly hypothetical; retain units, reference planes, model limits and acceptance evidence.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。

steps.title: 從溫度場積分光學相位
steps.titleEn: Integrate phase from a temperature field
steps.objective: 算出 0.730 rad 並註記固定幾何近似。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain 0.730 rad and state the fixed-geometry approximation.
steps.instruction: 把光路分成三段，列長度與溫升，用有效熱光係數相加，再另列熱膨脹項。
steps.instructionEn: Divide the path into three sections, tabulate lengths and temperature rises, sum using an effective thermo-optic coefficient and retain expansion separately.
steps.observation: 假設 L=1 mm、λ=1.55 µm、dneff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴/K、ΔT=1 K，固定幾何得 Δφ=0.730 rad；此係數不是通用 PDK 值。
steps.observationEn: Hypothetical L=1 mm, λ=1.55 µm, dneff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴/K and ΔT=1 K give Δφ=0.730 rad at fixed geometry; the coefficient is not universal PDK data.
steps.failure: 核心材料係數不等於有效模態係數，後者含包覆層與模場比例。
steps.failureEn: The core-material coefficient differs from the effective modal coefficient, which includes cladding and confinement.
steps.check: 算出 0.730 rad 並註記固定幾何近似。
steps.checkEn: Obtain 0.730 rad and state the fixed-geometry approximation.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: φ=(2π/λ)∫neff(s,T,σ)ds；非均勻熱點須沿光路積分，不能只讀封裝平均溫度。
knowledge.textEn: φ=(2π/λ)∫neff(s,T,σ)ds; nonuniform hotspots require path integration, not package-average temperature.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設 L=1 mm、λ=1.55 µm、dneff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴/K、ΔT=1 K，固定幾何得 Δφ=0.730 rad；此係數不是通用 PDK 值。 驗收：算出 0.730 rad 並註記固定幾何近似。
knowledge.textEn: Hypothetical L=1 mm, λ=1.55 µm, dneff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴/K and ΔT=1 K give Δφ=0.730 rad at fixed geometry; the coefficient is not universal PDK data. Acceptance: Obtain 0.730 rad and state the fixed-geometry approximation.

quiz.question: 檢查「從溫度場積分光學相位」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Integrate phase from a temperature field", which conclusion is supported?
options: 算出 0.730 rad 並註記固定幾何近似。
只需用封裝平均溫度便能保證局部相位。
mm 與 µm 可不換算直接相除。
optionsEn: Obtain 0.730 rad and state the fixed-geometry approximation.
Package-average temperature guarantees local phase.
Divide mm by µm without unit conversion.
quiz.explanation: 假設 L=1 mm、λ=1.55 µm、dneff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴/K、ΔT=1 K，固定幾何得 Δφ=0.730 rad；此係數不是通用 PDK 值。 核心材料係數不等於有效模態係數，後者含包覆層與模場比例。
quiz.explanationEn: Hypothetical L=1 mm, λ=1.55 µm, dneff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴/K and ΔT=1 K give Δφ=0.730 rad at fixed geometry; the coefficient is not universal PDK data. The core-material coefficient differs from the effective modal coefficient, which includes cladding and confinement.

steps.title: 建立加熱器熱串擾矩陣
steps.objective: 保留非對角項並驗證 1.2 rad 聯合響應。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain off-diagonal terms and verify the 1.2 rad joint response.
steps.instruction: 一次擾動一個加熱器，記錄所有監測相位；用未參與擬合的雙加熱器組合驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Perturb one heater at a time and record all phases; validate using joint heater combinations excluded from fitting.
steps.observationEn: For hypothetical H=[[0.10,0.02],[0.02,0.10]] rad/mW and 10 mW on each heater, both phases shift 1.2 rad, not 1.0.
steps.failure: 單加熱器校正而忽略鄰居，會在同時工作時失準。
steps.failureEn: Calibration that ignores neighbors fails during simultaneous operation.
steps.check: 保留非對角項並驗證 1.2 rad 聯合響應。
steps.checkEn: Retain off-diagonal terms and verify the 1.2 rad joint response.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 小訊號 Δφ=HΔP；對角項是本地效率，非對角項是熱串擾，適用於指定工作點附近。
knowledge.textEn: Small-signal Δφ=HΔP has local efficiency on the diagonal and crosstalk off diagonal, valid near a stated operating point.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設 H=[[0.10,0.02],[0.02,0.10]] rad/mW，各輸入 10 mW，兩個相位均改變 1.2 rad，而非 1.0。 驗收：保留非對角項並驗證 1.2 rad 聯合響應。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical H=[[0.10,0.02],[0.02,0.10]] rad/mW and 10 mW on each heater, both phases shift 1.2 rad, not 1.0. Acceptance: Retain off-diagonal terms and verify the 1.2 rad joint response.

quiz.question: 檢查「建立加熱器熱串擾矩陣」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？

保留非對角項並驗證 1.2 rad 聯合響應。
單獨校正即可免除聯合驗證。
optionsEn: All off-diagonal terms are noise and may be zeroed.
Retain off-diagonal terms and verify the 1.2 rad joint response.
Independent calibration eliminates joint verification.
quiz.explanation: 假設 H=[[0.10,0.02],[0.02,0.10]] rad/mW，各輸入 10 mW，兩個相位均改變 1.2 rad，而非 1.0。 單加熱器校正而忽略鄰居，會在同時工作時失準。
quiz.explanationEn: For hypothetical H=[[0.10,0.02],[0.02,0.10]] rad/mW and 10 mW on each heater, both phases shift 1.2 rad, not 1.0. Calibration that ignores neighbors fails during simultaneous operation.

steps.title: 檢查調諧解的功率可行性
steps.objective: 標示不可行，再以功率約束重新求解。
steps.objectiveEn: Flag infeasibility and solve again under power constraints.
steps.instruction: 用上一個 H 解目標 [1,0] rad，檢查功率上下限。若不可行，修改預偏壓或允許的共同相位再求解。
steps.instructionEn: Solve the previous H for target [1,0] rad and inspect power limits. If infeasible, change bias or permitted common phase and solve again.
steps.observation: 解為 P1=10.417 mW、P2=−2.083 mW；零偏壓不能直接實現。共同相位能否調整取決於系統功能。
steps.observationEn: The solution is P1=10.417 mW and P2=−2.083 mW, infeasible at zero bias. Whether common phase may change depends on the system.
steps.failure: 把負值截為零而不重算，會留下第二通道相位誤差。
steps.failureEn: Clipping a negative value without recomputation leaves phase error on the second channel.
steps.check: 標示不可行，再以功率約束重新求解。
steps.checkEn: Flag infeasibility and solve again under power constraints.

knowledge.text: 矩陣可逆不等於物理可實現；加熱器通常不能從零偏壓提供負熱功率。
knowledge.textEn: Invertibility does not ensure physical feasibility; a heater generally cannot supply negative heat from zero bias.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 解為 P1=10.417 mW、P2=−2.083 mW；零偏壓不能直接實現。共同相位能否調整取決於系統功能。 驗收：標示不可行，再以功率約束重新求解。
knowledge.textEn: The solution is P1=10.417 mW and P2=−2.083 mW, infeasible at zero bias. Whether common phase may change depends on the system. Acceptance: Flag infeasibility and solve again under power constraints.

An invertible matrix makes every target realizable.

quiz.explanation: 解為 P1=10.417 mW、P2=−2.083 mW；零偏壓不能直接實現。共同相位能否調整取決於系統功能。 把負值截為零而不重算，會留下第二通道相位誤差。
quiz.explanationEn: The solution is P1=10.417 mW and P2=−2.083 mW, infeasible at zero bias. Whether common phase may change depends on the system. Clipping a negative value without recomputation leaves phase error on the second channel.

steps.title: 分離熱效率與動態響應
steps.objective: 同報 Pπ、τ、殘差與取樣率。
steps.objectiveEn: Report Pπ, τ, residuals and sampling rate together.
steps.instruction: 施加小功率階躍，擬合 φ(t)=φ∞(1−exp(−t/τ))，檢查早期與尾端殘差，再比較設計。

steps.observationEn: For hypothetical τ=20 µs, f3dB≈1/(2πτ)=7.96 kHz and 95% settling takes about 3τ=60 µs.
steps.failure: 只由 Pπ 推斷閉迴路頻寬會漏掉熱延遲與感測延遲。

steps.observation: 假設 100 Gb/s、10 s 零錯誤，N=10^12，上限約 3×10⁻¹²；要約 10⁻¹² 需 30 s。
steps.observationEn: At a hypothetical 100 Gb/s for 10 s with zero errors, N=10^12 and the bound is about 3×10⁻¹²; about 30 s is needed for 10⁻¹².
steps.failure: 只報零錯誤會隱藏有限樣本與相關性問題。
steps.failureEn: Reporting only zero errors hides finite sampling and correlation.
steps.check: 提交錯誤數、位元數、時間及信賴假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit errors, bits, time and confidence assumptions.

knowledge.text: 零錯誤不是 BER=0；獨立稀有錯誤下，95% 單側上限近似 3/N。
knowledge.textEn: Zero errors do not mean BER=0; for independent rare errors the one-sided 95% bound is approximately 3/N.

knowledge.text: 假設 100 Gb/s、10 s 零錯誤，N=10^12，上限約 3×10⁻¹²；要約 10⁻¹² 需 30 s。 驗收：提交錯誤數、位元數、時間及信賴假設。

10 s 已證明 10⁻¹² 的 95% 上限。

Submit errors, bits, time and confidence assumptions.
Ten seconds establishes a 10⁻¹² bound at 95%.

steps.title: 注入 N−1 光路故障
steps.objective: 逐故障提交備援路與剩餘餘裕。
steps.objectiveEn: Submit the backup route and residual margin for each fault.
steps.instruction: 在原創圖逐一刪除鏈路或開關，重新求路並加總損耗、延遲與調諧功率。
steps.instructionEn: Remove each defined link or switch from an original graph, reroute and sum loss, delay and tuning power.
steps.observation: 假設主路 5 dB、備援 7 dB、預算 8 dB，備援餘裕只剩 1 dB；兩路共用唯一雷射便無法容忍其故障。
steps.observationEn: With hypothetical primary 5 dB, backup 7 dB and budget 8 dB, backup margin is 1 dB; one shared laser prevents tolerance of that laser's failure.
steps.failure: 畫兩條線卻不找共用失效點，不能證明 N−1。
steps.failureEn: Two lines without shared-fault analysis do not establish N−1.
steps.check: 逐故障提交備援路與剩餘餘裕。
steps.checkEn: Submit the backup route and residual margin for each fault.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: N−1 是指定元件集合中任一單一故障後仍達功能；必須列明集合及共用元件。
knowledge.textEn: N−1 means preserving function after one fault in a defined component set; specify that set and shared elements.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設主路 5 dB、備援 7 dB、預算 8 dB，備援餘裕只剩 1 dB；兩路共用唯一雷射便無法容忍其故障。 驗收：逐故障提交備援路與剩餘餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical primary 5 dB, backup 7 dB and budget 8 dB, backup margin is 1 dB; one shared laser prevents tolerance of that laser's failure. Acceptance: Submit the backup route and residual margin for each fault.

quiz.question: 檢查「注入 N−1 光路故障」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？

逐故障提交備援路與剩餘餘裕。
optionsEn: Two routes necessarily tolerate any single failure.
Connectivity alone suffices without loss budgeting.
Submit the backup route and residual margin for each fault.
quiz.explanation: 假設主路 5 dB、備援 7 dB、預算 8 dB，備援餘裕只剩 1 dB；兩路共用唯一雷射便無法容忍其故障。 畫兩條線卻不找共用失效點，不能證明 N−1。

steps.observation: 假設上限 20 mW、需求 24 mW，應標示 4 mW 不足；裁切命令不能等同光學鎖定。

steps.failure: 只有示意圖而缺單位和參考面，無法稽核。
steps.failureEn: Schematics without units or reference planes are unauditable.
steps.check: 另一人能重算損耗及相位並指出適用邊界。
steps.checkEn: A peer can reproduce loss and phase and identify validity limits.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 交付應讓他人以相同輸入重算，並區分預測、教學算例和實測。
knowledge.textEn: Handoff should enable recomputation from identical inputs and distinguish predictions, examples and measurements.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 最小封包包含有單位輸入、公式、假設、輸出圖、來源 URL 與未解議題；模擬不得標為量產實測。 驗收：另一人能重算損耗及相位並指出適用邊界。
knowledge.textEn: A minimal package includes inputs with units, formulas, assumptions, plots, source URLs and open issues; simulation must not be labeled production measurement. Acceptance: A peer can reproduce loss and phase and identify validity limits.

quiz.question: 檢查「交付可重現 CPO 設計審查」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Deliver a reproducible CPO review", which conclusion is supported?
options: 教學數據可改標為原廠量產資料。
只交渲染圖片，不需數值輸入。
另一人能重算損耗及相位並指出適用邊界。
optionsEn: Teaching data can be relabeled vendor production data.
Rendered images suffice without numeric inputs.
A peer can reproduce loss and phase and identify validity limits.
quiz.explanation: 最小封包包含有單位輸入、公式、假設、輸出圖、來源 URL 與未解議題；模擬不得標為量產實測。 只有示意圖而缺單位和參考面，無法稽核。
quiz.explanationEn: A minimal package includes inputs with units, formulas, assumptions, plots, source URLs and open issues; simulation must not be labeled production measurement. Schematics without units or reference planes are unauditable.

title: 晶圓對晶圓混合接合
summary: 36 項任務深入 W2W 混合接合：保留原 12 步，再以配對良率、二維對位、CMP 形貌、污染統計、熱機相容、Kelvin 電阻、串鏈與資格證據完成設計審查。
summaryEn: Thirty-six W2W hybrid-bonding tasks preserve the original twelve and add pairing yield, 2D overlay, CMP topography, contamination statistics, thermomechanical compatibility, Kelvin resistance, chains and qualification evidence.

stages.title: 界面與版圖
stages.description: 先界定成對晶圓、接點與驗證結構。
stages.descriptionEn: Define the paired wafers, contacts and verification structures.

steps.title: 界定混合接合的兩種功能
steps.titleEn: Define the two functions of hybrid bonding
steps.objective: 區別介電層支撐與金屬導通。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish dielectric attachment from metal conduction.
steps.instruction: 畫出兩片面對面的截面，將介電層接觸與銅接墊接觸分色。追蹤一條訊號跨越界面的路徑，指出哪些位置負責支撐、哪些位置必須導通。
steps.instructionEn: Draw face-to-face sections and color dielectric and copper contacts separately. Trace one signal across the interface, identifying mechanical attachment and required electrical continuity.
steps.observation: 整片看似貼合，並不表示每個銅接點已導通。
steps.observationEn: Apparent full-area attachment does not prove continuity through every copper contact.
steps.failure: 若把介電層畫成導線，重新檢查電流路徑與材料標記。
steps.failureEn: If dielectric is drawn as a wire, revisit the current path and material labels.
steps.check: 分別指定機械接合與電性接點的驗證方法。
steps.checkEn: Assign separate verification approaches to attachment and electrical contacts.

knowledge.title: 雙重界面
knowledge.text: 混合接合把介電層連接與嵌入金屬互連結合在同一界面。
knowledge.textEn: Hybrid bonding combines dielectric attachment and embedded metal interconnects at one interface.

knowledge.title: 功能分驗
knowledge.text: 機械完整與電性導通互相關聯，但不能互相替代驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical integrity and electrical continuity are related but need separate evidence.

quiz.question: 看見整片沒有分離，能證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What does observing that the wafers remain attached establish?
options: 提供機械貼合的部分證據，仍須電性驗證。
介電貼合強度已足以代表所有接觸電阻。
只要外圓重合，就證明每一接墊的隔離合格。
optionsEn: It provides some attachment evidence; electrical verification remains necessary.
Dielectric attachment strength fully represents every contact resistance.
Overlapping outlines prove isolation of every pad.
quiz.explanation: 提供機械貼合的部分證據，仍須電性驗證。 混合接合把介電層連接與嵌入金屬互連結合在同一界面。
quiz.explanationEn: It provides some attachment evidence; electrical verification remains necessary. Hybrid bonding combines dielectric attachment and embedded metal interconnects at one interface.

steps.title: 核對成對晶圓的版圖與方位
steps.objective: 避免面對面翻轉造成接點配對錯誤。
steps.objectiveEn: Prevent contact mismatches caused by face-to-face reversal.
steps.instruction: 在透明紙或繪圖軟體畫兩片含不對稱記號的晶圓。將上片翻面，逐一對應接墊與方向標記，再比較旋轉與鏡射的差異。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two wafers with asymmetric marks on transparent sheets or in drawing software. Flip the upper wafer and match pads and orientation marks, comparing rotation with reflection.
steps.observation: 對稱圖案可能掩蓋翻面錯誤，因此保留不對稱檢查點。
steps.observationEn: Symmetric patterns can hide a reversal error, so retain an asymmetric check.
steps.failure: 只對齊外圓卻錯配接墊時，應回到座標轉換，而非微調所有接點。
steps.failureEn: If wafer outlines align but pads mismatch, revisit coordinate transforms rather than adjust every contact.
steps.check: 用三個非共線標記驗證方向，並說明翻面後的接點對應。
steps.checkEn: Verify orientation with three non-collinear marks and explain pad correspondence after flipping.

knowledge.title: 座標轉換
knowledge.text: 面對面接合需要一致的翻面、旋轉與位移定義。
knowledge.textEn: Face-to-face bonding needs consistent definitions of reflection, rotation and translation.

knowledge.title: 不對稱標記
knowledge.text: 不對稱資訊能區分看似相同的錯誤方位。
knowledge.textEn: Asymmetric information distinguishes otherwise similar incorrect orientations.

quiz.question: 外圓重合但不對稱標記相反，優先檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Outlines overlap but asymmetric marks reverse. What should be checked first?
options: 只調整同一平移量，不檢查是否鏡射。
翻面與座標對應規則。
只看晶圓外圓，因為圖案方位不影響接點對應。
optionsEn: Apply one translation without checking for reflection.
The flip and coordinate-mapping rules.
Inspect the wafer outline only, assuming pattern orientation cannot affect matching.
quiz.explanation: 翻面與座標對應規則。 面對面接合需要一致的翻面、旋轉與位移定義。
quiz.explanationEn: The flip and coordinate-mapping rules. Face-to-face bonding needs consistent definitions of reflection, rotation and translation.

steps.title: 比較接墊尺寸與容許偏移
steps.titleEn: Compare pad size and overlay allowance
steps.objective: 理解接觸重疊與相鄰間距的共同限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand joint limits from contact overlap and neighbor spacing.
steps.instruction: 畫一組等尺寸接墊與一組上下不同尺寸接墊，逐次平移上層透明圖。記錄何時重疊不足或接近鄰點；所有尺寸自行假設，不能套用為製造規格。
steps.instructionEn: Draw equal-size and unequal-size pad pairs and translate the upper overlay. Record loss of overlap or approach to a neighbor; label all dimensions hypothetical, not manufacturing specifications.
steps.observation: 增加接墊大小可改善部分重疊，但也會改變相鄰間距。
steps.observationEn: Enlarging a pad can improve overlap while changing neighbor clearance.
steps.failure: 只最大化重疊而忽略鄰近接點，可能隱藏短路或介電風險。
steps.failureEn: Maximizing overlap while ignoring neighbors can conceal shorting or dielectric risk.
steps.check: 同時呈現重疊與間距兩項判據，並指出適用的偏移方向。
steps.checkEn: Show both overlap and clearance criteria and identify the displacement directions considered.

knowledge.title: 版圖容差
knowledge.text: 接墊形狀與相對尺寸會改變對位誤差的容忍度。
knowledge.textEn: Pad geometry and relative size affect tolerance to alignment error.

knowledge.title: 局部代價
knowledge.text: 幾何上的改良須連同鄰點間距和電性一起評估。
knowledge.textEn: A geometric improvement must be assessed with neighbor spacing and electrical behavior.

quiz.question: 為何不能無限制放大所有接墊？
quiz.questionEn: Why not enlarge every pad without limit?
options: 接墊加大只會改善重疊，不影響鄰近間距。
只要銅面積增加，就不需考慮介電隔離。
重疊改善可能消耗鄰點間距。
optionsEn: Enlarging pads improves overlap without affecting neighbor spacing.
More copper area removes the need to consider dielectric isolation.
Improved overlap can consume neighbor clearance.
quiz.explanation: 重疊改善可能消耗鄰點間距。 接墊形狀與相對尺寸會改變對位誤差的容忍度。
quiz.explanationEn: Improved overlap can consume neighbor clearance. Pad geometry and relative size affect tolerance to alignment error.

steps.title: 配置串鏈與隔離測試結構
steps.titleEn: Plan chain and isolation test structures
steps.objective: 讓開路與相鄰漏電能被分開發現。
steps.objectiveEn: Make opens and neighbor leakage separately observable.
steps.instruction: 在示意版圖串接多個跨界面接點，另畫相鄰但不相連的導體。預測單一開路、接觸電阻增加及鄰點短路，各會改變哪項測試結果。
steps.instructionEn: Chain multiple cross-interface contacts in a schematic and draw separate adjacent conductors. Predict which measurements change for an open, higher contact resistance or a neighbor short.
steps.observation: 串鏈只顯示累積路徑，未必能定位單一異常接點。
steps.observationEn: A chain exposes a cumulative path but may not localize one defective contact.
steps.failure: 把低串鏈電阻當作隔離合格會漏掉另一種故障；保留獨立隔離判據。
steps.failureEn: Treating low chain resistance as proof of isolation misses another failure class; retain a separate criterion.
steps.check: 建立故障、測試結構與可見現象的三欄對照。
steps.checkEn: Map each fault to a test structure and observable response.

knowledge.title: 可觀測性
knowledge.text: 測試結構必須讓想找的失效改變可讀取的量。
knowledge.textEn: A test structure must make the targeted failure affect an observable quantity.

knowledge.title: 累積與定位
knowledge.text: 整條串鏈的結果與單一接點的結果具有不同解析度。
knowledge.textEn: Whole-chain and individual-contact results have different diagnostic resolution.

quiz.question: 串鏈可導通，還需要哪類補充證據？
quiz.questionEn: A chain conducts. What complementary evidence is still useful?
options: 相鄰導體的隔離與漏電檢查。
只重複同一串鏈讀值，不需要不同測試結構。
只檢查機械接合強度便能排除相鄰短路。
optionsEn: Isolation and leakage checks between neighboring conductors.
Repeat the same chain reading; different test structures are unnecessary.
Mechanical bond strength alone rules out neighbor shorts.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰導體的隔離與漏電檢查。 測試結構必須讓想找的失效改變可讀取的量。
quiz.explanationEn: Isolation and leakage checks between neighboring conductors. A test structure must make the targeted failure affect an observable quantity.

stages.title: 表面與對位
stages.description: 區分表面幾何、表面狀態與面內對位的限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Separate limits from surface geometry, surface condition and in-plane alignment.

steps.title: 判讀 CMP 後的銅凹陷與介電平坦度
steps.titleEn: Interpret copper recess and dielectric flatness
steps.objective: 分開比較銅高度與介電面形貌。
steps.objectiveEn: Compare copper height separately from dielectric topography.
steps.instruction: 畫出銅突出、合適凹陷及過深凹陷三種假想截面，標出首先接觸的位置。比較它們對介電貼合與後續金屬連接的影響，不設定通用奈米公差。
steps.instructionEn: Draw hypothetical protruding, appropriately recessed and deeply recessed copper sections. Mark first-contact locations and compare dielectric attachment and later metal connection without assigning universal nanometer tolerances.
steps.observation: 全片平均平坦仍可能掩蓋某些接墊的局部高度問題。
steps.observationEn: Good average flatness can still hide local pad-height problems.
steps.failure: 把所有材料畫成完全齊平，可能遺失研究流程所需的受控凹陷；回查來源路線。
steps.failureEn: Drawing every material perfectly flush can erase the controlled recess required by the referenced route; review its assumptions.
steps.check: 說明三種截面的不同風險，且將量產公差保留為待查規格。
steps.checkEn: Explain the distinct risks and leave production tolerances as requirements to obtain.

knowledge.title: 受控形貌
knowledge.text: 接合前形貌須同時配合介電接觸及後續銅連接。
knowledge.textEn: Prebond topography must accommodate both dielectric contact and subsequent copper connection.

knowledge.title: 局部高度
knowledge.text: 銅凹陷相對於鄰近介電面定義，不能只看晶圓平均厚度。
knowledge.textEn: Copper recess is relative to nearby dielectric, not merely average wafer thickness.

quiz.question: 銅凹陷應相對於哪個基準判讀？
quiz.questionEn: What reference defines copper recess?
options: 整片晶圓背面的平均平面。
相鄰介電表面。
尚未拋光前的總銅沉積厚度。
optionsEn: The average plane of the wafer backside.
The adjacent dielectric surface.
Total copper thickness before polishing.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰介電表面。 接合前形貌須同時配合介電接觸及後續銅連接。
quiz.explanationEn: The adjacent dielectric surface. Prebond topography must accommodate both dielectric contact and subsequent copper connection.

steps.title: 追溯清潔、活化與等待時間
steps.objective: 將表面狀態與後續接合條件連接。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect surface condition to subsequent bonding conditions.
steps.instruction: 建立清潔、表面活化、等待與接合的時間線，為兩條假設路徑標記暴露及搬運點。比較粒子控制與活化目的，不推定兩者可互相取代。
steps.instructionEn: Build timelines for cleaning, activation, waiting and bonding, marking exposure and handling in two hypothetical routes. Compare particle control with activation without treating them as interchangeable.
steps.observation: 兩片幾何相同的表面，仍可能因狀態或污染不同而表現不同。
steps.observationEn: Geometrically similar surfaces can behave differently because of condition or contamination.
steps.failure: 缺少交接時間紀錄時，不能把不良全歸因於對位。
steps.failureEn: Without handoff timing records, do not attribute all failures to overlay.
steps.check: 時間線包含每次表面暴露與可追溯的狀態紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Include each exposure and a traceable surface-condition record.

knowledge.title: 表面功能
knowledge.text: 介電層直接接合依賴適當的表面狀態，不只是兩片相碰。
knowledge.textEn: Direct dielectric bonding depends on suitable surface condition, not merely physical contact.

knowledge.title: 交接窗口
knowledge.text: 等待和搬運也是流程條件，應與清潔及活化一起記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Waiting and handling are process conditions that belong with cleaning and activation records.

quiz.question: 活化後延長等待，為何仍需重新核對接合條件？
quiz.questionEn: Why review bonding conditions after a longer post-activation wait?
options: 只要對位精度相同，表面暴露時間就不影響判定。
等待越久必然接合越強，不需檢查表面狀態。
表面狀態和暴露歷程可能改變。
optionsEn: Equal overlay accuracy makes surface-exposure time irrelevant.
A longer wait always strengthens bonding without checking surface condition.
Surface condition and exposure history may change.
quiz.explanation: 表面狀態和暴露歷程可能改變。 介電層直接接合依賴適當的表面狀態，不只是兩片相碰。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface condition and exposure history may change. Direct dielectric bonding depends on suitable surface condition, not merely physical contact.

steps.title: 分離平移、旋轉與變形誤差
steps.objective: 用多位置標記判斷對位誤差模式。
steps.objectiveEn: Diagnose overlay-error patterns from multiple marks.
steps.instruction: 在中心與四個外圍位置畫誤差箭頭，分別建立同向、繞中心旋轉及局部不規則三個案例。嘗試以一個平移修正各案例，觀察哪些殘差無法消除。
steps.instructionEn: Draw overlay vectors at the center and four outer positions for translation, rotation and irregular local distortion. Apply one translation correction to each and identify residuals it cannot remove.
steps.observation: 中心對好仍可能在邊緣有旋轉或形變殘差。
steps.observationEn: Good center alignment can coexist with rotational or distortion residuals at the edge.
steps.failure: 只用單一標記決定全片合格會忽略誤差模式；增加空間取樣。
steps.failureEn: One-mark acceptance overlooks error structure; add spatial sampling.
steps.check: 將每種誤差對應到可修正部分與待調查部分。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish correctable components from residuals requiring investigation.

knowledge.title: 誤差場
knowledge.text: 對位是一個空間分布，不只是單一偏移值。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay is a spatial field, not just one offset.

knowledge.title: 剛體限制
knowledge.text: 平移與旋轉不能完全補償所有局部變形。
knowledge.textEn: Translation and rotation cannot fully compensate every local distortion.

quiz.question: 平移後中心已對齊但邊緣仍繞中心偏轉，較像哪種誤差？
quiz.questionEn: Translation fixes the center but edge vectors remain rotational. What does this suggest?
options: 仍有旋轉分量。
單純固定方向的平移，中心結果足以代表全片。
一定是所有接墊同等加寬，無需檢查對位模型。
optionsEn: A remaining rotational component.
Pure fixed-direction translation, with center results representing the entire wafer.
Every pad must have widened equally, requiring no alignment-model review.
quiz.explanation: 仍有旋轉分量。 對位是一個空間分布，不只是單一偏移值。
quiz.explanationEn: A remaining rotational component. Overlay is a spatial field, not just one offset.

steps.title: 規劃接合前的雙面放行
steps.objective: 防止只檢查其中一片晶圓。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid checking only one member of the wafer pair.
steps.instruction: 為上下晶圓各建一張表，列出身分、方位、形貌、污染與等待歷程。挑選一項缺失資料，討論它如何影響整對晶圓的放行，而非以另一片的結果補值。
steps.instructionEn: Make separate records for wafer identity, orientation, topography, contamination and waiting history. Remove one item and explain how that affects pair release rather than substituting the other wafer’s result.
steps.observation: 接合是成對事件，單片合格不等於配對與界面均合格。
steps.observationEn: Bonding is a paired event; one acceptable wafer does not prove a valid pair or interface.
steps.failure: 批次或方位配對錯誤不能靠後段退火修正。
steps.failureEn: Annealing cannot repair an incorrect lot or orientation pairing.
steps.check: 放行表可從接合批次追溯到兩片來料及各自量測。
steps.checkEn: Trace the bonded lot to both incoming wafers and their individual measurements.

knowledge.title: 配對追溯
knowledge.text: 兩側輸入共同決定接合界面品質。
knowledge.textEn: Both inputs jointly determine interface quality.

knowledge.title: 缺值處理
knowledge.text: 另一片的好結果不能補足本片缺少的證據。
knowledge.textEn: A good result from one wafer cannot fill an evidence gap for the other.

quiz.question: 上片形貌合格、下片未量測，正確結論為何？
quiz.questionEn: The upper wafer passes topography checks but the lower is unmeasured. What follows?
options: 下片可沿用上片結果，因為兩片目標規格相同。
整對晶圓仍待驗證。
對位設備型號相同，就不需要下片形貌證據。
optionsEn: The lower wafer can inherit the upper result because target specifications match.
The pair remains unverified.
The same aligner model removes the need for lower-wafer topography evidence.
quiz.explanation: 整對晶圓仍待驗證。 兩側輸入共同決定接合界面品質。
quiz.explanationEn: The pair remains unverified. Both inputs jointly determine interface quality.

stages.title: 接合與驗證
stages.description: 結合機械、空洞與電性證據，避免只用外觀判定接合成功。
stages.descriptionEn: Combine mechanical, void and electrical evidence rather than judge a bond by appearance.

steps.title: 觀察接合波與未接合區域
steps.titleEn: Observe the bond wave and unbonded regions
steps.objective: 把接觸傳播與空洞證據連結。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate contact propagation to void evidence.
steps.instruction: 在原創示意圖畫出由起始接觸點擴展的接合前緣，再加入一個粒子與一個局部形貌障礙。預測可能留下的未接合區，與來源影像中的觀察方法比較。
steps.instructionEn: Draw an original bond front spreading from initial contact, then add one particle and one local topographic obstacle. Predict unbonded regions and compare the observation approach with referenced imagery.
steps.observation: 前緣通過與界面完全無空洞是不同判斷。
steps.observationEn: Passage of a bond front is not the same conclusion as a void-free interface.
steps.failure: 若只保存最終外觀，可能缺少判斷缺陷起源的時間資訊。
steps.failureEn: Keeping only the final appearance may lose timing needed to diagnose defect origins.
steps.check: 標記預測區域、可檢查的方法及不能由示意圖證明的部分。
steps.checkEn: Mark predicted regions, an inspection approach and what the schematic cannot prove.

knowledge.title: 接觸傳播
knowledge.text: 表面接觸可沿界面擴展，局部障礙會影響完整貼合。
knowledge.textEn: Contact can propagate along the interface, while local obstacles affect complete attachment.

knowledge.title: 空洞定位
knowledge.text: 缺陷位置需與前處理和形貌紀錄交叉比較。
knowledge.textEn: Defect locations should be compared with preparation and topography records.

quiz.question: 模型顯示接合前緣已到邊緣，仍需檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: The modeled bond front reaches the edge. What still needs checking?
options: 只需確認接觸前緣速度，無需檢查內部區域。
只量測外圓厚度，就可取代界面檢查。
界面內是否殘留未接合區。
optionsEn: Only bond-front speed needs checking, not interior regions.
Edge thickness alone replaces interface inspection.
Whether unbonded regions remain inside the interface.
quiz.explanation: 界面內是否殘留未接合區。 表面接觸可沿界面擴展，局部障礙會影響完整貼合。
quiz.explanationEn: Whether unbonded regions remain inside the interface. Contact can propagate along the interface, while local obstacles affect complete attachment.

steps.title: 判讀退火對介電層與銅連接的作用
steps.titleEn: Interpret annealing of dielectric and copper bonds
steps.objective: 區分初始貼合與後續接合強化。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish initial attachment from subsequent bond strengthening.
steps.instruction: 用前後兩張截面圖標出預接合與退火後狀態，分別追蹤介電界面及銅接點。列出需向實際製程取得的熱預算與材料相容性資料，不填入通用溫度配方。
steps.instructionEn: Compare prebond and post-anneal sections, following dielectric interfaces and copper contacts separately. List thermal-budget and compatibility information needed from the actual process without inventing a universal temperature recipe.
steps.observation: 某條研究路線的可用條件不代表所有介電材料與金屬堆疊皆適用。
steps.observationEn: Conditions demonstrated for one research route do not apply automatically to every dielectric and metal stack.
steps.failure: 用提高溫度補償未知污染，可能增加其他損害而未處理根因。
steps.failureEn: Raising temperature to compensate for unknown contamination may add damage without addressing the cause.
steps.check: 說明退火前後需要不同證據，並保留產品熱限制。
steps.checkEn: Explain the evidence needed before and after annealing and retain product thermal constraints.

knowledge.title: 接合演變
knowledge.text: 初始貼合與永久介電、金屬接合的形成是不同階段。
knowledge.textEn: Initial attachment and development of permanent dielectric and metal bonds are distinct stages.

knowledge.title: 熱預算相容性
knowledge.text: 接合條件須與先前完成的元件和互連相容。
knowledge.textEn: Bonding conditions must remain compatible with existing devices and interconnects.

quiz.question: 能否把研究文章中的退火條件直接當所有產品配方？
quiz.questionEn: Can an article’s anneal condition become the recipe for every product?
options: 不能，材料、堆疊與熱預算需分別核對。
能，只要研究和產品使用相同晶圓直徑。
能，所有既有互連對接合熱歷程的承受能力相同。
optionsEn: No; materials, stacks and thermal budgets need separate review.
Yes, if research and product wafer diameters match.
Yes; all existing interconnects tolerate the same bonding thermal history.
quiz.explanation: 不能，材料、堆疊與熱預算需分別核對。 初始貼合與永久介電、金屬接合的形成是不同階段。
quiz.explanationEn: No; materials, stacks and thermal budgets need separate review. Initial attachment and development of permanent dielectric and metal bonds are distinct stages.

steps.title: 交叉判讀空洞、串鏈與接點電阻
steps.titleEn: Cross-check voids, chains and contact resistance
steps.objective: 避免單一測試掩蓋不同失效模式。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid allowing one test to conceal other failure modes.
steps.instruction: 製作四個紙上案例：外觀正常但串鏈開路、可導通但局部空洞、阻值偏高及各項一致。為每例選擇下一個能縮小原因範圍的量測，而非立即重工。
steps.instructionEn: Create paper cases with a normal appearance but open chain, conduction with local voids, elevated resistance and consistent results. Choose the next discriminating measurement before proposing rework.
steps.observation: 不同證據可能互補，也可能揭露取樣範圍不一致。
steps.observationEn: Different evidence can complement itself or reveal inconsistent sampling coverage.
steps.failure: 若把測到一條好串鏈擴大成整片合格，需回查測試覆蓋率。
steps.failureEn: If one good chain becomes a claim about the entire wafer, revisit coverage.
steps.check: 每個異常結論均指出測試覆蓋範圍及尚未排除的原因。
steps.checkEn: State test coverage and remaining possible causes for every abnormal conclusion.

knowledge.title: 多物理驗證
knowledge.text: 機械界面與電性路徑需要交叉驗證，才能縮小失效原因。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical interface and electrical-path evidence must be combined to narrow causes.

knowledge.title: 取樣覆蓋
knowledge.text: 局部良好結果不等於未量測區域已被證明良好。
knowledge.textEn: A good local result does not establish the condition of unmeasured regions.

quiz.question: 一條串鏈正常但附近影像有空洞，最佳解讀是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: One chain passes but nearby imaging shows a void. What is the best interpretation?
options: 串鏈導通已足以排除所有機械界面缺陷。
兩種測試覆蓋與失效敏感性不同，需交叉定位。
有局部空洞便可認定整片每個接點都開路。
optionsEn: Chain continuity rules out every mechanical-interface defect.
Coverage and failure sensitivity differ; correlate their locations.
One local void proves every wafer contact is open.
quiz.explanation: 兩種測試覆蓋與失效敏感性不同，需交叉定位。 機械界面與電性路徑需要交叉驗證，才能縮小失效原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Coverage and failure sensitivity differ; correlate their locations. Mechanical interface and electrical-path evidence must be combined to narrow causes.

steps.title: 建立接合批次的可靠度與交接表
steps.objective: 將製程條件、初始結果與後續變化連在一起。
steps.objectiveEn: Link process conditions, initial results and later changes.
steps.instruction: 把配對識別、對位地圖、形貌、接合紀錄及初始電性放入一張交接表。再加入假設的應力前後結果，區分初始缺陷和隨時間出現的劣化。
steps.instructionEn: Combine pairing, overlay, topography, bond history and initial electrical results in a handoff sheet. Add hypothetical before-and-after stress results to distinguish initial defects from later degradation.
steps.observation: 初始可導通不代表經應力後仍維持相同表現。
steps.observationEn: Initial continuity does not guarantee unchanged behavior after stress.
steps.failure: 沒有初始基線便難以判斷變化；先補足基線與樣本對應。
steps.failureEn: Without a baseline, change is hard to judge; restore baseline and sample correspondence.
steps.check: 為放行、複查與後續可靠度驗證各列出條件，不宣稱教學模型已證明量產可靠度。
steps.checkEn: Define release, review and later reliability conditions without claiming that the teaching model proves production reliability.

knowledge.title: 基線比較
knowledge.text: 可靠度觀察需要把同一樣本的初始與後續證據連接。
knowledge.textEn: Reliability observations need a link between the same sample’s initial and later evidence.

knowledge.title: 工程交接
knowledge.text: 後段薄化、互連與測試需知道接合界面的限制與未解問題。
knowledge.textEn: Later thinning, interconnect and test operations need interface limits and unresolved issues.

quiz.question: 為何保留應力測試前的電性基線？
quiz.questionEn: Why retain electrical results from before a stress test?
options: 用基線直接代替所有應力後量測。
只比較不同批次的最終平均值，不追蹤同一樣本。
用來識別後續變化，而不只看最終數字。
optionsEn: Substitute the baseline for every post-stress measurement.
Compare only final averages from different lots without tracking the same sample.
To identify change rather than view only a final number.
quiz.explanation: 用來識別後續變化，而不只看最終數字。 可靠度觀察需要把同一樣本的初始與後續證據連接。
quiz.explanationEn: To identify change rather than view only a final number. Reliability observations need a link between the same sample’s initial and later evidence.

stages.title: 配對良率與二維對位
stages.description: 六項原創工程推算與判讀任務。算例皆為明示假設，需保留單位、參考面、模型範圍與驗收證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Six authored calculation and interpretation tasks. Examples are explicitly hypothetical; retain units, reference planes, model limits and acceptance evidence.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。
steps.sourceScopeEn: Sources support public principles and research context; numbers, criteria, sequence and quizzes are authored teaching work, not vendor production parameters.
steps.title: 比較整片配對與良品晶粒組合
steps.titleEn: Compare wafer pairing and known-good-die assembly
steps.objective: 同報地圖交集與獨立模型，指出兩者差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Report both map intersection and the independence model, explaining differences.
steps.instruction: 畫兩張 4×4 良率地圖，對位後計算共同良品，再思考 D2W 可重配的範圍和限制。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two 4×4 yield maps, align them and count jointly good positions, then assess D2W remapping possibilities and constraints.
steps.observation: 假設上下片每位置良率 90% 且獨立、接合存活率 98%，共同良品率=0.9²×0.98=79.38%；有空間相關時不能直接套用。
steps.observationEn: Assuming independent 90% die yield on each wafer and 98% bond survival gives 0.9²×0.98=79.38%; spatial correlation invalidates direct use.
steps.failure: 忽略上下晶圓地圖相關性會使成本估算失真。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring cross-wafer map correlation distorts cost estimates.
steps.check: 同報地圖交集與獨立模型，指出兩者差異。
steps.checkEn: Report both map intersection and the independence model, explaining differences.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: W2W 同時接合整片對應位置；D2W 可挑選晶粒，但增加切割、搬運與放置負擔。
knowledge.textEn: W2W bonds corresponding wafer positions together; D2W can select dies but adds singulation, handling and placement burdens.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設上下片每位置良率 90% 且獨立、接合存活率 98%，共同良品率=0.9²×0.98=79.38%；有空間相關時不能直接套用。 驗收：同報地圖交集與獨立模型，指出兩者差異。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming independent 90% die yield on each wafer and 98% bond survival gives 0.9²×0.98=79.38%; spatial correlation invalidates direct use. Acceptance: Report both map intersection and the independence model, explaining differences.

quiz.question: 檢查「比較整片配對與良品晶粒組合」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Compare wafer pairing and known-good-die assembly", which conclusion is supported?
options: 同報地圖交集與獨立模型，指出兩者差異。
D2W 挑良品不會增加任何搬運風險。
optionsEn: Report both map intersection and the independence model, explaining differences.
Pairing two 90% wafers necessarily yields 90%.
D2W selection adds no handling risks.
quiz.explanation: 假設上下片每位置良率 90% 且獨立、接合存活率 98%，共同良品率=0.9²×0.98=79.38%；有空間相關時不能直接套用。 忽略上下晶圓地圖相關性會使成本估算失真。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming independent 90% die yield on each wafer and 98% bond survival gives 0.9²×0.98=79.38%; spatial correlation invalidates direct use. Ignoring cross-wafer map correlation distorts cost estimates.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。
steps.sourceScopeEn: Sources support public principles and research context; numbers, criteria, sequence and quizzes are authored teaching work, not vendor production parameters.
steps.title: 將對位誤差表示為向量
steps.objective: 同報向量圖、偏置及半徑分布。
steps.objectiveEn: Report the vector map, bias and radial distribution.
steps.instruction: 將各測點 dx、dy 畫成向量場，算 r=√(dx²+dy²)，區分平均偏置與殘差。
steps.instructionEn: Plot dx and dy as a vector field, calculate r=√(dx²+dy²), and separate mean bias from residuals.
steps.observation: 假設 dx=30 nm、dy=40 nm，r=50 nm；兩個方向都小於 45 nm，仍不符合自訂 r≤45 nm。
steps.observationEn: Hypothetical dx=30 nm and dy=40 nm give r=50 nm; both axes are below 45 nm but fail an authored radial limit r≤45 nm.
steps.failure: 只看平均向量接近零會掩蓋正負誤差相消。
steps.failureEn: A near-zero mean vector can hide cancellation of positive and negative errors.
steps.check: 同報向量圖、偏置及半徑分布。
steps.checkEn: Report the vector map, bias and radial distribution.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: X/Y 誤差與徑向誤差有不同統計分布，不能把單軸門檻直接當二維半徑門檻。
knowledge.textEn: X/Y errors and radial error have different distributions; a one-axis limit is not a two-dimensional radial limit.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設 dx=30 nm、dy=40 nm，r=50 nm；兩個方向都小於 45 nm，仍不符合自訂 r≤45 nm。 驗收：同報向量圖、偏置及半徑分布。
knowledge.textEn: Hypothetical dx=30 nm and dy=40 nm give r=50 nm; both axes are below 45 nm but fail an authored radial limit r≤45 nm. Acceptance: Report the vector map, bias and radial distribution.

quiz.question: 檢查「將對位誤差表示為向量」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Represent overlay as a vector", which conclusion is supported?
options: 兩軸各小於 45 nm 就保證半徑小於 45 nm。
同報向量圖、偏置及半徑分布。
平均零等於每點零誤差。
optionsEn: Both axes below 45 nm guarantee radius below 45 nm.
Report the vector map, bias and radial distribution.
Zero mean implies zero error at every point.
quiz.explanation: 假設 dx=30 nm、dy=40 nm，r=50 nm；兩個方向都小於 45 nm，仍不符合自訂 r≤45 nm。 只看平均向量接近零會掩蓋正負誤差相消。
quiz.explanationEn: Hypothetical dx=30 nm and dy=40 nm give r=50 nm; both axes are below 45 nm but fail an authored radial limit r≤45 nm. A near-zero mean vector can hide cancellation of positive and negative errors.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。
steps.sourceScopeEn: Sources support public principles and research context; numbers, criteria, sequence and quizzes are authored teaching work, not vendor production parameters.
steps.title: 拆出旋轉造成的邊緣位移
steps.objective: 保留 θ 的弧度單位與邊緣預測值。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain θ in radians and predicted edge displacement.
steps.instruction: 以中心和邊緣對位標記擬合旋轉，將剛體旋轉從向量場扣除再看局部殘差。
steps.instructionEn: Fit rotation using center and edge marks, subtract rigid rotation and inspect local residuals.
steps.observation: 假設半徑 100 mm、旋轉 1 µrad，邊緣位移 100 nm；中心標記幾乎不動不能證明全片合格。
steps.observationEn: At hypothetical radius 100 mm and rotation 1 µrad, edge shift is 100 nm; a nearly fixed center does not prove whole-wafer compliance.
steps.failure: 僅用中心標記校正會漏掉角度誤差。
steps.failureEn: Center-only alignment misses rotational error.
steps.check: 保留 θ 的弧度單位與邊緣預測值。
steps.checkEn: Retain θ in radians and predicted edge displacement.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 小旋轉造成的切向位移約 rθ，距中心越遠越敏感。
knowledge.textEn: A small rotation causes tangential displacement approximately rθ, increasing away from the center.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設半徑 100 mm、旋轉 1 µrad，邊緣位移 100 nm；中心標記幾乎不動不能證明全片合格。 驗收：保留 θ 的弧度單位與邊緣預測值。
knowledge.textEn: At hypothetical radius 100 mm and rotation 1 µrad, edge shift is 100 nm; a nearly fixed center does not prove whole-wafer compliance. Acceptance: Retain θ in radians and predicted edge displacement.

quiz.question: 檢查「拆出旋轉造成的邊緣位移」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Separate rotation-induced edge displacement", which conclusion is supported?
options: 1 µrad 在所有半徑造成同樣位移。
中心對準即可免查邊緣。
保留 θ 的弧度單位與邊緣預測值。
optionsEn: 1 µrad produces equal displacement at every radius.
Center alignment removes the need to check edges.
Retain θ in radians and predicted edge displacement.
quiz.explanation: 假設半徑 100 mm、旋轉 1 µrad，邊緣位移 100 nm；中心標記幾乎不動不能證明全片合格。 僅用中心標記校正會漏掉角度誤差。
quiz.explanationEn: At hypothetical radius 100 mm and rotation 1 µrad, edge shift is 100 nm; a nearly fixed center does not prove whole-wafer compliance. Center-only alignment misses rotational error.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。
steps.sourceScopeEn: Sources support public principles and research context; numbers, criteria, sequence and quizzes are authored teaching work, not vendor production parameters.
steps.title: 區別倍率與局部變形
steps.titleEn: Distinguish scale error from local distortion
steps.objective: 提交擬合係數與扣除後殘差。
steps.objectiveEn: Submit fitted coefficients and post-fit residuals.
steps.instruction: 擬合平移、旋轉、倍率及正交項，再畫剩餘向量，保留未被模型描述的高階形變。
steps.instructionEn: Fit translation, rotation, scale and orthogonality, then plot residual vectors and retain higher-order distortion outside the model.
steps.observation: 假設倍率差 1 ppm、r=100 mm，徑向差 100 nm；與 1 µrad 旋轉量級相同但方向不同。
steps.observationEn: A hypothetical 1 ppm scale mismatch at r=100 mm gives 100 nm radial error, comparable in magnitude to 1 µrad rotation but different in direction.
steps.failure: 只報全片 RMS 無法區分可校正的倍率與局部缺陷。
steps.failureEn: Whole-wafer RMS alone cannot distinguish correctable scale from local defects.
steps.check: 提交擬合係數與扣除後殘差。
steps.checkEn: Submit fitted coefficients and post-fit residuals.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 倍率誤差產生隨半徑增加的徑向位移；局部非線性變形無法靠一個平移完全修正。
knowledge.textEn: Scale error produces radial displacement increasing with radius; local nonlinear distortion cannot be removed by one translation.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設倍率差 1 ppm、r=100 mm，徑向差 100 nm；與 1 µrad 旋轉量級相同但方向不同。 驗收：提交擬合係數與扣除後殘差。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 1 ppm scale mismatch at r=100 mm gives 100 nm radial error, comparable in magnitude to 1 µrad rotation but different in direction. Acceptance: Submit fitted coefficients and post-fit residuals.

quiz.question: 檢查「區別倍率與局部變形」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Distinguish scale error from local distortion", which conclusion is supported?
options: 提交擬合係數與扣除後殘差。
調一個平移量能消除全片倍率差。
徑向與切向向量代表同一誤差機制。
optionsEn: Submit fitted coefficients and post-fit residuals.
One translation removes wafer-scale mismatch.
Radial and tangential vectors indicate the same mechanism.
quiz.explanation: 假設倍率差 1 ppm、r=100 mm，徑向差 100 nm；與 1 µrad 旋轉量級相同但方向不同。 只報全片 RMS 無法區分可校正的倍率與局部缺陷。
quiz.explanationEn: A hypothetical 1 ppm scale mismatch at r=100 mm gives 100 nm radial error, comparable in magnitude to 1 µrad rotation but different in direction. Whole-wafer RMS alone cannot distinguish correctable scale from local defects.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。
steps.sourceScopeEn: Sources support public principles and research context; numbers, criteria, sequence and quizzes are authored teaching work, not vendor production parameters.
steps.title: 計算接墊重疊與對位窗口
steps.titleEn: Calculate pad overlap and overlay window
steps.objective: 報告 72% 並列仍需接觸電阻驗證。
steps.objectiveEn: Report 72% and retain contact-resistance verification.
steps.instruction: 以兩個等大方形接墊作教學模型，逐次改變 dx、dy，計算重疊比例並標明模型不是原廠版圖。
steps.instructionEn: Use two equal square pads as a teaching model, sweep dx and dy, calculate overlap fraction and identify the layout as authored.
steps.observationEn: Hypothetical 1 µm squares with dx=0.2 µm and dy=0.1 µm overlap by (1−0.2)(1−0.1)=0.72 µm², or 72%.
steps.failure: 以圓形接墊套用方形面積公式會得到錯誤窗口。
steps.failureEn: Applying the square formula to round pads gives an incorrect window.
steps.check: 報告 72% 並列仍需接觸電阻驗證。
steps.checkEn: Report 72% and retain contact-resistance verification.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 重疊面積影響接觸機會，但電阻還受界面品質影響；幾何重疊不是完整電性驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Overlap affects contact opportunity, but resistance also depends on interface quality; geometry alone is not electrical validation.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設邊長 1 µm、dx=0.2 µm、dy=0.1 µm，重疊=(1−0.2)(1−0.1)=0.72 µm²，即 72%。 驗收：報告 72% 並列仍需接觸電阻驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Hypothetical 1 µm squares with dx=0.2 µm and dy=0.1 µm overlap by (1−0.2)(1−0.1)=0.72 µm², or 72%. Acceptance: Report 72% and retain contact-resistance verification.

quiz.question: 檢查「計算接墊重疊與對位窗口」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Calculate pad overlap and overlay window", which conclusion is supported?
options: 72% 重疊必然代表 72% 電性良率。
報告 72% 並列仍需接觸電阻驗證。
接墊放大可無限改善而沒有鄰點代價。
optionsEn: 72% overlap necessarily means 72% electrical yield.
Report 72% and retain contact-resistance verification.
Unlimited pad enlargement has no neighboring-pad penalty.
quiz.explanation: 假設邊長 1 µm、dx=0.2 µm、dy=0.1 µm，重疊=(1−0.2)(1−0.1)=0.72 µm²，即 72%。 以圓形接墊套用方形面積公式會得到錯誤窗口。
quiz.explanationEn: Hypothetical 1 µm squares with dx=0.2 µm and dy=0.1 µm overlap by (1−0.2)(1−0.1)=0.72 µm², or 72%. Applying the square formula to round pads gives an incorrect window.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。
steps.sourceScopeEn: Sources support public principles and research context; numbers, criteria, sequence and quizzes are authored teaching work, not vendor production parameters.
steps.title: 同時計算鄰點淨間距
steps.objective: 同圖標重疊和 0.7 µm 淨間距，另列電場評估。
steps.objectiveEn: Mark overlap and 0.7 µm clearance together and retain electric-field assessment.
steps.instruction: 畫三個相鄰方形接墊，沿最危險方向平移上層，計算對目標與鄰點的間距。
steps.instructionEn: Draw three adjacent square pads, translate the upper layer in the critical direction and compute intended and neighbor clearances.
steps.observation: 假設節距 2 µm、等寬 1 µm、偏移 0.3 µm，簡化同向幾何的鄰點最小邊距=2−1−0.3=0.7 µm。
steps.observationEn: For hypothetical 2 µm pitch, 1 µm equal widths and 0.3 µm shift, simplified directional neighbor clearance is 2−1−0.3=0.7 µm.
steps.failure: 只最大化重疊可能消耗介電隔離餘裕。
steps.failureEn: Maximizing overlap alone can consume dielectric isolation margin.
steps.check: 同圖標重疊和 0.7 µm 淨間距，另列電場評估。
steps.checkEn: Mark overlap and 0.7 µm clearance together and retain electric-field assessment.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 提升重疊和保留鄰近隔離是相互競爭的幾何需求，不能只檢查正確配對接點。
knowledge.textEn: Improving overlap competes with neighboring isolation; checking only intended pairs is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設節距 2 µm、等寬 1 µm、偏移 0.3 µm，簡化同向幾何的鄰點最小邊距=2−1−0.3=0.7 µm。 驗收：同圖標重疊和 0.7 µm 淨間距，另列電場評估。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical 2 µm pitch, 1 µm equal widths and 0.3 µm shift, simplified directional neighbor clearance is 2−1−0.3=0.7 µm. Acceptance: Mark overlap and 0.7 µm clearance together and retain electric-field assessment.

quiz.question: 檢查「同時計算鄰點淨間距」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Calculate neighboring-pad clearance", which conclusion is supported?
options: 只看目標重疊即可排除相鄰漏電。
0.7 µm 幾何間距直接證明所有電壓都安全。
同圖標重疊和 0.7 µm 淨間距，另列電場評估。
optionsEn: Intended overlap alone rules out neighbor leakage.
A 0.7 µm gap guarantees isolation at every voltage.
Mark overlap and 0.7 µm clearance together and retain electric-field assessment.
quiz.explanation: 假設節距 2 µm、等寬 1 µm、偏移 0.3 µm，簡化同向幾何的鄰點最小邊距=2−1−0.3=0.7 µm。 只最大化重疊可能消耗介電隔離餘裕。
quiz.explanationEn: For hypothetical 2 µm pitch, 1 µm equal widths and 0.3 µm shift, simplified directional neighbor clearance is 2−1−0.3=0.7 µm. Maximizing overlap alone can consume dielectric isolation margin.

stages.title: 表面形貌、污染與接合波
stages.description: 六項原創工程推算與判讀任務。算例皆為明示假設，需保留單位、參考面、模型範圍與驗收證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Six authored calculation and interpretation tasks. Examples are explicitly hypothetical; retain units, reference planes, model limits and acceptance evidence.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。
steps.sourceScopeEn: Sources support public principles and research context; numbers, criteria, sequence and quizzes are authored teaching work, not vendor production parameters.
steps.title: 區分粗糙度、凹陷與全片翹曲
steps.titleEn: Distinguish roughness, recess and wafer bow
steps.objective: 為三種尺度各指定獨立指標與量測方法。
steps.objectiveEn: Assign independent metrics and methods to all three scales.
steps.instruction: 為 AFM、輪廓或全片形貌各畫量測視窗，標明濾波及基準面，避免先濾掉欲檢查訊號。
steps.instructionEn: Draw measurement windows for AFM, profiling and wafer shape, specifying filters and reference planes without filtering away the target signal.
steps.observation: 教學例：1 µm 視窗的 0.2 nm RMS 與全片 20 µm bow 可同時存在；兩者不矛盾，也不能互相替代。
steps.observationEn: Teaching example: 0.2 nm RMS over a 1 µm window can coexist with 20 µm whole-wafer bow; neither contradicts nor replaces the other.
steps.failure: 小區域很平不代表整片能無缺陷接觸。
steps.failureEn: A locally smooth area does not guarantee defect-free whole-wafer contact.
steps.check: 為三種尺度各指定獨立指標與量測方法。
steps.checkEn: Assign independent metrics and methods to all three scales.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 奈米級表面粗糙、局部 Cu 凹陷與全片翹曲分属不同空間尺度，單一 RMS 不能同時描述。
knowledge.textEn: Nanoscale roughness, local Cu recess and wafer bow occur at different spatial scales; one RMS cannot describe them all.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 教學例：1 µm 視窗的 0.2 nm RMS 與全片 20 µm bow 可同時存在；兩者不矛盾，也不能互相替代。 驗收：為三種尺度各指定獨立指標與量測方法。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: 0.2 nm RMS over a 1 µm window can coexist with 20 µm whole-wafer bow; neither contradicts nor replaces the other. Acceptance: Assign independent metrics and methods to all three scales.

quiz.question: 檢查「區分粗糙度、凹陷與全片翹曲」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Distinguish roughness, recess and wafer bow", which conclusion is supported?
options: 為三種尺度各指定獨立指標與量測方法。
AFM RMS 合格即證明全片翹曲合格。
去除所有低頻成分後仍可直接量 bow。
optionsEn: Assign independent metrics and methods to all three scales.
Passing AFM RMS proves whole-wafer bow compliance.
Bow remains directly measurable after removing all low-frequency content.
quiz.explanation: 教學例：1 µm 視窗的 0.2 nm RMS 與全片 20 µm bow 可同時存在；兩者不矛盾，也不能互相替代。 小區域很平不代表整片能無缺陷接觸。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching example: 0.2 nm RMS over a 1 µm window can coexist with 20 µm whole-wafer bow; neither contradicts nor replaces the other. A locally smooth area does not guarantee defect-free whole-wafer contact.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。

steps.title: 建立銅凹陷分布而非單點值
steps.titleEn: Map copper recess rather than one point
steps.objective: 呈現分布和最差點，門檻標為教學假設。
steps.objectiveEn: Show distribution and worst point, labeling the threshold hypothetical.
steps.instruction: 對稀疏與密集接墊各取中心和邊緣掃描，保存原始剖面、平面扣除方法及異常值。
steps.instructionEn: Scan center and edge of sparse and dense pads and retain raw profiles, plane-removal method and outliers.
steps.observation: 假設凹陷量 2、3、4 nm，平均 3 nm 不代表每點都是 3；若自訂窗口 2–3.5 nm，4 nm 點仍不符合。
steps.observationEn: Hypothetical recess values 2, 3 and 4 nm average 3 nm, but a 4 nm point fails an authored 2–3.5 nm window.
steps.failure: 只以平均値放行會遮蔽局部過度凹陷。
steps.failureEn: Acceptance by average hides excessive local recess.
steps.check: 呈現分布和最差點，門檻標為教學假設。
steps.checkEn: Show distribution and worst point, labeling the threshold hypothetical.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 凹陷是 Cu 相對周圍介電層的高度差，需一致基準面、材料辨識和掃描位置。
knowledge.textEn: Recess is copper height relative to surrounding dielectric and requires a consistent plane, material identification and scan location.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設凹陷量 2、3、4 nm，平均 3 nm 不代表每點都是 3；若自訂窗口 2–3.5 nm，4 nm 點仍不符合。 驗收：呈現分布和最差點，門檻標為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Hypothetical recess values 2, 3 and 4 nm average 3 nm, but a 4 nm point fails an authored 2–3.5 nm window. Acceptance: Show distribution and worst point, labeling the threshold hypothetical.

quiz.question: 檢查「建立銅凹陷分布而非單點值」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Map copper recess rather than one point", which conclusion is supported?
options: 平均 3 nm 即代表所有點合格。
呈現分布和最差點，門檻標為教學假設。
凹陷可忽略介電基準直接讀絕對高度。
optionsEn: A 3 nm average means every point passes.
Show distribution and worst point, labeling the threshold hypothetical.
Recess can be read as absolute height without a dielectric reference.
quiz.explanation: 假設凹陷量 2、3、4 nm，平均 3 nm 不代表每點都是 3；若自訂窗口 2–3.5 nm，4 nm 點仍不符合。 只以平均値放行會遮蔽局部過度凹陷。
quiz.explanationEn: Hypothetical recess values 2, 3 and 4 nm average 3 nm, but a 4 nm point fails an authored 2–3.5 nm window. Acceptance by average hides excessive local recess.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。
steps.sourceScopeEn: Sources support public principles and research context; numbers, criteria, sequence and quizzes are authored teaching work, not vendor production parameters.
steps.title: 檢查圖形密度與 CMP 差異
steps.objective: 提出有前後量測與副作用檢查的 dummy 試驗。
steps.objectiveEn: Propose a dummy-layout experiment with before/after data and side-effect checks.
steps.instruction: 畫出相同晶粒內的稀疏、密集及 dummy 區，將高度差與密度圖疊合，控制量測尺度。
steps.instructionEn: Map sparse, dense and dummy regions on one die, overlay height differences and density, and control measurement scale.
steps.observation: 教學假設兩區金屬密度 20% 和 60%，即使全片平均膜厚相同，也不能推定局部接墊高度相同。
steps.observationEn: Hypothetical 20% and 60% metal-density regions can share wafer-average thickness yet have different local pad heights.
steps.failure: 增加 dummy 而不檢查電容、隔離和對位標記，可能引入其他問題。
steps.failureEn: Adding dummy metal without checking capacitance, isolation and marks may introduce other problems.
steps.check: 提出有前後量測與副作用檢查的 dummy 試驗。
steps.checkEn: Propose a dummy-layout experiment with before/after data and side-effect checks.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 局部金屬密度與特徵尺寸改變拋光接觸條件，可能造成凹陷與侵蝕的不同趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Local metal density and feature size change polishing contact conditions and can affect dishing and erosion differently.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 教學假設兩區金屬密度 20% 和 60%，即使全片平均膜厚相同，也不能推定局部接墊高度相同。 驗收：提出有前後量測與副作用檢查的 dummy 試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Hypothetical 20% and 60% metal-density regions can share wafer-average thickness yet have different local pad heights. Acceptance: Propose a dummy-layout experiment with before/after data and side-effect checks.

quiz.question: 檢查「檢查圖形密度與 CMP 差異」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Inspect pattern-density effects on CMP", which conclusion is supported?
options: 全片平均厚度等於局部平坦度。
dummy 只改機械性，永遠不影響電性。
提出有前後量測與副作用檢查的 dummy 試驗。
optionsEn: Wafer-average thickness equals local planarity.
Dummy metal affects mechanics only and never electrical behavior.
Propose a dummy-layout experiment with before/after data and side-effect checks.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設兩區金屬密度 20% 和 60%，即使全片平均膜厚相同，也不能推定局部接墊高度相同。 增加 dummy 而不檢查電容、隔離和對位標記，可能引入其他問題。
quiz.explanationEn: Hypothetical 20% and 60% metal-density regions can share wafer-average thickness yet have different local pad heights. Adding dummy metal without checking capacitance, isolation and marks may introduce other problems.

steps.sourceScopeEn: Sources support public principles and research context; numbers, criteria, sequence and quizzes are authored teaching work, not vendor production parameters.
steps.title: 從污染密度估算無缺陷機率
steps.objective: 標出獨立、均勻、致命比例三項假設。
steps.objectiveEn: State independence, uniformity and fatal-fraction assumptions.
steps.instruction: 選定有效接合面積，換算顆粒密度單位，再對密度與有效致命比例做敏感度分析。
steps.instructionEn: Choose effective bond area, convert particle-density units and sweep density and effective fatal fraction.
steps.observation: 假設 D=0.01/mm²、A=100 mm²，P0=e⁻¹=36.79%；這不是所有顆粒皆致命的實測結論，只是模型假設。
steps.observationEn: Hypothetical D=0.01/mm² and A=100 mm² give P0=e⁻¹=36.79%; fatality of every particle is an assumed model, not measured evidence.
steps.failure: 把顆粒計數直接轉電性良率而不辨粒徑位置，會過度簡化。
steps.failureEn: Converting particle count directly to electrical yield ignores size and location.
steps.check: 標出獨立、均勻、致命比例三項假設。
steps.checkEn: State independence, uniformity and fatal-fraction assumptions.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 簡化 Poisson 模型 P0=exp(−DA) 假設缺陷獨立且均勻；群聚污染需用空間地圖檢查。
knowledge.textEn: The simplified Poisson model P0=exp(−DA) assumes independent uniform defects; clusters require spatial-map checks.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設 D=0.01/mm²、A=100 mm²，P0=e⁻¹=36.79%；這不是所有顆粒皆致命的實測結論，只是模型假設。 驗收：標出獨立、均勻、致命比例三項假設。
knowledge.textEn: Hypothetical D=0.01/mm² and A=100 mm² give P0=e⁻¹=36.79%; fatality of every particle is an assumed model, not measured evidence. Acceptance: State independence, uniformity and fatal-fraction assumptions.

quiz.question: 檢查「從污染密度估算無缺陷機率」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Estimate defect-free probability from contamination", which conclusion is supported?
options: 標出獨立、均勻、致命比例三項假設。
P0=36.79% 是所有實際產品的已知良率。
群聚污染可不看地圖直接用同一模型。
optionsEn: State independence, uniformity and fatal-fraction assumptions.
36.79% is established yield for every actual product.
Clustered contamination needs no map-based check.
quiz.explanation: 假設 D=0.01/mm²、A=100 mm²，P0=e⁻¹=36.79%；這不是所有顆粒皆致命的實測結論，只是模型假設。 把顆粒計數直接轉電性良率而不辨粒徑位置，會過度簡化。
quiz.explanationEn: Hypothetical D=0.01/mm² and A=100 mm² give P0=e⁻¹=36.79%; fatality of every particle is an assumed model, not measured evidence. Converting particle count directly to electrical yield ignores size and location.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。
steps.sourceScopeEn: Sources support public principles and research context; numbers, criteria, sequence and quizzes are authored teaching work, not vendor production parameters.
steps.title: 規劃表面等待時間實驗
steps.objective: 提交隨機化表、混淆因子與量測指標。
steps.objectiveEn: Submit randomization, confounders and response metrics.
steps.instruction: 設短、中、長三組自訂等待時間，隨機化量測順序，記錄濕度、載具、清潔批次及接合後缺陷。
steps.instructionEn: Choose short, medium and long authored delays, randomize measurement order and log humidity, carriers, cleaning lot and post-bond defects.
steps.observation: 教學設計每組 5 試片共 15 片，只是比較計畫；不能在未量測前宣稱已找到製程窗口。
steps.observationEn: A teaching design of five coupons per delay uses 15 samples; it is an experiment plan, not evidence of a validated process window.
steps.failure: 把長等待組全放在同一天，可能將日期差誤認為等待效應。
steps.failureEn: Running all long-delay samples on one day confounds delay with day effects.
steps.check: 提交隨機化表、混淆因子與量測指標。
steps.checkEn: Submit randomization, confounders and response metrics.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 清潔或活化後的表面會隨環境與等待時間演變；時間、搬運和批次必須分開控制。
knowledge.textEn: Surfaces evolve after cleaning or activation with environment and delay; time, handling and lot must be controlled separately.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 教學設計每組 5 試片共 15 片，只是比較計畫；不能在未量測前宣稱已找到製程窗口。 驗收：提交隨機化表、混淆因子與量測指標。
knowledge.textEn: A teaching design of five coupons per delay uses 15 samples; it is an experiment plan, not evidence of a validated process window. Acceptance: Submit randomization, confounders and response metrics.

quiz.question: 檢查「規劃表面等待時間實驗」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Design a surface queue-time experiment", which conclusion is supported?
options: 未取得結果即可宣稱最短等待時間已合格。
提交隨機化表、混淆因子與量測指標。
等待組與批次完全重合不影響推論。
optionsEn: The shortest delay can be declared qualified before data exist.
Submit randomization, confounders and response metrics.
Perfect confounding of delay and lot does not affect inference.
quiz.explanation: 教學設計每組 5 試片共 15 片，只是比較計畫；不能在未量測前宣稱已找到製程窗口。 把長等待組全放在同一天，可能將日期差誤認為等待效應。
quiz.explanationEn: A teaching design of five coupons per delay uses 15 samples; it is an experiment plan, not evidence of a validated process window. Running all long-delay samples on one day confounds delay with day effects.

steps.sourceScope: 來源支持相關公開原理與研究背景；數值、判據、步序及選擇題為原創教學編排，並非原廠量產參數。
steps.sourceScopeEn: Sources support public principles and research context; numbers, criteria, sequence and quizzes are authored teaching work, not vendor production parameters.
steps.title: 判讀接合波前與未接合區域
steps.titleEn: Interpret bond-wave fronts and unbonded regions
steps.objective: 聯合波前、空洞圖與電性結果判讀。
steps.objectiveEn: Interpret fronts, void maps and electrical results together.
steps.instruction: 在原創時序圖標接觸起點、波前和邊緣排氣，將最終空洞位置與前段形貌疊合。
steps.instructionEn: Mark initiation, fronts and edge venting on an original time sequence, then overlay final voids with pre-bond shape.
steps.observation: 教學例：同樣 2 s 完成的兩片，一片中央空洞、一片無可見空洞；相同總時間不能證明相同品質。
steps.observationEn: Teaching example: two wafers finish in 2 s, but one has a central void and the other no visible void; equal duration does not prove equal quality.
steps.failure: 把波前到邊緣視為所有接點已導通，混淆機械接觸與電連接。
steps.failureEn: A front reaching the edge does not establish electrical continuity at every contact.

A front reaching the edge eliminates electrical tests.
Interpret fronts, void maps and electrical results together.
quiz.explanation: 教學例：同樣 2 s 完成的兩片，一片中央空洞、一片無可見空洞；相同總時間不能證明相同品質。 把波前到邊緣視為所有接點已導通，混淆機械接觸與電連接。

steps.title: 估算熱膨脹與銅凹陷閉合
steps.objective: 報告 1 nm 量級及自由膨脹假設的限制。

steps.observation: 假設 Δα=10 ppm/K、h=1 µm、ΔT=100 K，差動伸長約 1 nm；不能因此保證任何 1 nm 凹陷皆完成接合。

knowledge.textEn: Δh≈Δα·h·ΔT estimates free-expansion scale; embedded copper is constrained and may deform plastically, so it is not a general annealing recipe.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設 Δα=10 ppm/K、h=1 µm、ΔT=100 K，差動伸長約 1 nm；不能因此保證任何 1 nm 凹陷皆完成接合。 驗收：報告 1 nm 量級及自由膨脹假設的限制。

steps.title: 辨識破壞位置與接合能量
steps.titleEn: Identify fracture location and bond-energy evidence
steps.objective: 提交荷重曲線、幾何及破面分類。
steps.objectiveEn: Submit load curves, geometry and fracture classification.
steps.instruction: 畫裂紋路徑並記錄界面、介電或矽內破壞，對比相同幾何的試片，不混用剪切力與界面能。
steps.instructionEn: Map crack paths and identify interface, dielectric or silicon fracture, comparing identical geometries without mixing shear force and interface energy.
steps.observation: 假設兩試片都在 20 N 破裂，一片界面分離、一片矽破裂；相同力不代表相同界面韌性。
steps.observationEn: Two hypothetical coupons fracture at 20 N, one at the interface and one in silicon; equal force does not imply equal interfacial toughness.

steps.failureEn: Ranking peak load without fracture surfaces can misidentify improvement.
steps.check: 提交荷重曲線、幾何及破面分類。
steps.checkEn: Submit load curves, geometry and fracture classification.

steps.title: 以四端結構分離接點電阻
steps.titleEn: Separate contact resistance with four terminals
steps.objective: 列單位、端點、反向電流檢查及不確定度。
steps.objectiveEn: List units, terminals, current-reversal check and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 畫電流端與高阻抗感測端，檢查電壓是否跨欲測接點，再改變電流方向檢查偏置。

steps.observation: 假設 I=10 mA、ΔV=50 µV，R=5 mΩ；若量測偏置 10 µV 未扣除，誤差相當於 1 mΩ。
steps.observationEn: Hypothetical I=10 mA and ΔV=50 µV give R=5 mΩ; an unremoved 10 µV offset corresponds to 1 mΩ error.
steps.failure: 毫伏與微伏混用會造成千倍錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Confusing millivolts and microvolts creates a thousandfold error.
steps.check: 列單位、端點、反向電流檢查及不確定度。

knowledge.textEn: Four-terminal measurement separates current and voltage paths to reduce lead resistance, but still requires valid structures and parasitic correction.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設 I=10 mA、ΔV=50 µV，R=5 mΩ；若量測偏置 10 µV 未扣除，誤差相當於 1 mΩ。 驗收：列單位、端點、反向電流檢查及不確定度。

options: 列單位、端點、反向電流檢查及不確定度。
四端法能自動消除所有偏置與版圖寄生。
50 µV 除以 10 mA 等於 5 Ω。
optionsEn: List units, terminals, current-reversal check and uncertainty.
Four terminals automatically remove all offsets and layout parasitics.
50 µV divided by 10 mA is 5 Ω.
quiz.explanation: 假設 I=10 mA、ΔV=50 µV，R=5 mΩ；若量測偏置 10 µV 未扣除，誤差相當於 1 mΩ。 毫伏與微伏混用會造成千倍錯誤。

steps.title: 從串鏈回推平均接點的限制

steps.objective: 報告基線、接點數、平均與定位限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Report baseline, count, average and localization limits.
steps.instruction: 列串鏈總電阻、參考走線和接點數，計算平均並設計不同長度鏈以檢查比例關係。
steps.instructionEn: List total resistance, reference wiring and contact count, calculate the average and use different chain lengths to test scaling.
steps.observation: 假設 100 接點總 1.5 Ω、走線基線 1.0 Ω，平均接點 5 mΩ；可能仍混有少數高阻與多數低阻。
steps.observationEn: A hypothetical 100-contact chain at 1.5 Ω with 1.0 Ω wiring gives mean contact resistance 5 mΩ; high-resistance outliers may remain.
steps.failure: 把平均值當每個接點精確值會遮蔽尾端分布。
steps.failureEn: Treating the mean as each exact contact value hides distribution tails.
steps.check: 報告基線、接點數、平均與定位限制。
steps.checkEn: Report baseline, count, average and localization limits.

knowledge.textEn: Chains include wiring, transitions and many contacts; baseline subtraction estimates an average but cannot locate one high-resistance contact.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設 100 接點總 1.5 Ω、走線基線 1.0 Ω，平均接點 5 mΩ；可能仍混有少數高阻與多數低阻。 驗收：報告基線、接點數、平均與定位限制。

options: 平均 5 mΩ 證明每個接點都是 5 mΩ。
報告基線、接點數、平均與定位限制。

optionsEn: A 5 mΩ average proves every contact is 5 mΩ.

steps.instruction: 掃描接點數 N 與單接點失效率 q，計算 (1−q)^N，再比較故障位置地圖。
steps.instructionEn: Sweep contact count N and failure probability q, calculate (1−q)^N and compare fault-location maps.
steps.observation: 假設 q=0.001、N=1000，串鏈存活約 36.77%；單接點 99.9% 並不表示千接點鏈也是 99.9%。
steps.observationEn: Hypothetical q=0.001 and N=1000 give about 36.77% chain survival; 99.9% per contact is not 99.9% per thousand-contact chain.
steps.failure: 將群聚缺陷視為獨立，會錯估不同鏈長的結果。
steps.failureEn: Treating clustered defects as independent misestimates chain-length effects.
steps.check: 保留獨立模型與群聚診斷的差異。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish the independence model from cluster diagnosis.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 獨立接點存活相乘，長串鏈放大低機率缺陷；真實缺陷可能群聚，需另驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Independent contact survival multiplies and long chains amplify rare defects; real clustering requires separate validation.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設 q=0.001、N=1000，串鏈存活約 36.77%；單接點 99.9% 並不表示千接點鏈也是 99.9%。 驗收：保留獨立模型與群聚診斷的差異。
knowledge.textEn: Hypothetical q=0.001 and N=1000 give about 36.77% chain survival; 99.9% per contact is not 99.9% per thousand-contact chain. Acceptance: Distinguish the independence model from cluster diagnosis.

quiz.question: 檢查「從接點失效率推算串鏈存活」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing "Estimate chain survival from contact failures", which conclusion is supported?
options: 保留獨立模型與群聚診斷的差異。
1000 接點鏈必然仍有 99.9% 良率。
長串鏈無法放大稀有接點缺陷。
optionsEn: Distinguish the independence model from cluster diagnosis.
A 1000-contact chain must still yield 99.9%.
Long chains do not amplify rare contact defects.
quiz.explanation: 假設 q=0.001、N=1000，串鏈存活約 36.77%；單接點 99.9% 並不表示千接點鏈也是 99.9%。 將群聚缺陷視為獨立，會錯估不同鏈長的結果。
quiz.explanationEn: Hypothetical q=0.001 and N=1000 give about 36.77% chain survival; 99.9% per contact is not 99.9% per thousand-contact chain. Treating clustered defects as independent misestimates chain-length effects.

steps.title: 量化零失效樣本的信賴界限
steps.titleEn: Quantify confidence after zero sample failures
steps.objective: 明示樣本單位、數量、信賴度與相關性限制。
steps.objectiveEn: State sampling unit, count, confidence and correlation limits.
steps.instruction: 分別以晶圓、晶粒或接點作抽樣單位，檢查是否同批相關，再計算可支持的上限。
steps.instructionEn: Choose wafer, die or contact as the sampling unit, inspect within-lot correlation and calculate the supported bound.
steps.observation: 假設 300 個獨立試片零失效，95% 上限約 1%；不能宣稱失效率已低於 1 ppm。
steps.observationEn: With hypothetical 300 independent failure-free coupons, the approximate 95% upper bound is 1%, not evidence below 1 ppm.
steps.failure: 把同片大量接點當完全獨立試片，可能誇大樣本資訊。
steps.failureEn: Treating many contacts on one wafer as independent coupons can exaggerate information.
steps.check: 明示樣本單位、數量、信賴度與相關性限制。
steps.checkEn: State sampling unit, count, confidence and correlation limits.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 零失效只能界定上限；獨立二項模型下，95% 失效率上限約 3/n，樣本單位要明確。
knowledge.textEn: Zero failures only bounds the rate; under independent Bernoulli sampling the 95% upper bound is about 3/n and the sampling unit must be clear.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設 300 個獨立試片零失效，95% 上限約 1%；不能宣稱失效率已低於 1 ppm。 驗收：明示樣本單位、數量、信賴度與相關性限制。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical 300 independent failure-free coupons, the approximate 95% upper bound is 1%, not evidence below 1 ppm. Acceptance: State sampling unit, count, confidence and correlation limits.

quiz.question: 檢查「量化零失效樣本的信賴界限」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？

options: 300 個零失效已證明小於 1 ppm。
明示樣本單位、數量、信賴度與相關性限制。
所有同片接點必然統計獨立。
optionsEn: Three hundred zero-failure samples prove below 1 ppm.
State sampling unit, count, confidence and correlation limits.
All contacts on one wafer are necessarily independent.
quiz.explanation: 假設 300 個獨立試片零失效，95% 上限約 1%；不能宣稱失效率已低於 1 ppm。 把同片大量接點當完全獨立試片，可能誇大樣本資訊。
quiz.explanationEn: With hypothetical 300 independent failure-free coupons, the approximate 95% upper bound is 1%, not evidence below 1 ppm. Treating many contacts on one wafer as independent coupons can exaggerate information.

steps.title: 整合上下片及接合後地圖
steps.titleEn: Merge upper, lower and post-bond maps
steps.objective: 提交座標轉換與三標記殘差。
steps.objectiveEn: Submit transforms and three-mark residuals.
steps.instruction: 以三個非共線且不對稱標記驗證轉換，疊合前段顆粒、對位殘差、空洞及電性地圖。
steps.instructionEn: Verify transforms with three asymmetric non-collinear marks and overlay particles, overlay residuals, voids and electrical maps.
steps.observation: 教學例：上片圖左側缺陷經鏡射後可能對應成品右側；若直接疊圖，會錯誤宣稱缺陷不相關。
steps.observationEn: Teaching example: a defect on the upper map's left may become the assembled right after reflection; direct overlay could falsely suggest no correlation.
steps.failure: 地圖方向錯誤會破壞根因分析而不易從圓形外觀察覺。
steps.failureEn: Wrong map orientation undermines root-cause analysis while wafer outlines still look correct.
steps.check: 提交座標轉換與三標記殘差。
steps.checkEn: Submit transforms and three-mark residuals.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 晶圓面對面接合涉及鏡射、旋轉和座標原點；不同量測圖必須先轉為同一實體位置。
knowledge.textEn: Face-to-face bonding introduces reflection, rotation and origins; maps must be transformed to common physical coordinates.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 教學例：上片圖左側缺陷經鏡射後可能對應成品右側；若直接疊圖，會錯誤宣稱缺陷不相關。 驗收：提交座標轉換與三標記殘差。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a defect on the upper map's left may become the assembled right after reflection; direct overlay could falsely suggest no correlation. Acceptance: Submit transforms and three-mark residuals.

options: 圓形晶圓重合即代表所有座標正確。
鏡射可永遠以旋轉取代。
提交座標轉換與三標記殘差。
optionsEn: Overlapping circles prove coordinate correctness.
Reflection can always be replaced by rotation.
Submit transforms and three-mark residuals.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching example: a defect on the upper map's left may become the assembled right after reflection; direct overlay could falsely suggest no correlation. Wrong map orientation undermines root-cause analysis while wafer outlines still look correct.

steps.title: 建立空洞與高阻的競爭假說
steps.titleEn: Build competing hypotheses for voids and high resistance
steps.objective: 提交假說、辨識試驗及預期結果表。
steps.objectiveEn: Submit hypotheses, discriminating tests and expected results.
steps.instruction: 列至少三個假說，為每個指定可支持及可否證的量測，先安排非破壞定位再選截面。
steps.instructionEn: List at least three hypotheses and supporting and falsifying measurements, using nondestructive localization before sectioning.
steps.observation: 若空洞圖與高阻位置不重合，先查座標與檢測解析度，再考慮無可見空洞的電性機制。
steps.observationEn: If void and high-resistance maps do not coincide, first check coordinates and resolution before proposing electrically defective but visually bonded interfaces.
steps.failure: 看到空洞就直接歸因清洗不足，會忽略形貌和困氣。
steps.failureEn: Attributing every void to poor cleaning ignores topography and trapped gas.
steps.check: 提交假說、辨識試驗及預期結果表。
steps.checkEn: Submit hypotheses, discriminating tests and expected results.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 相同高阻可由未接合、污染、氧化或幾何錯位造成；單一影像通常不足以唯一決定根因。
knowledge.textEn: High resistance can arise from nonbonding, contamination, oxide or misalignment; one image rarely identifies a unique cause.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 若空洞圖與高阻位置不重合，先查座標與檢測解析度，再考慮無可見空洞的電性機制。 驗收：提交假說、辨識試驗及預期結果表。
knowledge.textEn: If void and high-resistance maps do not coincide, first check coordinates and resolution before proposing electrically defective but visually bonded interfaces. Acceptance: Submit hypotheses, discriminating tests and expected results.

quiz.question: 檢查「建立空洞與高阻的競爭假說」時，哪個判斷有完整工程依據？

options: 提交假說、辨識試驗及預期結果表。
任何空洞都只能由清洗不足造成。
沒有可見空洞必然表示電性完美。
optionsEn: Submit hypotheses, discriminating tests and expected results.
Every void is caused only by poor cleaning.
No visible void guarantees perfect electrical behavior.
quiz.explanation: 若空洞圖與高阻位置不重合，先查座標與檢測解析度，再考慮無可見空洞的電性機制。 看到空洞就直接歸因清洗不足，會忽略形貌和困氣。
quiz.explanationEn: If void and high-resistance maps do not coincide, first check coordinates and resolution before proposing electrically defective but visually bonded interfaces. Attributing every void to poor cleaning ignores topography and trapped gas.

steps.instruction: 先定使用任務與失效判據，再選溫循、濕熱或電性應力；保留應力前後電阻、漏電和影像。

knowledge.textEn: Acceleration models depend on failure mechanisms; one factor fails if stress changes the mechanism.

scope: 公開原理的 36 項教學任務，包含自訂幾何、試算與實驗規劃；保留原 12 項進度 ID。研究里程碑、教學數字與量產資格明確區分，不提供專有配方。
scopeEn: Thirty-six educational tasks in public principles with authored geometry, calculations and experiment plans, preserving the first twelve progress IDs. Research milestones, teaching numbers and production qualification remain distinct; no proprietary recipes are provided.

title: 銅柱微凸塊製作
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入凸塊共面性、電流密度與界面可靠度。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore bump coplanarity, current density and interface reliability, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 互連幾何與來料
stages.description: 針對互連幾何與來料完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for interconnect geometry and input, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 焊墊與凸塊座標｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Pad and bump coordinates | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對焊墊與凸塊座標，把「焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For pad and bump coordinates, turn "Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「焊墊與凸塊座標」的模型：焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for pad and bump coordinates: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.title: 電荷與高度預算｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Charge and height budget | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對電荷與高度預算，把「法拉第關係把總電荷連到理想沉積質量，實際高度還受電流效率、有效面積及邊緣電流影響。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for charge and height budget: Faraday's relation links charge to ideal deposited mass; actual height also depends on current efficiency, active area and edge current. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare charge–height slopes at fixed pattern density and inspect center-to-edge residuals. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 固定圖形密度比較電荷與高度斜率，檢查中心至邊緣殘差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare charge–height slopes at fixed pattern density and inspect center-to-edge residuals. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總電荷相同必有相同每顆柱高。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付電荷與高度預算的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for charge and height budget, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.textEn: Compare charge–height slopes at fixed pattern density and inspect center-to-edge residuals. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

optionsEn: Faraday's relation links charge to ideal deposited mass; actual height also depends on current efficiency, active area and edge current.
Assuming equal total charge gives equal height at every pillar
Directly inferring pure-Cu resistivity from two-terminal resistance
quiz.explanation: 法拉第關係把總電荷連到理想沉積質量，實際高度還受電流效率、有效面積及邊緣電流影響。 固定圖形密度比較電荷與高度斜率，檢查中心至邊緣殘差。 因此不能採用「總電荷相同必有相同每顆柱高」。
