steps.objectiveEn: For shear-test failure locus, turn "Interpret shear force with tool height, loading direction and fracture locus; a high peak can include unrelated structural loading." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「剪切測試的破壞位置」的模型：剪切力需連同工具高度、加載方向與破面位置解讀；高峰值也可能來自不相關結構受力。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「標示破面在柱身、焊料或焊墊，對照相同幾何的樣本而非只比牛頓數。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。

title: 熱壓接合
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入力—熱—位移耦合與接合後界面。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore force–temperature–displacement coupling and bonded interfaces, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 接觸設計
stages.description: 針對接觸設計完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for contact design, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 接合堆疊剖面｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對接合堆疊剖面，把「上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For bond-stack cross-section, turn "Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「接合堆疊剖面」的模型：上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for bond-stack cross-section: Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付接合堆疊剖面的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for bond-stack cross-section, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

options: 上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。
工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「界面反應與脆層」的模型：反應層形成有助於接合，但其厚度、形貌與應力集中需共同評估，並非越厚越可靠。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「把界面層厚度分布、裂紋路徑及電性配對，區分初始與老化後。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：教學假設接觸總力 20 N、有效承載面積 4 mm²，平均壓力為 5 MPa；若只有四分之一面積先接觸，局部平均可達 20 MPa。這不是設備力或溫度配方，實際須由變形與接觸分析界定。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。

Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.

knowledge.text: 教學假設接觸總力 20 N、有效承載面積 4 mm²，平均壓力為 5 MPa；若只有四分之一面積先接觸，局部平均可達 20 MPa。這不是設備力或溫度配方，實際須由變形與接觸分析界定。
knowledge.textEn: An illustrative 20 N on 4 mm² gives a 5 MPa average pressure. If only one quarter initially touches, its average can reach 20 MPa. This is not a tool force or temperature recipe; deformation/contact analysis determines the actual distribution.

quiz.question: 在「界面反應與脆層」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For interface reaction and brittle layers — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?

晶粒料號相同即可省略翻面座標檢查
把界面層厚度分布、裂紋路徑及電性配對，區分初始與老化後。
optionsEn: Assuming thicker reaction layers always improve bonding
Skipping flip-coordinate checks for identical part numbers
Pair layer-thickness distributions, crack paths and electrical data before and after aging.
quiz.explanation: 反應層形成有助於接合，但其厚度、形貌與應力集中需共同評估，並非越厚越可靠。 把界面層厚度分布、裂紋路徑及電性配對，區分初始與老化後。 因此不能採用「反應層越厚接合必越好」。
quiz.explanationEn: Reaction layers enable bonding, but thickness, morphology and stress concentration must be assessed together; thicker is not automatically more reliable. Pair layer-thickness distributions, crack paths and electrical data before and after aging. Therefore reject: Assuming thicker reaction layers always improve bonding.

title: 直接銅對銅接合
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入銅表面形貌、接觸形成與界面電阻。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore copper topography, contact formation and interface resistance, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 表面與界面設計
stages.description: 針對表面與界面設計完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for surface and interface design, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 銅與介電界面區分｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對銅與介電界面區分，把「直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For separate cu and dielectric interfaces, turn "Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「銅與介電界面區分」的模型：直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for separate cu and dielectric interfaces: Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating every solderless bond as the same hybrid interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付銅與介電界面區分的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for separate cu and dielectric interfaces, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.title: 晶粒取向與界面遷移｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Grain orientation and interface migration | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對晶粒取向與界面遷移，把「銅晶粒的取向和界面遷移會影響接合演化，初始接觸消失不等於所有區域皆連續。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For grain orientation and interface migration, turn "Grain orientation and boundary migration affect bond evolution; a locally vanished seam does not prove full-area continuity." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：用多位置截面或取向分析對照電性，標注取樣偏差。 將「一張無接縫截面足以代表整片界面」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare multisite sections or orientation analysis with electrical data and note sampling bias. Challenge the hypothesis "Using one seam-free section to certify the whole interface" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 用多位置截面或取向分析對照電性，標注取樣偏差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare multisite sections or orientation analysis with electrical data and note sampling bias. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：一張無接縫截面足以代表整片界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using one seam-free section to certify the whole interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付晶粒取向與界面遷移的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for grain orientation and interface migration: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: Kelvin 接觸電阻｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Kelvin contact resistance | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對Kelvin 接觸電阻，把「四端結構能減少引線影響，但電流擁擠與幾何展開仍可能混入界面估算。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For kelvin contact resistance, turn "Four-terminal structures reduce lead effects, but current spreading and geometry can still enter interface estimates." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「Kelvin 接觸電阻」的模型：四端結構能減少引線影響，但電流擁擠與幾何展開仍可能混入界面估算。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比较不同接點尺寸的 R×面積趨勢，檢查是否存在固定串聯項。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for kelvin contact resistance: Four-terminal structures reduce lead effects, but current spreading and geometry can still enter interface estimates. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare R×area across contact sizes and check for a fixed series contribution. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比较不同接點尺寸的 R×面積趨勢，檢查是否存在固定串聯項。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare R×area across contact sizes and check for a fixed series contribution. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：四端量測自動排除所有幾何寄生。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming four-terminal measurement removes every geometric parasitic. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付Kelvin 接觸電阻的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for kelvin contact resistance, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

options: 四端量測自動排除所有幾何寄生

steps.title: 空洞與偵測極限｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Voids and detection limits | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對空洞與偵測極限，把「聲學、截面與電性看到不同空洞尺度；沒有檢出只代表低於當次方法的靈敏度。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For voids and detection limits, turn "Acoustic, cross-section and electrical methods respond to different void scales; nondetection is limited by sensitivity." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「空洞與偵測極限」的模型：聲學、截面與電性看到不同空洞尺度；沒有檢出只代表低於當次方法的靈敏度。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「對照方法的解析度、掃描範圍與埋深，設計已知缺陷見證件。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設總接點電阻 12 mΩ，四端量得銅體與走線為 7±1 mΩ，界面差值估計 5 mΩ；若總值不確定度為 1 mΩ 且獨立，差值標準不確定度為 √2≈1.41 mΩ。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for voids and detection limits: Acoustic, cross-section and electrical methods respond to different void scales; nondetection is limited by sensitivity. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare resolution, coverage and depth sensitivity using known-defect witnesses. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: Assume total resistance 12 mΩ and four-terminal body/trace contribution 7±1 mΩ. The inferred interface contribution is 5 mΩ; with independent 1 mΩ total uncertainty, its standard uncertainty is √2≈1.41 mΩ. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 對照方法的解析度、掃描範圍與埋深，設計已知缺陷見證件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare resolution, coverage and depth sensitivity using known-defect witnesses. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：聲學無異常可排除奈米界面空隙。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using a clean acoustic image to exclude nanoscale interface gaps. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付空洞與偵測極限的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for voids and detection limits, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：對照方法的解析度、掃描範圍與埋深，設計已知缺陷見證件。 將「聲學無異常可排除奈米界面空隙」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。 原創算例：假設總接點電阻 12 mΩ，四端量得銅體與走線為 7±1 mΩ，界面差值估計 5 mΩ；若總值不確定度為 1 mΩ 且獨立，差值標準不確定度為 √2≈1.41 mΩ。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare resolution, coverage and depth sensitivity using known-defect witnesses. Challenge the hypothesis "Using a clean acoustic image to exclude nanoscale interface gaps" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition. Original example: Assume total resistance 12 mΩ and four-terminal body/trace contribution 7±1 mΩ. The inferred interface contribution is 5 mΩ; with independent 1 mΩ total uncertainty, its standard uncertainty is √2≈1.41 mΩ. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 對照方法的解析度、掃描範圍與埋深，設計已知缺陷見證件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare resolution, coverage and depth sensitivity using known-defect witnesses. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：聲學無異常可排除奈米界面空隙。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付空洞與偵測極限的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for interface strength and energy: Peak tensile/shear loads depend on specimen geometry; fracture energy also requires crack-path and mode-mix information. Use this evidence plan: Identify whether cracks stay at the interface and report direction, area and fracture images. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 先後量測冷態電阻、通電溫升與裂紋，保留試驗順序。 必須排除的錯判：分開通過機械和電性測試就可忽略耦合。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Measure cold resistance, powered temperature rise and cracking while preserving test order. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

title: 晶粒對晶圓混合接合
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入已知良品、局部對位與混合介面。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore known-good die, local overlay and hybrid interfaces, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

knowledge.textEn: Compare particle and void maps spatially. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating equal particle counts with equal bonding risk. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「切割後表面」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For post-singulation surfaces — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 顆粒總數相同就有相同接合風險
只看最終位置即可判斷接合完整
切割顆粒可成為接合空洞起點，晶粒邊緣與中心須分開採樣。
optionsEn: Equating equal particle counts with equal bonding risk
Inferring bond completeness from final position
Dicing particles can initiate voids; sample edges and centers separately.
quiz.explanation: 切割顆粒可成為接合空洞起點，晶粒邊緣與中心須分開採樣。 對照顆粒圖與空洞圖的空間相關。 因此不能採用「顆粒總數相同就有相同接合風險」。
quiz.explanationEn: Dicing particles can initiate voids; sample edges and centers separately. Compare particle and void maps spatially. Therefore reject: Equating equal particle counts with equal bonding risk.

steps.title: 切割後表面｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對切割後表面，把「切割顆粒可成為接合空洞起點，晶粒邊緣與中心須分開採樣。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For post-singulation surfaces, turn "Dicing particles can initiate voids; sample edges and centers separately." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：對照顆粒圖與空洞圖的空間相關。 將「顆粒總數相同就有相同接合風險」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare particle and void maps spatially. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating equal particle counts with equal bonding risk" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 對照顆粒圖與空洞圖的空間相關。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare particle and void maps spatially. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：顆粒總數相同就有相同接合風險。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating equal particle counts with equal bonding risk. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付切割後表面的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for post-singulation surfaces: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 活化與等待｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Activation and queue time | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對活化與等待，把「表面化學會隨保存環境演化，活化效果須連到實際等待歷程。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For activation and queue time, turn "Surface chemistry evolves during storage; activation must be linked to queue history." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「活化與等待」的模型：表面化學會隨保存環境演化，活化效果須連到實際等待歷程。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「記錄活化到貼合時間及見證接合。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for activation and queue time: Surface chemistry evolves during storage; activation must be linked to queue history. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Record activation-to-bond delay and witness results. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 記錄活化到貼合時間及見證接合。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Record activation-to-bond delay and witness results. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：活化條件相同即可忽略保存環境。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Ignoring storage with identical activation settings. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付活化與等待的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for activation and queue time, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

stages.title: 表面準備
stages.description: 針對表面準備完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for surface preparation, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 局部銅凹陷｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Local Cu recess | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對局部銅凹陷，把「單顆晶粒的焊墊高度分布影響接觸，晶圓平均不能替代逐顆尾端風險。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For local cu recess, turn "Per-die pad-height distribution controls contact; wafer means hide die-level tails." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「局部銅凹陷」的模型：單顆晶粒的焊墊高度分布影響接觸，晶圓平均不能替代逐顆尾端風險。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「量中心和四角焊墊的相對高度。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for local cu recess: Per-die pad-height distribution controls contact; wafer means hide die-level tails. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Measure pad-relative height at center and corners. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 量中心和四角焊墊的相對高度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Measure pad-relative height at center and corners. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均高度合格即排除局部未接觸。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean height to rule out local noncontact. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付局部銅凹陷的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for local cu recess, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

title: 晶粒對晶粒堆疊
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入堆疊拓撲、累積誤差與可測性。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore stack topology, accumulated error and testability, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

steps.objectiveEn: For known-good-die sequence, turn "Testing before adding costly layers avoids wasted downstream work." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「已知良品序列」的模型：昂貴上層疊入前的測試可以避免浪費後續工序。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「計算各保留點的成本與逃逸風險。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for known-good-die sequence: Testing before adding costly layers avoids wasted downstream work. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare hold-point cost and escape risk. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 計算各保留點的成本與逃逸風險。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare hold-point cost and escape risk. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：最終測試即可取代全部中間測試。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Replacing every intermediate test with final testing. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付已知良品序列的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for known-good-die sequence, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.text: 昂貴上層疊入前的測試可以避免浪費後續工序。

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 計算各保留點的成本與逃逸風險。 必須排除的錯判：最終測試即可取代全部中間測試。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare hold-point cost and escape risk. Misinterpretation to reject: Replacing every intermediate test with final testing. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「已知良品序列」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For known-good-die sequence — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 昂貴上層疊入前的測試可以避免浪費後續工序。
最終測試即可取代全部中間測試
邊界鏈路通過即所有邏輯功能正常
optionsEn: Testing before adding costly layers avoids wasted downstream work.
Replacing every intermediate test with final testing
Equating boundary-chain success with all logic functionality
quiz.explanation: 昂貴上層疊入前的測試可以避免浪費後續工序。 計算各保留點的成本與逃逸風險。 因此不能採用「最終測試即可取代全部中間測試」。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing before adding costly layers avoids wasted downstream work. Compare hold-point cost and escape risk. Therefore reject: Replacing every intermediate test with final testing.

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare hold-point cost and escape risk. steps.failure: 避免：最終測試即可取代全部中間測試。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付已知良品序列的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「接合界面抽樣」的模型：埋藏層的取樣可接近性隨堆疊改變，須預留見證結構。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「列每一界面的可測量與盲區。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。

steps.objective: 針對測試存取，把「埋藏邏輯需設計可觀測和可控制路徑，邊界測試不等於完整功能測試。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「測試存取」的模型：埋藏邏輯需設計可觀測和可控制路徑，邊界測試不等於完整功能測試。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較連通測試、記憶體測試與功能測試覆蓋。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設 8 層厚度各 50±1 μm，獨立標準差的總厚不確定度 √8≈2.83 μm；若每層有同向 1 μm 系統偏差，總偏差為 8 μm，不能用 RSS 消除。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。

Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare continuity, memory and functional coverage. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: Eight illustrative 50±1 μm layers give √8≈2.83 μm total standard uncertainty if independent. A same-sign 1 μm systematic bias per layer instead adds to 8 μm. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.

steps.failure: 避免：邊界鏈路通過即所有邏輯功能正常。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 比較連通測試、記憶體測試與功能測試覆蓋。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare continuity, memory and functional coverage. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：邊界鏈路通過即所有邏輯功能正常。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

knowledge.title: 測試存取：機制
knowledge.text: 埋藏邏輯需設計可觀測和可控制路徑，邊界測試不等於完整功能測試。

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較連通測試、記憶體測試與功能測試覆蓋。 必須排除的錯判：邊界鏈路通過即所有邏輯功能正常。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare continuity, memory and functional coverage. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating boundary-chain success with all logic functionality. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 明示假設的量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 8 層厚度各 50±1 μm，獨立標準差的總厚不確定度 √8≈2.83 μm；若每層有同向 1 μm 系統偏差，總偏差為 8 μm，不能用 RSS 消除。

quiz.question: 在「測試存取」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？

title: 晶圓暫時接合與解接合
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入載板支撐、黏著窗口與低損傷解接合。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore carrier support, adhesion window and low-damage release, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for materials and routes, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.observation: 按加工與釋放需求建立材料矩陣。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. Challenge the hypothesis "Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付膠層厚度地圖的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for adhesive thickness map: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

quiz.explanationEn: Thin-plate bending stiffness approximately scales with thickness cubed. Compare support needs when thickness halves. Therefore reject: Assuming half thickness means half stiffness.

steps.title: 解接合支撐｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對解接合支撐，把「釋放瞬間載荷路徑改變，應避免自由薄片懸空。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.

title: 晶圓薄化與背面研磨
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入薄化幾何、次表面損傷與薄片支撐。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore thinning geometry, subsurface damage and thin-wafer support, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

steps.title: TTV 與翹曲｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: TTV versus warpage | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對TTV 與翹曲，把「總厚度變異與自由形狀翹曲是不同量。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For ttv versus warpage, turn "Total-thickness variation and free-shape warpage are different measurands." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較夾持與自由狀態雙面量測。 將「單面高度圖可直接當 TTV」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare clamped and free-state two-sided measurements. Challenge the hypothesis "Treating a one-sided height map as TTV" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較夾持與自由狀態雙面量測。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare clamped and free-state two-sided measurements. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：單面高度圖可直接當 TTV。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating a one-sided height map as TTV. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付TTV 與翹曲的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for ttv versus warpage: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.objective: 針對正面保護，把「保護層需承擔局部凸塊地形且避免污染功能面。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「正面保護」的模型：保護層需承擔局部凸塊地形且避免污染功能面。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較凸塊周圍支撐和剝離後表面。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for frontside protection: Protection must accommodate bump topography without contaminating the functional face. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare support near bumps and post-peel surfaces. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較凸塊周圍支撐和剝離後表面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.check: 交付正面保護的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for frontside protection, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.title: 粗磨與細磨｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Coarse and fine grinding | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對粗磨與細磨，把「移除效率和損傷深度互相牽制，細磨不保證去除全部粗磨損傷。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For coarse and fine grinding, turn "Removal rate trades against damage depth; fine grinding need not remove all coarse damage." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「粗磨與細磨」的模型：移除效率和損傷深度互相牽制，細磨不保證去除全部粗磨損傷。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「對照逐站移除量與截面損傷。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for coarse and fine grinding: Removal rate trades against damage depth; fine grinding need not remove all coarse damage. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare removal per station with damage sections. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 對照逐站移除量與截面損傷。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：最後表面光滑就無次表面裂紋。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較相同測試幾何下的分位數與樣本量。 將「最高強度樣本可代表整批可靠度」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare quantiles and sample sizes at identical test geometry. Challenge the hypothesis "Using the strongest sample to represent lot reliability" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較相同測試幾何下的分位數與樣本量。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare quantiles and sample sizes at identical test geometry. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：最高強度樣本可代表整批可靠度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using the strongest sample to represent lot reliability. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付破裂統計的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for fracture statistics: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

title: 雷射隱形切割
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入內部改質層、裂紋傳播與薄晶粒強度。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore internal modified layers, crack propagation and thin-die strength, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 材料與路徑
stages.description: 針對材料與路徑完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for material and path, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 光穿透條件｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對光穿透條件，把「焦點須位於材料內部，入射面與材料吸收決定可達深度。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw the optical path and films, identifying obstruction. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.observationEn: Draw the optical path and films, identifying obstruction. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有晶圓材料都可共用同一光路。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using one optical path for every wafer material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付光穿透條件的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for chipping and crack depth: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 崩邊與裂紋深度：機制
knowledge.text: 邊緣外觀只顯示表面，次表面裂紋仍可能控制抗折強度。
knowledge.textEn: Edge appearance shows the surface; subsurface cracks may control strength.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 結合邊緣影像和匹配方向彎曲試驗。 必須排除的錯判：無可見崩邊即無潛在裂紋。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Combine edge images with direction-matched bend tests. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating no visible chipping with no latent cracks. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 明示假設的量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設街道寬 40 μm、對準誤差界限 ±3 μm、受影響區寬 12 μm，單側理想幾何餘量為 (40−12)/2−3=11 μm；還未包含裂紋偏折和保護區。
knowledge.textEn: For a hypothetical 40 μm street, ±3 μm alignment bound and 12 μm affected zone, one-sided geometric margin is (40−12)/2−3=11 μm before crack deviation and keep-outs.

quiz.question: 在「崩邊與裂紋深度」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？

Combine edge images with direction-matched bend tests.

title: 電漿晶圓切割
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入遮罩、深蝕刻及膜框熱邊界。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore masking, deep etch and frame thermal boundaries, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for singulation design, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 街道版圖｜機制與設計

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for street layout: Mask openings must accommodate metals and functional films; streets are not pure silicon. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: List the layer stack in each street. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 列街道逐層材料。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

knowledge.text: 用最慢區深度和最大遮罩損失估算。 必須排除的錯判：平均選擇比可確保所有位置遮罩存活。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Use slowest-site depth and greatest mask loss. Misinterpretation to reject: Using mean selectivity to guarantee mask survival everywhere. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「遮罩預算」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For mask budget — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 平均深度達厚度就表示全部切開
遮罩選擇比須保留過蝕與非均勻性餘量。
平均選擇比可確保所有位置遮罩存活
optionsEn: Equating mean depth with complete singulation
Mask selectivity needs margin for overetch and nonuniformity.
Using mean selectivity to guarantee mask survival everywhere
quiz.explanation: 遮罩選擇比須保留過蝕與非均勻性餘量。 用最慢區深度和最大遮罩損失估算。 因此不能採用「平均選擇比可確保所有位置遮罩存活」。
quiz.explanationEn: Mask selectivity needs margin for overetch and nonuniformity. Use slowest-site depth and greatest mask loss. Therefore reject: Using mean selectivity to guarantee mask survival everywhere.

steps.title: 遮罩預算｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對遮罩預算，把「遮罩選擇比須保留過蝕與非均勻性餘量。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For mask budget, turn "Mask selectivity needs margin for overetch and nonuniformity." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：用最慢區深度和最大遮罩損失估算。 將「平均選擇比可確保所有位置遮罩存活」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Use slowest-site depth and greatest mask loss. Challenge the hypothesis "Using mean selectivity to guarantee mask survival everywhere" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 用最慢區深度和最大遮罩損失估算。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Use slowest-site depth and greatest mask loss. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均選擇比可確保所有位置遮罩存活。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean selectivity to guarantee mask survival everywhere. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付遮罩預算的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for mask budget: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

stages.title: 遮罩與載台
stages.description: 針對遮罩與載台完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for mask and chuck, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 膜框相容性｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對膜框相容性，把「膜材揮發、耐熱與夾持決定能否承受真空加工。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For tape-frame compatibility, turn "Tape outgassing, heat resistance and clamping govern vacuum compatibility." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「膜框相容性」的模型：膜材揮發、耐熱與夾持決定能否承受真空加工。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「對照見證膜的外觀、黏力及污染。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for tape-frame compatibility: Tape outgassing, heat resistance and clamping govern vacuum compatibility. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Check witness-film appearance, adhesion and contamination. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 對照見證膜的外觀、黏力及污染。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Check witness-film appearance, adhesion and contamination. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：膜框能入腔就代表材料已相容。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating chamber fit with material compatibility. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付膜框相容性的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for tape-frame compatibility, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.title: 深寬比效應｜機制與設計

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「深寬比效應」的模型：深溝的傳輸限制使底部反應與表面不同。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較不同開口寬度的深度曲線。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for aspect-ratio effects: Transport limitations make deep-trench bottoms differ from surfaces. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare depth curves across opening widths. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較不同開口寬度的深度曲線。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare depth curves across opening widths. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：速率只由總加工時間決定。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.title: 充電與電路｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Charging and circuits | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對充電與電路，把「電漿環境可影響暴露結構，分離良率需搭配電性檢查。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For charging and circuits, turn "Plasma exposure can affect structures; singulation yield needs electrical checks." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「充電與電路」的模型：電漿環境可影響暴露結構，分離良率需搭配電性檢查。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「用匹配電路作前後電性比較。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設晶圓厚 50 μm、街道開口 10 μm，名義深寬比為 5。若遮罩消耗 2 μm、矽移除 50 μm，表觀選擇比為 25；不能用它預測不同圖形負載。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for charging and circuits: Plasma exposure can affect structures; singulation yield needs electrical checks. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare matched circuits before and after processing. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: A hypothetical 50 μm wafer and 10 μm opening give aspect ratio 5. Removing 50 μm Si with 2 μm mask loss gives apparent selectivity 25, not a prediction for different pattern loading. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 用匹配電路作前後電性比較。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：非機械切割就不會傷害電路。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming nonmechanical dicing cannot damage circuits. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

title: 晶粒拾取與精密放置
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入薄晶粒取放、座標轉換與受力保護。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore thin-die handling, coordinate transforms and load protection, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

title: 底部填膠流動控制
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入毛細流動、填料與固化應力。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore capillary flow, fillers and cure stress, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

steps.objective: 針對接觸角與表面，把「潤濕取決於實際表面污染和粗糙度。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For contact angle and surface, turn "Wetting depends on actual contamination and roughness." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「接觸角與表面」的模型：潤濕取決於實際表面污染和粗糙度。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「以相同清潔歷程見證片量測。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for contact angle and surface: Wetting depends on actual contamination and roughness. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Measure witnesses with matched cleaning history. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 以相同清潔歷程見證片量測。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Measure witnesses with matched cleaning history. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：材料手冊接觸角適用所有表面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Applying handbook contact angles to every surface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付接觸角與表面的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for contact angle and surface, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 接觸角與表面：機制
knowledge.text: 潤濕取決於實際表面污染和粗糙度。
knowledge.textEn: Wetting depends on actual contamination and roughness.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 以相同清潔歷程見證片量測。 必須排除的錯判：材料手冊接觸角適用所有表面。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Measure witnesses with matched cleaning history. Misinterpretation to reject: Applying handbook contact angles to every surface. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「接觸角與表面」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For contact angle and surface — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 材料手冊接觸角適用所有表面
看到遠端出膠即可證明中間已填滿
潤濕取決於實際表面污染和粗糙度。
optionsEn: Applying handbook contact angles to every surface
Using far-edge arrival as proof of complete internal fill
Wetting depends on actual contamination and roughness.
quiz.explanation: 潤濕取決於實際表面污染和粗糙度。 以相同清潔歷程見證片量測。 因此不能採用「材料手冊接觸角適用所有表面」。
quiz.explanationEn: Wetting depends on actual contamination and roughness. Measure witnesses with matched cleaning history. Therefore reject: Applying handbook contact angles to every surface.

steps.title: 接觸角與表面｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Contact angle and surface | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對接觸角與表面，把「潤濕取決於實際表面污染和粗糙度。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For contact angle and surface, turn "Wetting depends on actual contamination and roughness." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：以相同清潔歷程見證片量測。 將「材料手冊接觸角適用所有表面」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Measure witnesses with matched cleaning history. Challenge the hypothesis "Applying handbook contact angles to every surface" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 以相同清潔歷程見證片量測。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Measure witnesses with matched cleaning history. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：材料手冊接觸角適用所有表面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Applying handbook contact angles to every surface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付接觸角與表面的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for contact angle and surface: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 黏度與時間｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Viscosity and time | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對黏度與時間，把「材料黏度可能隨溫度及固化時間改變。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for viscosity and time: Viscosity may change with temperature and cure time. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare rheology before and during use. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using one room-temperature viscosity for the whole fill. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

options: 固化收縮只會改體積不會改應力
材料黏度可能隨溫度及固化時間改變。
一次室溫黏度可代表整段填膠
optionsEn: Assuming cure shrinkage changes volume but not stress
Viscosity may change with temperature and cure time.
Using one room-temperature viscosity for the whole fill

quiz.explanationEn: Viscosity may change with temperature and cure time. Compare rheology before and during use. Therefore reject: Using one room-temperature viscosity for the whole fill.

stages.title: 流動與排氣
stages.description: 針對流動與排氣完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for flow and venting, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 毛細尺度模型｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對毛細尺度模型，把「理想流長平方隨時間成長，幾何和流變改變時須重新檢查。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For capillary scaling, turn "Ideal squared flow length grows with time; geometry/rheology changes require reassessment." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「毛細尺度模型」的模型：理想流長平方隨時間成長，幾何和流變改變時須重新檢查。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「繪 L² 對 t 並檢查曲線偏離。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for capillary scaling: Ideal squared flow length grows with time; geometry/rheology changes require reassessment. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Plot L² against t and inspect departures. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 繪 L² 對 t 並檢查曲線偏離。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Plot L² against t and inspect departures. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：流長加倍只需兩倍時間。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming twice the flow length takes twice the time. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付毛細尺度模型的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.title: 填料與篩分｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Fillers and filtration | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對填料與篩分，把「粒徑相對間隙過大會堵塞或造成局部濃度變化。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For fillers and filtration, turn "Large particles relative to gaps can clog or change local concentration." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「填料與篩分」的模型：粒徑相對間隙過大會堵塞或造成局部濃度變化。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較入口出口及窄隙填料分布。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for fillers and filtration: Large particles relative to gaps can clog or change local concentration. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare filler distributions at inlet, outlet and constrictions. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較入口出口及窄隙填料分布。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare filler distributions at inlet, outlet and constrictions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總填料比例相同就不會有局部偏析。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming equal bulk filler fraction excludes segregation. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付填料與篩分的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for fillers and filtration, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 填料與篩分：機制
knowledge.text: 粒徑相對間隙過大會堵塞或造成局部濃度變化。
knowledge.textEn: Large particles relative to gaps can clog or change local concentration.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較入口出口及窄隙填料分布。 必須排除的錯判：總填料比例相同就不會有局部偏析。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare filler distributions at inlet, outlet and constrictions. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming equal bulk filler fraction excludes segregation. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「填料與篩分」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For fillers and filtration — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 總填料比例相同就不會有局部偏析
相同空洞面積必有相同可靠度
粒徑相對間隙過大會堵塞或造成局部濃度變化。
optionsEn: Assuming equal bulk filler fraction excludes segregation
Equating equal void area with equal reliability
Large particles relative to gaps can clog or change local concentration.
quiz.explanation: 粒徑相對間隙過大會堵塞或造成局部濃度變化。 比較入口出口及窄隙填料分布。 因此不能採用「總填料比例相同就不會有局部偏析」。
quiz.explanationEn: Large particles relative to gaps can clog or change local concentration. Compare filler distributions at inlet, outlet and constrictions. Therefore reject: Assuming equal bulk filler fraction excludes segregation.

steps.title: 填料與篩分｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Fillers and filtration | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對填料與篩分，把「粒徑相對間隙過大會堵塞或造成局部濃度變化。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For fillers and filtration, turn "Large particles relative to gaps can clog or change local concentration." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較入口出口及窄隙填料分布。 將「總填料比例相同就不會有局部偏析」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare filler distributions at inlet, outlet and constrictions. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming equal bulk filler fraction excludes segregation" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較入口出口及窄隙填料分布。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare filler distributions at inlet, outlet and constrictions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總填料比例相同就不會有局部偏析。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming equal bulk filler fraction excludes segregation. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付填料與篩分的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for fillers and filtration: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

stages.title: 固化與應力
stages.description: 針對固化與應力完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for cure and stress, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 焊點與通道｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Joints and channels | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對焊點與通道，把「陣列方向改變流阻與毛細旁路，流量不均可繞過密集區。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For joints and channels, turn "Array direction alters resistance and bypass paths; flow can skip dense regions." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「焊點與通道」的模型：陣列方向改變流阻與毛細旁路，流量不均可繞過密集區。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較沿列與斜向流動示意。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for joints and channels: Array direction alters resistance and bypass paths; flow can skip dense regions. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare row-aligned and diagonal flow. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較沿列與斜向流動示意。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare row-aligned and diagonal flow. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：看到遠端出膠即可證明中間已填滿。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using far-edge arrival as proof of complete internal fill. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付焊點與通道的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for joints and channels, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.title: Tg 與 CTE｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Tg and CTE | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對Tg 與 CTE，把「玻璃轉移附近模數和膨脹行為改變，不能用單一常數跨全溫域。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

Use this evidence plan: Overlay material curves and operating range. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: For a Newtonian liquid between parallel plates, neglecting gravity, L²∝hγcosθ·t/μ: doubling length takes about four times as long and doubling viscosity twice as long. Bumps and fillers modify the relation. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 把材料曲線與使用溫度範圍疊合。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

options: 空洞位置和連通性常比總面積更能反映風險。
相同空洞面積必有相同可靠度
一次室溫黏度可代表整段填膠
optionsEn: Void location/connectivity can matter more than total area.
Equating equal void area with equal reliability
Using one room-temperature viscosity for the whole fill
quiz.explanation: 空洞位置和連通性常比總面積更能反映風險。 配對聲學圖、截面和焊點位置。 因此不能採用「相同空洞面積必有相同可靠度」。
quiz.explanationEn: Void location/connectivity can matter more than total area. Pair acoustic maps, sections and joint locations. Therefore reject: Equating equal void area with equal reliability.

steps.title: 空洞量測｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對空洞量測，把「空洞位置和連通性常比總面積更能反映風險。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Pair acoustic maps, sections and joint locations. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating equal void area with equal reliability" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 配對聲學圖、截面和焊點位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Pair acoustic maps, sections and joint locations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：相同空洞面積必有相同可靠度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating equal void area with equal reliability. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付空洞量測的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for void metrology: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for moisture and interfaces: Hygroscopic expansion and adhesion loss may appear during later heating. title: 模封材料與翹曲控制
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入模封收縮、材料非線性與翹曲。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore mold shrinkage, material nonlinearity and warpage, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 材料表徵
stages.description: 針對材料表徵完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for material characterization, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for material composition: Resin, fillers and interfaces determine flow and thermomechanics. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Link material lots to measured curves. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.title: 量測支撐｜機制與設計

steps.failure: 避免：夾持後平坦即證明自由狀態平坦。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

options: 擬合誤差小即證明所有物性正確
整批配方相同就不可能局部翹曲差
保留一種厚度或溫度歷程作盲測。
optionsEn: Treating low fit error as proof of correct material properties
Assuming one formulation excludes local warp variation
Hold out a thickness or thermal history for validation.
quiz.explanation: 模型需用獨立條件驗證，擬合一條曲線不足以預測新堆疊。 保留一種厚度或溫度歷程作盲測。 因此不能採用「擬合誤差小即證明所有物性正確」。
quiz.explanationEn: Validate on independent conditions; fitting one curve cannot establish transferability. Hold out a thickness or thermal history for validation. Therefore reject: Treating low fit error as proof of correct material properties.

title: 扇出型晶圓級封裝
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入重組晶圓、晶粒位移與 RDL 互連。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore reconstituted wafers, die shift and rdl interconnect, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 架構選擇
stages.description: 針對架構選擇完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for architecture selection, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: Chip-first 與 chip-last｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Chip-first and chip-last | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對Chip-first 與 chip-last，把「先放晶粒或先做 RDL 改變對位、已知良品與返修節點。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For chip-first and chip-last, turn "Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「Chip-first 與 chip-last」的模型：先放晶粒或先做 RDL 改變對位、已知良品與返修節點。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for chip-first and chip-last: Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating the routes as renamed identical risks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付Chip-first 與 chip-last的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for chip-first and chip-last, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險

steps.title: Chip-first 與 chip-last｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Chip-first and chip-last | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對Chip-first 與 chip-last，把「先放晶粒或先做 RDL 改變對位、已知良品與返修節點。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For chip-first and chip-last, turn "Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。 將「兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. Challenge the hypothesis "Treating the routes as renamed identical risks" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating the routes as renamed identical risks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付Chip-first 與 chip-last的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for chip-first and chip-last: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

Use this evidence plan: Mark die, RDL, balls and keep-outs. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：驗證翻轉、旋轉與批次映射。 將「重組後只保留封裝編號即可」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Verify flip, rotation and lot mapping. Challenge the hypothesis "Keeping only final package IDs after reconstitution" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 驗證翻轉、旋轉與批次映射。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Verify flip, rotation and lot mapping. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：重組後只保留封裝編號即可。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Keeping only final package IDs after reconstitution. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for good-die and reconstitution map: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

stages.title: 重組與模封
stages.description: 針對重組與模封完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for reconstitution and molding, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 載板與膠層｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Carrier and adhesive | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對載板與膠層，把「載板 CTE 和黏著改變模封後晶粒位移。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For carrier and adhesive, turn "Carrier CTE and adhesion affect post-mold die shift." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「載板與膠層」的模型：載板 CTE 和黏著改變模封後晶粒位移。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較模封前後逐顆位置。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for carrier and adhesive: Carrier CTE and adhesion affect post-mold die shift. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare per-die positions before/after molding. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較模封前後逐顆位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare per-die positions before/after molding. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：初始放置精準就不會後續位移。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming accurate initial placement prevents later shift. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付載板與膠層的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for carrier and adhesive, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.textEn: Compare per-die positions before/after molding. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming accurate initial placement prevents later shift. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

options: 載板 CTE 和黏著改變模封後晶粒位移。

RDL 直流導通便不需熱循環

Assuming accurate initial placement prevents later shift
Skipping thermal cycling after RDL continuity passes

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較熱態與室溫全片形狀。 將「平均晶粒密度足以描述翹曲」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare hot and room-temperature wafer shapes. Challenge the hypothesis "Using mean die density to describe warpage" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較熱態與室溫全片形狀。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare hot and room-temperature wafer shapes. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均晶粒密度足以描述翹曲。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean die density to describe warpage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付重組翹曲的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for reconstituted warpage: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 重組翹曲：機制
knowledge.text: 晶粒與模封材料分布形成非均勻剛性和曲率。
knowledge.textEn: Die/mold distribution creates nonuniform stiffness and curvature.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較熱態與室溫全片形狀。 必須排除的錯判：平均晶粒密度足以描述翹曲。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare hot and room-temperature wafer shapes. Misinterpretation to reject: Using mean die density to describe warpage. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「重組翹曲」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？

比較熱態與室溫全片形狀。

Equating package failure rate with die failure rate
Compare hot and room-temperature wafer shapes.

quiz.explanationEn: Die/mold distribution creates nonuniform stiffness and curvature. Compare hot and room-temperature wafer shapes. Therefore reject: Using mean die density to describe warpage.

steps.title: 露墊與表面｜機制與設計
