steps.objective: 針對露墊與表面，把「露墊、台階與殘膠決定 RDL 接觸和覆蓋。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For pad exposure and surface, turn "Pad exposure, steps and residue determine RDL contact/coverage." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「露墊與表面」的模型：露墊、台階與殘膠決定 RDL 接觸和覆蓋。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「配對露墊截面與接觸電阻。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for pad exposure and surface: Pad exposure, steps and residue determine RDL contact/coverage. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Pair pad sections with contact resistance. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 配對露墊截面與接觸電阻。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Pair pad sections with contact resistance. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：可見金屬即等於可可靠接線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating visible metal with reliable contact. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付露墊與表面的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for pad exposure and surface, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for adaptive alignment: Adapting patterns to die locations must preserve spacing and via rules. steps.objective: 針對跨材料 RDL，把「銅線跨越矽與模封邊界時承受局部失配應變。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For cross-material rdl, turn "Cu lines crossing Si/mold boundaries experience local mismatch strain." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「跨材料 RDL」的模型：銅線跨越矽與模封邊界時承受局部失配應變。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「定位裂紋與晶粒邊緣的關係。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設重組後晶粒平移 4 μm，而 RDL 捕捉墊可允許 ±6 μm；留給曝光、熱變形與量測不確定度的合計餘量只剩 2 μm，不可把各站公差各自都設為 6 μm。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for cross-material rdl: Cu lines crossing Si/mold boundaries experience local mismatch strain. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Locate cracks relative to die edges. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: If illustrative die shift is 4 μm and the RDL capture allowance is ±6 μm, only 2 μm remains for exposure, thermal deformation and measurement uncertainty—not 6 μm at every station. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 定位裂紋與晶粒邊緣的關係。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Locate cracks relative to die edges. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：RDL 直流導通便不需熱循環。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Skipping thermal cycling after RDL continuity passes. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付跨材料 RDL的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.title: 焊球與板連接｜機制與設計

Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare hot coplanarity and bond sections. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 做熱態共面性與接合截面比較。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：球徑一致即可保證全部焊點接觸。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.objectiveEn: For yield and cost, turn "Yield, usable area and reconstitution loss set cost per good package." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「良率與成本」的模型：良率、可用面積和重組損失決定每良品成本。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較相同封裝功能下兩路徑成本。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for yield and cost: Yield, usable area and reconstitution loss set cost per good package. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare routes at equal package functionality. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較相同封裝功能下兩路徑成本。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare routes at equal package functionality. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：每片加工費較低就一定更便宜。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating lower wafer processing cost with lower unit cost. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付良率與成本的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for yield and cost, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 良率與成本：機制
knowledge.text: 良率、可用面積和重組損失決定每良品成本。
knowledge.textEn: Yield, usable area and reconstitution loss set cost per good package.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較相同封裝功能下兩路徑成本。 必須排除的錯判：每片加工費較低就一定更便宜。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare routes at equal package functionality. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating lower wafer processing cost with lower unit cost. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「良率與成本」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For yield and cost — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 位移是純平移不需量旋轉
良率、可用面積和重組損失決定每良品成本。
每片加工費較低就一定更便宜
optionsEn: Treating shift as translation only
Yield, usable area and reconstitution loss set cost per good package.
Equating lower wafer processing cost with lower unit cost
quiz.explanation: 良率、可用面積和重組損失決定每良品成本。 比較相同封裝功能下兩路徑成本。 因此不能採用「每片加工費較低就一定更便宜」。
quiz.explanationEn: Yield, usable area and reconstitution loss set cost per good package. Compare routes at equal package functionality. Therefore reject: Equating lower wafer processing cost with lower unit cost.

steps.title: 良率與成本｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Yield and cost | evidence and diagnosis

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較相同封裝功能下兩路徑成本。 將「每片加工費較低就一定更便宜」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare routes at equal package functionality. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating lower wafer processing cost with lower unit cost" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較相同封裝功能下兩路徑成本。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare routes at equal package functionality. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：每片加工費較低就一定更便宜。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating lower wafer processing cost with lower unit cost. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付良率與成本的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for yield and cost: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

title: 扇出型面板級封裝
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入大面積均勻性、面板變形與拼接對位。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore large-area uniformity, panel distortion and stitching, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 面板布局
stages.description: 針對面板布局完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for panel layout, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 格式與設備邊界｜機制與設計

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for format and tool boundaries: Panel size must fit patterning, deposition, handling and inspection. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: List effective process areas at every station. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 建立所有站點有效處理面積表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: List effective process areas at every station. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：單一設備可容納就代表整線可用。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating one tool's capacity with line compatibility. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付格式與設備邊界的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Cross-map position, station and failure class. steps.failure: 避免：相同總良率代表同樣成熟度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for scale economics: Larger area must account for tool, handling and rework costs. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare cost per good unit and tail risks. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較每良品成本及尾端風險。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for scale economics, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

title: 重佈線層微影與電鍍
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入細線 RDL、過孔連通與跨材料可靠度。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore fine rdl, via continuity and cross-material reliability, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 介面與版圖
stages.description: 針對介面與版圖完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for interfaces and layout, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for interconnect function layers: Power and signal traces need different widths, impedances and currents. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Mark networks and return planes per layer. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.failure: 避免：最小線寬可用於所有電源線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using minimum width for all power traces. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付互連功能分層的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for via-bottom damage: Opening must expose pads without damaging thin metal. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare bottom sections and contact resistance. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「金屬化連續」的模型：孔壁與焊墊的連續覆蓋決定垂直接點。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「用鏈路加局部截面定位不連續。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設晶粒厚 100±5 μm、腔深 120±4 μm，名義上方餘隙 20 μm；若公差為界限，最小餘隙 11 μm、最大 29 μm。RSS 只適用已知統計模型，不能替代最壞界限。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for metallization continuity: Continuous wall-to-pad coverage determines vertical connection. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.

summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入功能分割、異質接口與系統驗證。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore functional partitioning, heterogeneous interfaces and system validation, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 系統分工
stages.description: 針對系統分工完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for system partition, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 功能需求樹｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Functional requirement tree | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對功能需求樹，把「系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For functional requirement tree, turn "System performance must become measurable module interfaces." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「功能需求樹」的模型：系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for functional requirement tree: System performance must become measurable module interfaces. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：把功能元件放一起即成完整系統。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating colocated components with a complete system. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付功能需求樹的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for functional requirement tree, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 必須排除的錯判：把功能元件放一起即成完整系統。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating colocated components with a complete system. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

steps.title: 功能需求樹｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Functional requirement tree | evidence and diagnosis

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 將「把功能元件放一起即成完整系統」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating colocated components with a complete system" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：把功能元件放一起即成完整系統。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating colocated components with a complete system. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付功能需求樹的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for functional requirement tree: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 晶粒技術分工｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Die technology partition | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對晶粒技術分工，把「不同製程的優勢須抵銷封裝接口成本。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.failure: 避免：分割越多一定越省成本。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

knowledge.textEn: Map test points to failures. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating successful boot with all interface qualification. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 明示假設的量化算例

knowledge.textEn: Illustrative independent module yields 0.98, 0.99, 0.97 and assembly yield 0.95 multiply to≈0.894, excluding correlations, rework and screening.

Assuming more partitioning always lowers cost
Map test points to failures.

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for test and supply chain, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 良率與返修｜機制與設計

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for yield and rework: Assembly order of expensive modules changes scrap cost. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare early tests, late tests and rework branches. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較早測、晚測及可返修分支。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：只看最終良率就能比較生產成本。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Comparing manufacturing cost from final yield alone. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付良率與返修的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for yield and rework, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare early tests, late tests and rework branches. Challenge the hypothesis "Comparing manufacturing cost from final yield alone" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較早測、晚測及可返修分支。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：只看最終良率就能比較生產成本。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付良率與返修的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for yield and rework: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for system acceptance: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 系統接受測試：機制
knowledge.text: 電、熱、機械及軟體證據需對應同一工作負載。
knowledge.textEn: Electrical, thermal, mechanical and software evidence must share a workload.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨

Placing capacitors by visual proximity to die center
Submit representative and boundary-scenario matrices.

title: 矽穿孔蝕刻與絕緣
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入TSV 孔形、絕緣覆蓋與漏電。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore tsv geometry, insulation coverage and leakage, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 孔洞架構

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for via architecture, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: Via-first/middle/last｜機制與設計

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for via-first/middle/last: Insertion timing determines thermal budget and structures needing protection. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw three integration routes and irreversible interfaces. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫三條整合路徑和不可逆界面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：所有 TSV 都可用相同熱預算。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Giving every TSV the same thermal budget. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for via-first/middle/last, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.title: 孔徑與深度｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Diameter and depth | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對孔徑與深度，把「深寬比影響傳輸、側壁覆蓋和後續填充。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Estimate worst mask loss and overlay bounds. Challenge the hypothesis "Ignoring mask retreat after alignment passes" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 估最壞遮罩消耗和對位界限。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Estimate worst mask loss and overlay bounds. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：孔位對準就可忽略遮罩退縮。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for mask and keep-outs: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

stages.title: 深矽蝕刻

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for deep silicon etch, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 深度負載｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對深度負載，把「孔密度與深寬比使不同區域蝕刻速率不同。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For depth loading, turn "Via density and aspect ratio cause spatial etch-rate differences." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「深度負載」的模型：孔密度與深寬比使不同區域蝕刻速率不同。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「按孔群密度比較深度圖。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for depth loading: Via density and aspect ratio cause spatial etch-rate differences. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare depth maps by via density. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 按孔群密度比較深度圖。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare depth maps by via density. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：固定時間可保證每孔同深。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming fixed time ensures equal depth. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付深度負載的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for depth loading, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨

knowledge.textEn: Compare depth maps by via density. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming fixed time ensures equal depth. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

optionsEn: Via density and aspect ratio cause spatial etch-rate differences.
Assuming fixed time ensures equal depth
Inferring unlimited life from low initial leakage

steps.objectiveEn: For bottom and corners, turn "Bottom corners affect coating continuity and local fields." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：檢查最薄絕緣處而非平均厚度。 將「平均膜厚可排除所有擊穿弱點」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Inspect thinnest insulation, not the mean. Challenge the hypothesis "Using average thickness to exclude breakdown weak spots" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 檢查最薄絕緣處而非平均厚度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Inspect thinnest insulation, not the mean. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均膜厚可排除所有擊穿弱點。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using average thickness to exclude breakdown weak spots. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付孔底與轉角的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for bottom and corners: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 孔底與轉角：機制
knowledge.text: 孔底轉角影響沉積連續與局部場強。
knowledge.textEn: Bottom corners affect coating continuity and local fields.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 檢查最薄絕緣處而非平均厚度。 必須排除的錯判：平均膜厚可排除所有擊穿弱點。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect thinnest insulation, not the mean. Misinterpretation to reject: Using average thickness to exclude breakdown weak spots. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

optionsEn: Using average thickness to exclude breakdown weak spots
Removing stress keep-outs after insulation passes
Inspect thinnest insulation, not the mean.

stages.title: 絕緣界面

steps.titleEn: Cleaning and surface | mechanism and design

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「清潔與表面」的模型：蝕刻殘留與表面損傷改變介電質界面。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「配對清潔見證與漏電分布。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for cleaning and surface: Etch residue and damage change dielectric interfaces. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Pair cleaning witnesses and leakage distributions. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 配對清潔見證與漏電分布。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.titleEn: Leakage and breakdown | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對漏電與擊穿，把「漏電、擊穿及時間退化是不同測量。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For leakage and breakdown, turn "Leakage, breakdown and time-dependent degradation are distinct." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「漏電與擊穿」的模型：漏電、擊穿及時間退化是不同測量。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「規劃電壓、溫度及時間的分離見證。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設孔深 50 μm、直徑 5 μm，深寬比 10。理想同軸近似 C≈2π εL/ln(b/a)，a 為導體半徑、b 為外側半徑；真正 TSV 還含半導體耗盡與頻率依賴。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for leakage and breakdown: Leakage, breakdown and time-dependent degradation are distinct. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Plan separate voltage, temperature and time witnesses. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: A 50 μm deep, 5 μm diameter illustrative via has aspect ratio 10. Ideal coaxial C≈2π εL/ln(b/a), with conductor radius a and outer radius b; real TSVs add semiconductor depletion and frequency dependence. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 規劃電壓、溫度及時間的分離見證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Plan separate voltage, temperature and time witnesses. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：低初始漏電即可預測無限壽命。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Inferring unlimited life from low initial leakage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付漏電與擊穿的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

knowledge.text: 規劃電壓、溫度及時間的分離見證。 必須排除的錯判：低初始漏電即可預測無限壽命。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Plan separate voltage, temperature and time witnesses. Misinterpretation to reject: Inferring unlimited life from low initial leakage. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 明示假設的量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設孔深 50 μm、直徑 5 μm，深寬比 10。理想同軸近似 C≈2π εL/ln(b/a)，a 為導體半徑、b 為外側半徑；真正 TSV 還含半導體耗盡與頻率依賴。
knowledge.textEn: A 50 μm deep, 5 μm diameter illustrative via has aspect ratio 10. Ideal coaxial C≈2π εL/ln(b/a), with conductor radius a and outer radius b; real TSVs add semiconductor depletion and frequency dependence.

quiz.question: 在「漏電與擊穿」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For leakage and breakdown — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 入口孔徑足以描述整個 TSV
漏電、擊穿及時間退化是不同測量。
低初始漏電即可預測無限壽命
optionsEn: Describing a TSV only by its entrance diameter
Leakage, breakdown and time-dependent degradation are distinct.
Inferring unlimited life from low initial leakage
quiz.explanation: 漏電、擊穿及時間退化是不同測量。 規劃電壓、溫度及時間的分離見證。 因此不能採用「低初始漏電即可預測無限壽命」。
quiz.explanationEn: Leakage, breakdown and time-dependent degradation are distinct. Plan separate voltage, temperature and time witnesses. Therefore reject: Inferring unlimited life from low initial leakage.

steps.title: 漏電與擊穿｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Leakage and breakdown | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對漏電與擊穿，把「漏電、擊穿及時間退化是不同測量。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For leakage and breakdown, turn "Leakage, breakdown and time-dependent degradation are distinct." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：規劃電壓、溫度及時間的分離見證。 將「低初始漏電即可預測無限壽命」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。 原創算例：假設孔深 50 μm、直徑 5 μm，深寬比 10。理想同軸近似 C≈2π εL/ln(b/a)，a 為導體半徑、b 為外側半徑；真正 TSV 還含半導體耗盡與頻率依賴。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Plan separate voltage, temperature and time witnesses. Challenge the hypothesis "Inferring unlimited life from low initial leakage" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition. Original example: A 50 μm deep, 5 μm diameter illustrative via has aspect ratio 10. Ideal coaxial C≈2π εL/ln(b/a), with conductor radius a and outer radius b; real TSVs add semiconductor depletion and frequency dependence. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 規劃電壓、溫度及時間的分離見證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Plan separate voltage, temperature and time witnesses. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：低初始漏電即可預測無限壽命。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Inferring unlimited life from low initial leakage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付漏電與擊穿的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for leakage and breakdown: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

stages.title: 測試交接
stages.description: 針對測試交接完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for test handoff, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 電容與基板｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Capacitance and substrate | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對電容與基板，把「TSV—矽系統可能具有偏壓和頻率依賴。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For capacitance and substrate, turn "TSV–silicon behavior may depend on bias and frequency." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「電容與基板」的模型：TSV—矽系統可能具有偏壓和頻率依賴。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較 C–V、頻率與基板電阻率。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for capacitance and substrate: TSV–silicon behavior may depend on bias and frequency. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare C–V, frequency and substrate resistivity. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較 C–V、頻率與基板電阻率。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare C–V, frequency and substrate resistivity. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：TSV 電容永遠是固定平行板值。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating TSV capacitance as a fixed parallel-plate value. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付電容與基板的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for capacitance and substrate, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

options: TSV—矽系統可能具有偏壓和頻率依賴。
TSV 電容永遠是固定平行板值
孔位對準就可忽略遮罩退縮
optionsEn: TSV–silicon behavior may depend on bias and frequency.
Treating TSV capacitance as a fixed parallel-plate value
Ignoring mask retreat after alignment passes
quiz.explanation: TSV—矽系統可能具有偏壓和頻率依賴。 比較 C–V、頻率與基板電阻率。 因此不能採用「TSV 電容永遠是固定平行板值」。
quiz.explanationEn: TSV–silicon behavior may depend on bias and frequency. Compare C–V, frequency and substrate resistivity. Therefore reject: Treating TSV capacitance as a fixed parallel-plate value.

steps.title: 應力保護區｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Stress keep-out zone | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對應力保護區，把「填銅後熱失配可影響周邊元件，孔洞設計須提前保留區。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For stress keep-out zone, turn "Post-fill mismatch can affect nearby devices; reserve space early." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「應力保護區」的模型：填銅後熱失配可影響周邊元件，孔洞設計須提前保留區。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較鄰近與遠端見證元件。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。

Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare nearby and remote witness devices. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較鄰近與遠端見證元件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare nearby and remote witness devices. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：孔外絕緣良好即可取消應力保護區。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Removing stress keep-outs after insulation passes. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

title: 矽穿孔金屬填充
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入阻障種子、成長前沿與空洞。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore barrier/seed, growth fronts and voids, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

knowledge.textEn: Measure mouth constriction and full-depth profile. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming narrower mouths facilitate void-free fill. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「孔形來料」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For incoming geometry — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 量孔口收縮及全深度截面。
孔口越窄越容易無空洞填滿
流場均勻就代表所有孔內傳質相同
optionsEn: Measure mouth constriction and full-depth profile.
Assuming narrower mouths facilitate void-free fill
Equating uniform bulk flow with equal in-via transport
quiz.explanation: 再入形孔口可能先封閉而困住內部空洞。 量孔口收縮及全深度截面。 因此不能採用「孔口越窄越容易無空洞填滿」。
quiz.explanationEn: Reentrant mouths can close early and trap voids. Measure mouth constriction and full-depth profile. Therefore reject: Assuming narrower mouths facilitate void-free fill.

steps.title: 擴散阻障｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對擴散阻障，把「阻障需阻擋金屬進入介電質或矽，同時維持接觸。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For diffusion barrier, turn "Barriers must block metal diffusion while preserving contact." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「擴散阻障」的模型：阻障需阻擋金屬進入介電質或矽，同時維持接觸。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較連續性、厚度和接觸電阻。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for diffusion barrier: Barriers must block metal diffusion while preserving contact. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare continuity, thickness and resistance. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較連續性、厚度和接觸電阻。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare continuity, thickness and resistance. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：阻障越厚越能無代價提高可靠度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming thicker barriers improve reliability without cost. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付擴散阻障的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for diffusion barrier, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.title: 擴散阻障｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對擴散阻障，把「阻障需阻擋金屬進入介電質或矽，同時維持接觸。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For diffusion barrier, turn "Barriers must block metal diffusion while preserving contact." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較連續性、厚度和接觸電阻。 將「阻障越厚越能無代價提高可靠度」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare continuity, thickness and resistance. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming thicker barriers improve reliability without cost" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較連續性、厚度和接觸電阻。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare continuity, thickness and resistance. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：阻障越厚越能無代價提高可靠度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming thicker barriers improve reliability without cost. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付擴散阻障的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for diffusion barrier: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

stages.title: 阻障與種子
stages.description: 針對阻障與種子完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for barrier and seed, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 種子連通｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對種子連通，把「深孔種子不連續會使局部無法電鍍。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「種子連通」的模型：深孔種子不連續會使局部無法電鍍。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「將片阻和孔底截面合併判讀。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for seed connectivity: Discontinuous deep seed prevents local plating. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Combine sheet resistance and bottom sections. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 將片阻和孔底截面合併判讀。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Combine sheet resistance and bottom sections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：表面種子導通即孔底也連通。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Inferring bottom continuity from surface conductivity. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付種子連通的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.title: 潤濕與氣泡｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Wetting and bubbles | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對潤濕與氣泡，把「被困氣體阻斷局部沉積，與後期封口空洞有不同位置特徵。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For wetting and bubbles, turn "Trapped gas blocks deposition and differs from late pinch-off voids." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「潤濕與氣泡」的模型：被困氣體阻斷局部沉積，與後期封口空洞有不同位置特徵。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較空洞形狀和分布高度。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for wetting and bubbles: Trapped gas blocks deposition and differs from late pinch-off voids. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare void shape and height distribution. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較空洞形狀和分布高度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare void shape and height distribution. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有空洞都由電鍍電流過小造成。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付潤濕與氣泡的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore thinning endpoint, selectivity and reveal uniformity, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 將 TTV 與 TSV 深度地圖配準。 必須排除的錯判：平均厚度達標即所有 TSV 同步露出。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。

Stopping at first global endpoint as complete reveal
Thickness distribution determines earliest/latest reveal sites.

steps.failure: 避免：平均厚度達標即所有 TSV 同步露出。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

title: 玻璃穿孔製作
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入玻璃孔洞、裂紋與金屬化。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore glass vias, cracking and metallization, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.
